Hahaha... In this world we live in, the strong have to make even more of an effort.

They don't know what a bad deal they've made until just before their death.
They aren't even suspicious...
Ah, just ignore me. I'm talking to myself.

Just be careful! We don't know what awaits us in there!
I'll follow you as soon as the Fortune Corps. is ready!
Ok, then I'll go ahead and get started!
I'll be there shortly. Don't go overboard! Okay?
There you are. Pleased to meet you.
Ah, Martin! So this is where you were.
Hm. As I already said, I'm heading up the investigation into the Vacuum.

Of course, I'll continue managing the investigation team at Ruin Fortress, so I'll be going back and forth between both bases.
Probably when %username% stops by Ruin Fortress, I'll be there too.

From the investigation of the Near SoulWorkers to the investigation of the Vacuum...
Even though you're still so young, you're really capable, Martin!
Hahaha. Think about whether I'm capable or whether I simply put up with everything from my damned superiors.

But if I start complaining about everything now, I'll just talk until I'm frothing at the mouth. I'd rather explain the situation to you here.
Even though I just arrived and just want to regurgitate everything that's been said to me.
Yes! Please help me.

There's nothing here but at least the place still had a name.
You can call it Grasscover Camp in future.

Grasscover... a camp covered with lawn...?
It doesn't suit this scenery, but it sounds like a warm name.

If you want to moan about it, speak to whoever suggested the name.
I'm just passing on what I heard.
Sorry, I didn't mean it like that.

Haha, I didn't want to say anything either.
Your nerves must be fried after all the shocking events right after your arrival.
Yeah, yeah. Have they actually found the people who were sucked into the Vacuum?

You shouldn't expect too much in that regard.
There were barely any people here when we got here.

To be more accurate, there was exactly one person.
And even with him we're not sure if he's really human.
Not sure? How do you mean?

Well... You'd better talk to him yourself.
He says he's a human that died exactly five years ago.

Died...
He... He's not a ghost is he?

We can't rule it out entirely, but...
He doesn't want to hurt us at any rate. So there's no reason to quake in fear.
Besides, you, %username%, who've defeated so many strong enemies, have no reason to fear ghosts, right?

Oh well. When you kill a monster once, it's dead. But physical force is useless with ghosts.
Of course, I'm more afraid of ghosts.

Ah. Right.
I get more afraid when you say something like that with such an ambivalent look on your face...

Well, in any case it's the first investigation of its kind.
That's why we're getting lots of help from the SFL.

More than half of the ESP Supernatural unit is stationed here.
The commanders probably want to use the investigation of the Vacuum to end all the harm on earth and are putting all their eggs in one basket.
A Supernatural unit... Not bad.
That's really extraordinary, but after all they don't have anywhere near the power of a SoulWorker.
Ah, hahaha. I'm not that great.

Come on, being modest like that...
If you underestimate yourself too much, you'll lose your self-esteem before you know it.

Well, in any case I've assumed the role of commander of the Supernatural unit.
The Supernaturals were all very friendly, so there were no outstanding difficulties.
Things have been a bit tougher with Amanda since Ruin. I keep trying to befriend her but I can't even so much as talk to her properly. Haha.
Ah! Amanda's here too?

She didn't want to come, I had to force her.
What am I to do? I lose all motivation to work when I don't see Amanda's beautiful visage.
Martin.

That was just a joke. Don't look at me so condescendingly.
Communication is paramount when you put your life in danger. So I brought the person who can best help me with this.

I may not know much but I'm good at judging people.
Please, trust me.
All right. Got it.

My superiors expect a lot from me.
I'm really happy there's a SoulWorker around to investigate the Vacuum.

As soon as I've received the Near SoulWorker material, I'll send it to you, just like I promised in Ruin.
Maybe we'll find it here in the Vacuum too, Haru.
Yes, thank you.

Well, that's everything from me.
Amanda looks like she might be in a bad mood. Go on, have a chat with her.
Phew...
You... look knackered, Amanda.
If someone in my situation didn't look like this then they'd just have dirt for brains or be a masochist.

They believe that humans are simply interchangeable objects!
But to be honest, I'm slowly running out of breath.
That must be really tough for you.

If only he hadn't got involved in the employee assessment for me then I'd be living somewhere else in peace and quiet.
It definitely doesn't pay to be a helpful person.

But compared to %username%'s work...
That wasn't something to say in front of someone who risks their life on the front lines. I'm sorry.

No need to apologize.
Of course, you don't always have it easy, but why don't you just look at it like this? You're saving people. I'm sure that'll give you new strength.

...I knew it, but you're the same as ever, %username%.
I'm in no position to lecture others, but SoulWorkers and psychics are too good-natured.

Have you spoken to the person over there?
He was in the void as far as I know.

Yes, I've heard that before.
They say he died five years ago.

Right. Tenebris was the strongest SoulWorker there was ten years ago, when the Vessi appeared for the first time and the war began.
It's still unclear if it's really him but if it is, then he'd be a great help to the Starry Forest League.
Another SoulWorker...
Oh, by the way, you seemed to know %username%. Have you talked before?
Excuse me? He knows me?
It seems %username% doesn't know.
No... I lost all my memories of the Vacuum and can't remember anyone any more.
In that case, you should go and talk to him. I'm afraid I'm too busy and have to keep going.
H... hello!

I'm %username%! A would-be doctor... a SoulWorker!
Nice to meet you!
Uh...
What about...?
Excuse me? I can't really understand you. Would you please repeat that?
I asked where Erwin Arclight is.
Erwin? Who is that? I...
Don't play dumb. You were his closest friend. You must know!

I don't know why you're hanging around with people, but I want you out of here right now!
This is no place for you.
H... hey! I didn't see that coming. Did I do something wrong?

Was I out of line?
If so, then I want to apologize.
Um... excuse me.
Are you really %username%?

What? Ah! Yes! Exactly!
Did you mistake me for someone else?
Hm... I assumed that people change a bit when they lose their memory...

Memories... yes.
Apparently I was in the Vacuum for 15 years... but I have no memory of that time at all...
You seem to be telling the truth.

The %username% I know is a completely different person...
The look in their eyes, the way they speak... even their aura.

Sorry I behaved so badly the very first time we met.
I hope it won't darken our relationship in future.
Of course not! These days you have to be careful with everybody. I don't care.

Sorry again.
My name is Tenebris. I know I don't look like it, but I used to be active as a SoulWorker of Justice.

Tenebris!
I was told you died five years ago...
Oh, that was a different... No, actually it was the same person, but not the same Tenebris.
What? What does that mean?

%username%, do you know about Soul Spirits, beings contained within a person's body?
It's a phenomenon where a person's will separates from the body, and most often it takes the form of a child.

Essence... ah! I'm not sure, but there was a small child who always appeared when I called for strength.
Is that the child you mean?

A small child who appears when you call for strength... Sounds about right.
The child tends to appear when people need it or ask for it.

If you've seen it before, you shouldn't have any trouble following me.
I took the form of this essence that you already know, and separated from my body.
Humans who become essence... is it really true?

Of course! My body was cast out of the Vacuum ten years ago, returning to reality.
Only my will to save people in the Vacuum stayed behind, having split off in the form of essence.

That is also why I can't get involved in anything that requires a body.
I can stand on the ground, but when I try to touch things my hand passes right through them.

Hahaha... just like a ghost.
Uh... but you're not really a ghost, are you?

I can't say so for sure.
If it's true that my real body has been dead for five years, I guess that makes me some sort of poltergeist who stayed here.
You're not going to curse me or hurt me, are you?

Of course.
I bear no grudge at all against the %username% who is here now.

That's a load off my mind.
Even though it is a bit weird, talking to a ghost... haha.
Is that right?

That reminds me...
Do you recall what happened in the Vacuum, Tenebris?
I never left this place, so I retained my memory.

Can you tell me what happened in the Vacuum?
And what happened to the people who got sucked into it?
I'm sorry, but I can't.
What? Why not?

I have my reasons.
You'll have to be happy with that answer for now.
Does this... have something to do with the thing you warned me about the first time we met?
I have to give you one thing.

You've definitely lost your memory.
But I am not yet sure if you have really changed.
To be blunt, I can't fully trust you, %username%.
You don't trust me? I fight passionately for humanity.

I know that. Martin has told me a lot about you.
You have saved the lives of many people.

But everyone has a reason for what they do.
I hope you understand that I cannot tell you more about it now.
I understand. Then what can I do to win your trust?

I will simply keep an eye on you.
If and when I decide that I can trust you... I will tell you everything.
Understood... then I'll help people as always!
I never thought we'd meet again!

Then we can find the people sacrificed in the Vacuum now?

That would be the best scenario.
Since most of the people who entered the Vacuum are all Supernaturals, the war against the Vessi is bound to get very... interesting if we can pull them back out of there.

But right now I can tell you that the situation doesn't look good.
With Amanda's help we've already tried to establish communications but with no success.

But still. Even if we only find a single person.
I'd like to save that person.

%username% is desperate to help people.
But we won't be satisfied with that. We'll find all the psychics at once and bring everyone back to reality.
That would be... good.

That's why I'd like %username% to help out a little this time too.
Haha, sorry for always leaving things to you.
Honestly, I was looking forward to it! What should I do?

We're the mouse sent into the lion's cave on reconnaissance.
Orders are orders. There's nothing for it.
Hahaha. There are no easy tasks in the SFL.

Even if I do complain, only you, Haru, and the damned Vacuum will hear it. So we'd better leave it.
Let's get down to business.

Do you see the building over there radiating sinister energy, Haru?
It seems to be an anomaly of the Vacuum. We recorded an unusually large energy output at this location.
We've got to examine it directly to find out more. But the energy is so powerful that we can't send in the investigation team accompanying the ESP.
If nobody is capable of doing it, I'll handle it! Leave it to me!
Oho. My, but you're full of zest today. Did something good happen?
Uh, well, Tenebris said that he can't trust me so I decided to knuckle down and work even harder.
Can't trust you... Says him, of all people.

You may just be putting on airs, pretending to be a person who died 5 years ago.
Even if you're the same SoulWorker, %username%, it's better to keep a proper distance and stay cool.
Yes, yeees. I'm already cautious!
Good work on the search, Haru.

This concerns me.
I never imagined we would encounter the followers of Grace's Rapid Flame here.
But... why here?
Did voids open up above the Vessi, like they did above the human cities?

They are also unfortunate creatures who were sucked in here just like us humans.
They are still our enemies, of course.
But you've been here for a long time, so maybe you can help me understand the situation better.
May I also... ask Tenebris?
Why are you asking me? Have you been arguing?
No, it's not that... See you later!
Haha. You've done good work today, as per usual.

You're back! Good work.
Goodness me, I never would have thought you'd fight the Vessi.
Don't worry. I can crush them all!
Have you ever thought about handling it with words?
I would have done that long ago if it was possible.

But those guys have already killed hundreds of people mercilessly before... They all died before my very eyes.
That's why... I'll make them pay for it the same way. That's all.
Weren't you... different before?
Excuse me? What are you talking about?

Oh, nothing.
Why are you here?
Just because... I wondered why there are Vessi here.

I think your observations are bang on.
The Vacuum doesn't even stop for Vessi.

Lots of Vessi came in here, even at my best time.
But they didn't just attack people for no reason. Weird.
They've been enemies of humanity since time immemorial. I don't find it weird at all.

Out there, it might be because of the war, but here it's different.
Still, we were still able to talk to them. That's why here...
I don't care. Now they're enemies who want to kill me and harm humans.

It's senseless to try and convince you.
Well then... Do what you think is right.
Hup... there... Oh, welcome back, %username%.
Are you rearranging things? It really is a lot.

These are Spirit PathFinders from Grace City.
Since an energy flow was detected, they'll be used here to find out more about it.
An energy flow... Oh! They want to track the ability to find people?

At least that's what our superiors are planning.
But that won't work in a million years.
Excuse me? I thought that would be a good method... Are they broken, then?
No, they're not. But Dr Sarah sees things differently. Since the Vacuum spat out so many Supernaturals and SoulWorkers, it's clearly full of ability.

The problem isn't that we can't find anything, but that we're finding too much to be able to recognise anything.
But I still keep moving everything back and forth. At any rate, it's a command from way above.
Good luck with that.
Hossa! Argh! Ow, my shoulder. Why is it always me?

You'd be better to quit moaning and start hauling.
Or get promoted so you can order people around.
Hehe... Should I help you?
No... it's fine. %username% has the important task of setting this up at the operation site.
She's right. You've got a lot more to handle than we have. We can't burden you with yet another triviality like this too.

Shall we have a briefing while we're at it?
Now, %username%. Go to the area we secured earlier and set these up. The farther you place them, the wider the detection range should be.
Okay! Leave it to me!

I heard you caused a huge massacre!
Fantastic, the way you just destroy everything!
Ehehe... I hope Tenebris finally realises what I'm truly capable of.

Oh, you mean that, what was his name... Tenis?
I didn't like the way he acted from the beginning. He's completely useless!
Forget that guy. Just keep doing what you've been doing.

And we don't know why.

That includes the energy of %username% and other Supernaturals. All of it.
Is it broken?

An engineer is taking a look at it, but he's shaking his head.
I guess that means I'll have to look myself... I won't leave a stone unturned!
You sound really pleased. But it's a complete waste of time, so I object.

Oh, more importantly, could you go see Amanda first?

Serious? Did something happen?

It's probably something like too much laundry piling up that needs drying, or forgetting to turn off the gas valve on the stove.
If she's looking for %username%, the laundry is the most likely.
I can see you really have faith in Amanda.

Of course I'm joking.
She was checking %username%'s condition and seems to have found something odd, so she keeps checking over and over.
See you later!
Come back soon. I've got to go off again. Haha.

Oh. %username%, you came, huh!
Sorry for calling you over when you're so busy.
I came because Martin said you were pulling a serious face...
A serious face? Oh, it's nothing important. I was just thinking what kind of voice it is I keep hearing.
Voice...?

Sometimes there's a creepy laughing voice saying things like "At last" or "It's here."

Y... you must have heard a ghost...
Hahaha... you were worried for no reason... haha...

I'd love to rule out the possibility that we're dealing with a ghost, but...
I still don't know anything.
Aha... Ahahahaha...

There is no one who knows energy theories better. Please restrain yourself until we have a result.

Yes, please.
I really don't like the idea that ghosts are constantly following us one bit.
We should take care of this for the shining future of the Starry Forest League.

Is something worrying you?
Well, err... it's like this...

I think I'm being followed by a ghost or something like that.
I'm worried that I'm cursed.

A voice? Hm...
Maybe you know more about that?
...It's common inside the Vacuum. I don't know the details either.

Anyway, it can't be the ghosts or such that you're worried about, %username%.
That I guarantee.
Yeah, really?! It's not a ghost?
Maybe it would be better if it was one.
Hahaha... Now I'm quite relieved.
Oh, there you are. %username%, I've been looking for you.
Uh, okay! What's this about?
Did you speak to Amanda? Is it trivial stuff again?
No, Amanda said something strange had happened and wanted me to find out more about it.

Oh, right. And was Tenebris able to tell you anything?

You want to start with excuses now?
The people around me seem to be harbouring more and more secrets lately.
Well, never mind that, it can wait. %username%, it looks like you've finally pinpointed their base this time.

And there was a Grand Blaze Taifon that disrupted the energy flow.

In Grace City it was the Rapid Flame who had something like that with them.
You mean, the Grand Blaze Taifon from Grace City...?

Yes. I can still see it before my eyes.

That's the only thing that makes sense.
They could never have made it in the Vacuum.

See you.
Haha, as expected, %username%'s way of solving things is extreme.

What is it, Tenebris?
You look so serious.

No... it's nothing.
For just a moment, I thought I saw the %username% I used to know...

Well done, truly!
Thanks to your efforts, %username%, the surrounding Rapid Flames have retreated and the Fortune Unit can enter.

Thanks to that, we've been able to stop the cowards
who try to flee the Vacuum with excuses about being injured.
Heh heh... %username% really is a lifesaver.
S... Somehow, I have the feeling that I've done something bad.

She's been looking for you, Haru. Why don't you go and see her?
Yes, of course. I should go help with the tents!

No, I didn't mean it like that.
If you don't have anything to do, go get some rest.

Hahaha... it's okay, a little work never hurt anybody.
I'm going now!
Hm? Weren't you leaving?

Oh, %username%!
Sorry about that, was I a bit late? The preparations took longer than I expected...
No, it's all right! Shall I help you put tents up?

No, it's fine! The tent setup is almost done!
You're busy enough already, so I can't add more to %username%'s workload.
It's really no problem. Don't worry about it.

Uh, if you want to help then you could explain the situation here to me.
I still don't know what's going on because I only just returned from Rocco Town.
There's not much to tell... The Rapid Flame showed up and was driven out.
The Vessi that were in Grace? Coming here and attacking people. Unbelievable...

I guess they were probably just sucked in too.
But don't worry. We must have driven them all away!
What about the people sucked up inside? Nobody has been saved yet as far as I know.
There was nobody here when we arrived...
I see.

Ah, true: a... you can't quite call him a person... But there was one person here.
His name is Tenebris.
Tenebris?!
Do you actually know him?

...No... it's nothing...
I was just startled because the name of the legendary SoulWorker who died 5 years ago suddenly came up...
Yes, of course. I thought so too.
A... and what about him? What did he say then?

Uh, he knows a lot about the Vacuum.
But he said that he still can't trust me yet.
O... kay? Does he seem in good health then? What's wrong with his memory? Does he perhaps remember... someone?

Erm...
Maybe you should speak to him directly if you want to know everything.

T... true! I can do that.
Hahahaha! What's up with me today?

Oh, sorry, %username%! We still have to finish building the camp, and I talked too much!
That's all for now! Come again later, okay?
So take care! See you later!
What...? Uh... okay.
Did I say something wrong?
Tenebris! I eliminated them all this time!

Seems that way! Good work!
You work incessantly; so you do live up to your reputation.
Hoho, but that's a given when it comes to protecting humanity!
Ah, I understand.

So do you accept it now, yes?
I've really pushed myself too!

I'm afraid that's not how I see it...
I still don't trust you. My mistrust has actually grown.
Mistrust... Did I make a mistake?

%username%, what are you fighting enemies for? What are you risking your life for?
What? I want save humanity...

No, I don't mean such lofty reasons.
That's not the dream of a girl who went to a normal school until just recently.

But it's true!
I wanted to be a doctor back then so I could save people's lives...

%username%, you are not a legendary hero sent by God.
You are originally an ordinary person, and people fundamentally don't act without a purpose.

I would understand if you just said that saving humanity brings you lots of money and honour.
... But what you just said is nothing more than an excuse you're using to try and hide your true intentions.

Why do you always have to express yourself so grandly?
I'm really only doing it to save humanity...

Is that so? If you can't realize it yourself, I'll say it.
%username%, you are...
Could it be that you kill so mercilessly because you want to get revenge for someone?
Excuse me?

From the time we first met, you spoke of "taking the lives" of enemy monsters and Vessi as inevitable.
Just like... the %username% I met long ago.
That's why we're hesitant to send you on this quest.

W... What do you mean by that?
How... do you know... Tenebris?
I can't say.
I don't know if it will change in the future, but right now I simply can't trust you.

All we can do is keep observing what happens to your pure soul.
But we know about the threat you pose.
What do you mean by that?

You should count yourself lucky that you can't remember.

I'm sorry for causing confusion with unnecessary talk.
...But %username%, please worry at least once about what you're doing.

You don't look well, %username%.
Did the legendary SoulWorker bully you?
Ah, haha... We only talked about something unpleasant.

I see. How about a little break?
You should clear your head for the fight.
No, it's all right! I want to push myself even more so that Tenebris appreciates my work!

You needn't mind that show-off.
%username%, just work hard at what you believe is right.

If you want to help me, then I'll bring you up to date...
The Rapid Flame was wiped out, but there's a place steeped in mystery.

It's dangerous because we don't know what might show up, so the ESP Unit has already given up on the search.
If it's alright with %username%...

No, let me be honest. Only %username% can handle this investigation.
Please, I'm counting on you.
Leave it to me! I'll be on my way!
Thanks, I can always count on you.
You're making such an effort. Really.
I have no idea what happened.

I'm confused too.
The enemy that appeared then looked like the enemy %username% fought before... right?
Yes, I think they're illusions...

Hm... I don't understand that. Maybe Tenebris knows something. At any rate, he once lived here.
Can you ask him?
So you... want me to talk to Tenebris.
Why the grim expression? Did you two fight?

No, it's not that...
it's as if a wall has been put up...
You think so? Want me to come with you?
I... If you don't mind...

I have a lot of questions for Tenebris anyway.
Shall we go together?
All right, let's go!
H... hello, Tenebris!

Hello, %username%.
You were a great success again this time.
N... No... Hahaha, that was nothing special...
Even while being modest, doing anything no one else can is %username%'s charm.

But the league seems to depend on that power too heavily.
They shouldn't leave everything to the Supernaturals, right?

Ahaha, I'm afraid I can't gainsay that.
But an apology from me wouldn't change much... so I'll have to keep relying on the SoulWorkers and hang my head down in shame.

I think it's natural that the stronger help the weaker.
But I doubt that humanity will continue to evolve if a little girl shoulders the entire burden herself.
I... It's all right!

I always wanted to help people. Even before I was a SoulWorker...
That's why I'm absolutely happy with this life. Even though it's not easy!

...
That you would say something like that...!
Excuse me?
Oh, it's nothing. Aren't you here for another reason?
Hahaha, we'll celebrate our love on a date.
A... Martin!
Oho? This is no kind of place for a date, is it?
Th... That was just a joke! That's not the way it is! Not at all! Over my dead body!
You're right but do you have to deny it so vehemently?! It offends even me.

Now is not the right time for jokes!
Tenebris, tell me more about the phenomena unleashed by the Vacuum.

This place cannot be comprehended by human understanding.
It is filled with Desire Energy, which makes everything possible. Nothing would surprise me.
Desire Energy?! Seriously?
Don't tell me you didn't know about it?
How were we supposed to investigate the Vacuum? We can't even get near it!
Hmm... then I guess I should start by telling you exactly what the Vacuum is.

The Vacuum is neither a natural catastrophe nor a special place.
It's just a great big lump of Desire Energy. This energy has just one goal: to soak everything up.
There's Desire Energy to spare in the Vacuum.
Understood... So that's the reason the Spirit PathFinder wasn't able to detect the ability.

The Desire Energy is so strong that the marker can't get any reaction from the ability.
If she were here, energy expert Dr Sarah would have realised that ages ago. She's never there when you need her.

Hm... but wait a moment!
Amanda's communication abilities also use ability. Why can she use those skills here?
Don't Soul Energy and Desire Energy cancel each other out when they collide?

Well, if you put it that way, %username% shouldn't be able to use SoulWorker powers either,
so I suppose it's a good thing in a way.

For now, I'll request that the forensics personnel who investigate this energy be dispatched into the Vacuum as quickly as possible.

Haha. I'm sorry I keep causing work for you.

Don't be like that. Just send me, like always.

My wonderful superiors might do it that way. Not me.
I don't want to exploit the friendship of people who've helped me in good faith.

We're the mouse sent into the lion's cave on reconnaissance.
Orders are orders. There's nothing for it.
Good work on the search, Lily.

This concerns me.

You can find those barbarians even here. It really ruins my mood.

I had a hunch the Vessi were sucked in here like us humans.

Right, so you're really familiar with this place, Tenebris. Can I ask you something?
It would be useful to know if those creatures have always lived here or were sucked in, too.
A name I never believed in, but what the heck.

Tenebris' story is truly unbelievable!
When a hero believed to be dead unexpectedly returns after five years, it's suspicious.

At the moment, that's all I can tell you.

If you want to divulge your personal views, keep a journal.
I consider things I don't know to be an enemy for a start. And that's exactly how I'll behave too.

Don't always try to do everything yourself. Let's talk about it.
If you treat everyone as an enemy, you reduce your options.
Maybe.
Okay, let's go see Tenebris.

You're back! Good work.
Goodness me, I never would have thought you'd fight the Vessi.
Oh, do you get on with them that well?

Like I already said: I've always avoided needless conflicts with the Vessi.

It's strange that there are Vessi stationed here.
Even back then there was nothing to be gained here.

It won't be coincidence.
They're up to something.
No matter what it's about, I don't like the fact they've shown up. As if they predicted the fact you'd come.

Don't worry.
I'll find them all and eliminate them one by one.

You're not even the slightest bit nervous.
Combat is the purest form of entertainment to you, isn't it?

You know well.

As a result, I save people as an incidental duty.

Secondary duty...

I thought about it already too, but I find that my feeling of duty is better explained this way.

It's like making excuses to myself, perhaps.
With the justification of protecting people, no matter how many enemies I kill,
no one thinks it odd.

You no longer seem to be the person I once knew.
I'm scared you could lose control of yourself and hurt people.

So there is no need to worry.
As I said earlier, I am not a fool who cannot control her own emotions.

Yes... As I said, I've been observing you for a while now.
I hope you'll do justice to your self-confidence.

Heave... ho... welcome back, %username%.
As you see, I'm working hard moving heavy boxes right now. May I borrow the justice and strength of the SoulWorker?

I'm sorry, but these kinds of sidekick activities aren't my thing.
I don't want to be the villain responsible for having degraded you.
Tch, going on at length about not wanting to help...

...or so the higher-ups seem to think.

Ugh, %username%'s condescending look... reminds me of my superiors.
Hossa! Argh! Ow, my shoulder. Why is it always me?
Because this work suits you.

The members of the ESP unit are on patrol and there's nobody else here. I'll help you.
The Starry Forest League must be pretty hard up if it needs the help of a weak woman.
Weak... hahaha!

I may be tired but I'll still crush you all.
Can't you just quickly close your eyes while I take care of these idiots?

All right.
And you should be punished for your nasty comment, Martin!

Well, no wonder nobody calls you delicate...
Oh, that hurt! Don't punch! This is mutiny!
Ugh... that's not fair! But I'm still working so hard!
I agree with you. You're working harder than before.

That's because I really disappointed myself in Ruin Fortress.
I can't make it right with my work here, but at least I can contribute a little to stopping such catastrophes from happening again.

Let's see how long that decision lasts.
Shall I go and work then? So I'm just supposed to place these steel things?
Yes, please, that would be great.

Haha, you were really very thorough.
But unfortunately, it was in vain.
I wouldn't say it was in vain, because I was finally able to let off some steam.

It was within expectations that the Spirit Pathfinder wouldn't work

Well, let's hear it!

That includes the energy of %username% and other Supernaturals. All of it.

Do you think it's broken?

Oh, more importantly, could you go see Amanda first?

Well, this stuff here isn't helping any right now.
I'll go see what she wants.

If she's looking for %username%, the laundry is the most likely.
A joke that feels very familiar.

That wasn't supposed to be a joke.
Be that as it may, just say hello.
Come back soon. I've got to go off again. Haha.

Sorry for calling you over when you're so busy.

I still don't know anything.

If %username% has no idea either, all I can do is tell you to be careful.

Great job. Was the mission a success?

The device wouldn't work; so it was useless.

It doesn't seem to bother you particularly.
You look rather relieved.
%username% is satisfied by fighting after all.

Of course!
I like piercing bones with my blade and slicing flesh with my cold sabre.
Is there anything more beautiful than killing an enemy begging for their life?

The mindset of a murderer.
...Same as back then.
Isn't it better to enjoy fighting instead of shrinking from it?

This is the 3rd time I'm telling you, I am not a fool who cannot control her own emotions.

I don't know why you've become this way but in a way, I can understand it.

Do you have a solution for ridding yourself of the greed sometime?

I am one who enjoys combat and slaughter.

I will keep fighting ceaselessly for as long as my body will let me.

That's the only way I'll win. Even today I've made my contribution for humanity.

How about it? I satisfy my desires reasonably and can be wrapped in applause until I exit.
Don't you think that's a good idea?
Typical.

You're as ever... treating life very lightly.
...No different from the %username% I knew.

Yeah, really? Well then, congratulations!
And I'm sure you have a fantastic solution already?

Oh... Maybe the legendary Tenebris knows more about it. That would be nice.

...Commander.

Reasons, reasons, always these reasons...

Isn't it enough for me to destroy it?

Haha, as expected, %username%'s way of solving things is extreme.

What is it, Tenebris?

Thanks to you, we're able to stop the cowards

All right. I'll be absolutely fine on my own without getting depressed right away.
How nice to see you again.

Uh... That information is correct.

I see.

Oh well. We weren't entirely unsuccessful.
There's a man here named Tenebris...
Tenebris?!!

Wow. Simply unbelievable...
It's just a meaningless false name.
B... but... what is it then? What did he say?

They raise their voice at the sight of my face without even greeting.
One needn't think about their character.
Yes? That's not actually how he is at all.
So you do know each other.
Hahahaha, I have no idea what you're talking about!

So take care! See you later!
You're really incredibly bad at hiding your feelings, do you know that?

Good work, %username%.
You cleared them out completely this time, didn't you?

So have you got it now?
Reasons, blah blah. I fight for humanity!

Oh, I see. But that's not enough.
We should probe this issue a little more.

Truly, are there no goals at all?

Haven't I explained this already? Anyone who fights could die.

Pretty shallow.
I could swear I misheard just now.
No, I won't take it back.

It's selfish to put your life on the line so carelessly.

Lily, you're fighting your own death.

Worthless rubbish.
I don't fight to be understood by other people.

Not to give the slightest damn about others and doing only what you like is pretty childish behaviour.

Please try to get a grip on your soul again.

Remember...

If it's alright with %username%...

Please, I'm counting on you.

Who could say no to a battle?

If %username% wants to savor some thrills, I'd recommend going at least once.

Goose pimples or not, if it's annoying, I don't want to.

Hm... I don't understand that. Maybe Tenebris knows something. At any rate, he once lived here.
Can you ask him?

If you wanted to go anyway, why don't you make it a boys' night out?

Now stop swearing and come along.
Let's go, quick.
Seeing that whiner everyday, it saps all my energy.

Tenebris.

Understood... So that's the real reason the Spirit PathFinder wasn't able to detect the ability.

Please.

Uh, did I say something wrong?

Oh come on, this is a big deal. But... err...

I really don't know what I should do. That worries me.
Hm, I see. Well, then I guess this ominous man is probably Tenebris, right?
Yes! Tene... Uh, no! It's about my good friend... and another man!

That person... has an innocent face but is needlessly meddlesome.
As if she herself were justice, she brandishes hypocrisy
and likes to give others advice.

does nothing but sneer at others' faults.

What... What do you think?
It's definitely not about Tenebris!
Of course...

What are you saying?

I just had to provoke you a bit and you've already let out the truth.

If you don't talk to him just because you're scared, one day you'll regret it bitterly.
Hm...

So, I don't need to be ashamed or hide it...
You think I should talk to him and hope that everything goes back to how it was before?

That's the best advice I can give you.
But we've chatting here for ages. I'd better look for something I can hit.
Oh, yes! Thank you, %username%! Come see me again!

I don't need a break. Give me something to do.

If you need a break, you should also get enough rest.
If I were in charge, I would fight the forces of darkness for the rights of soldiers to go on leave.

I don't want to have to repeat myself.
I didn't need a holiday right from the start.

Hmm... I see...? If you'll help, I'd really appreciate it, but...
Are you really okay...?

The ESP unit was able to defeat these ghosts, but something unexpected happened.
What does that mean?

That information is more interesting than I expected.

I can move out right now. Finally, something fun again!

It's like you're looking forward to this.
Are you really that strong?

Being reasonably worth fighting is second,
that creepy face never gets old no matter how many times I carve it up.

We must finally move forward with the investigation.
I'm sorry, but I cannot say.

The truth which I know has totally different dimensions that you can't imagine.

No way! We might find the very thing we need to save the world.

This is personal!

I'm going to carry on here, no matter what.

I'm an expert.

Anything might help us. Come on, try to remember something!
Don't ask me... I don't remember anything!
Any detail might be useful, no matter how small... Just tell me what you remember!
I'm telling you, I don't remember anything!

I understand.
I'm sorry for being so hard on you.

We'd be punished if we kept blaming the hero who prevented the world's destruction.
It's good enough that %username% came back alive.

That's all very well, but...
Do we know where the kids went?

No idea. If I knew, I would have gone after them long ago.
But Dr Sarah, what's bothering you?

Don't ask me.
So much is happening these days I can barely keep up.
What? Has something else happened?

Strange events have been occurring in Cloudream ever since Sion and that woman vanished.
The apocalypse was averted, but things are increasingly coming to a head.

Really?
We didn't do anything dangerous, did we?

We were just following orders.
We might be held responsible all the same.

Heh... I'm used to having responsibility pushed onto me.
At the very least, I'll recommend that no member of the investigation team be disciplined.
Blame is unavoidable, but they won't lose their jobs.
I'd really appreciate that... Things would be difficult without the lab.

So there's really nothing for me to do right now, is there?
In that case, I'll get back to searching for the kids. Will you help me?
I have a bone to pick with Sion anyway.
Wait, we mustn't act prematurely now.

The Dig Monster, which caused all the chaos when Sion was awakened, was utterly destroyed.
And the signature of the woman, who appeared so suddenly, vanished along with the Near SoulWorkers.

This place is so quiet now, you'd think nothing had ever happened.
It would be a waste of time to go there again right now.
But wouldn't that still be better than doing nothing?

We're as frustrated as you are.
We're doing our best to make sure our efforts weren't in vain, but all we can do right now is wait.

Even though there's no guarantee we'll get any useful information.
It's that simple.
Hmm, I see. In that case, be quick.

Please refrain from hasty action.
If you misjudge in the current situation, many people's lives could be endangered.

How am I supposed to sit still and do nothing?!
I said I would rescue the kids and now I'm completely helpless!
Hm, you might feel better if you go to Amanda and see if she's got any news.

She's been looking a bit distracted lately.
Something must have happened. Maybe she obtained some critical information. It will be useful to you as well, Iris.
Yeah, yeah. I'll be right back. Wait for me!

Ha ha, sorry to ask you for even this.
I'm busy writing a report to excuse myself to the big shots, so I'm counting on you.
Go see Amanda and Dr Sarah. You might receive some information.

Oh, you're here, %username%, great work on this operation.
No major injuries?

Thanks for your concern, but I'm all right!
I'm here because I heard that you have so much to do.

Yeah, I'm really unbelievably busy.
To sum it up: the whole world is in uproar. Everyone wants support.
The whole world? Did something happen?
Not yet. They're simply overwhelmed with the appearance of the new Vacuum. We've got no damage to report so far.

But we still don't know what influence will come from the Alternate Vacuums that have shown up everywhere, so everyone is on high alert.
We've also lost the signatures of the Near SoulWorkers we were tracking. We can't waste even more time here.
It's not a waste of time! Maybe we'll find them if we keep looking!

I understand the feeling, but since %username%'s word isn't more reliable than a probe,
most of the Starry Forest League will soon withdraw from here.

Is there nothing we can do then?!
The kids... for dead Dr Hicks alone, we have to...

Please go to Dr Sarah first.
Listen to what they have to say. Then you can assess the situation yourself, Iris.
There you are. Have you heard yet from Amanda that a blazing void has appeared?
I just know that chaos has broken out everywhere.

Well, they also opened up multiple voids simultaneously before.
It's stopped of late, but it was a regular occurrence two or three years ago.

But this time the void is different than before.
That's why the people from the Starry Forest League named it the Alternate Vacuum.
What's so special about it?
You can enter it just like that.
Can you get in and back out again too... any time you like?!

Yes, the other voids sucked people in and nobody was able to escape.
And if someone got away or was spat out, they'd lost their memory. That is, we've failed to learn anything about the void.

But this blazing void is totally different.
You can get in and back out again too. It's not a white hole and it's not a black hole. It's more like a door that you can go through.

That's why the Starry Forest League has already put together a special team tasked with investigating the void.
This could herald the end of our 15-year ordeal.
Then... the Near SoulWorkers might be there too?

I can't say with certainty, but I think probably not.
Since a blazing void has never appeared here before, they can't have been sucked in either.
Hrmph.

What do you want to do now?
Do you want to keep looking for the Near SoulWorkers here? Or do you want to go into the void with the SFL?

Doesn't the look on my face tell you everything?
I'll keep looking for them... And if I don't find them, I'll keep searching until I do.

Hehe, I knew you would say that.
Why don't you stay in Ruin Fortress with me and...
I'm sorry, but you can't stay here.
Oh yeah? Says who?
You haven't received other orders have you?
Just now. Most of the members of the search party here have been sent into the void.

They're probably going to be deployed here because they couldn't get any further with the search for the Near SoulWorkers.
Haha, our superiors already have their own ideas about who should do what.
Why don't you finish this business? Why do you want to start something new?

I'm not going voluntarily.
Just striding into the void so unprotected, without knowing what waits for me there, like a lamb being led to the chopping block.
My specialist area is humanity, so I don't have to follow orders. But the others do.

Even so...! Are you just going to follow orders like this?
Don't you have any pride!?

No, I don't.
I've long since laid my pride aside working here.

In a hierarchical society like the Starry Forest, if you hold pride, all you get is unreasonable punishment.
You'll understand when you're an adult too, %username%.
That's a pathetic excuse.

I'll let you know the moment I find anything about the Near SoulWorkers.
But don't you think it's worth investigating the void? After all, it's the source of all our problems.

All of the catastrophes that have happened so far, just like the NED Company's Near SoulWorker project... they all started in the void.
Once it's gone, it won't quite make everything else disappear but at least there won't be any new catastrophes.

That's why I think %username% must go to this Abnormal Vacuum.
...Well, it may sound like an excuse for not wanting to go alone. Ha ha.
You're absolutely right.
In order to save even more people, it would be better if we investigate the void.
So you want to help?
I do, but that doesn't mean that I'm giving up the search for the Near SoulWorkers.

Haha, then I'll take that as a yes.
Why aren't you coming with us, Dr Sarah? Isn't that exactly what you're researching, the energy of the void?

Of course, it's terribly interesting, but right now the energy in the fortress takes priority.
What's more, like Amanda, I don't have any special abilities.
I understand. I don't want to force any civilian who doesn't want to.

In that case, today it's up to us, Iris! Let's move out!
The Alternate Vacuum is located on the way to Rocco Town.
Oh, %username%! It's been a while!
I just dropped by, because I have something to do here! I'm glad you're doing well!
I ought to be the one saying that to you. There are all sorts of rumours going around that a lot happened. I was worried sick about you!
I'm used to it. I'm all right!
Ah. Haha. I don't know if this is good or bad...
No problem! Don't worry about it.
It's good that you're here. The void that appeared here recently is causing chaos in Rocco Town.

See that void in the sky above Rocco Town?
Compared to the other voids near here, Rocco Town's void is phenomenally huge.
That's where I came out of, isn't it?

The void's size alone is enough to make it intimidating, but to make matters worse it's now active.
If the research team's report is to be believed, you can walk right into it.

That's why Rocco Town's residents are fleeing in a panic.
At the same time, Rocco Town is crawling with members of the Starry Forest League ESP's Supernatural unit.

I think I've heard about it
What's the situation inside the terrifying Vacuum?

They haven't looked into that yet.
The Starry Forest League's Supernaturals will find that out next.
The SFL always gives me the feeling they're hard at work but not really helping.

Right... %username% has solved nearly all the big jobs.
No matter how hard we try, we can't touch your achievements.

I didn't mean it like that.
But I can see why you took it that way... sorry.

Ha ha... but it seems it's really tough in there right now.
You probably know well, but if %username% goes, she'll surely have a hard time.
Can you do it? It's not asking too much, is it?

Don't worry about me.
I wasn't able to save the Near SoulWorkers, but at least I'll be able to lead the people out of the Vacuum.

Heh, %username% hasn't changed.
Sometimes you look rough, but you always had a strong sense of justice.
The strong should protect the weak. It's true, isn't it?

They don't know what a bad deal they've made until just before their death.
They aren't even suspicious...
What...? What is that supposed to mean?
Ah, just ignore me. I'm talking to myself.

Just be careful! We don't know what awaits us in there!
I'll follow you as soon as the Fortune Corps. is ready!
Oh, I'll go ahead and deal with everything on my own; then you don't even have to follow!
I'll be there shortly. Don't go overboard! Okay?
There you are. Pleased to meet you.

What? You're here already?!
If you can teleport, why didn't you take me along?

I'd love to have done that but I came here in the helicopter for the commander of investigation team. Outsiders can't fly with us, I'm afraid.
You might think it's a senseless privilege, but please forgive me. I constantly have to travel back and forth between here and Ruin Fortress.
Heli... copter... Ugh.
Yes, right. You definitely wouldn't have been able to fly with us with your fear of heights.
I've flown once before, but... I didn't get used to it...

I bet that's pretty annoying nowadays.
I will definitely cheer you on while you run in future too.

Then I'll explain the situation to you now. There's nothing here but at least the place still had a name.
You can call it Grasscover Camp in future.
Who came up with words like ‘verdant' and ‘camp' looking at this sight?

If you want to moan about it, speak to whoever suggested the name.
I'm just passing on what I heard.
Wait until he hears from me! There are so many cool names like ‘World of the Twisted Shadow Kingdom' or ‘Fallen Imperium'!

But this right here is neither a shadow kingdom or imperium...
No matter, you can take it up with him later. He's using the name of someone who died five years ago. I'm sure you'll like his unnecessarily pretentious manner.

There are far fewer people here than I thought.
Aren't all members of the SFL supposed to be coming here?

Yes, we do really need a lot more troops for this last battle to save humanity.
But we can't risk Cloudream being taken by the Vessi.

But that doesn't mean %username% needs to worry.
A few, but almost all combat personnel belong to the E.S.P Squad, that is, the psychic squad.
But many look like ordinary soldiers.

That's because there are also humans who don't fight as insanely as you. They only use their ability to lend support.
That's why they almost look like normal soldiers, but they're the elite.
I don't care as long as they don't throw their lives away for an investigation.

No worries on that point. They're all battle-hardened psychics.
They won't get in %username%'s way.

Well... Since I was suddenly appointed commander of the Supernatural unit I feel a heavy sense of responsibility too.
But the Supernaturals are all very friendly, so I've really been able to settle in.
Things have been a bit tougher with Amanda since Ruin. I keep trying to befriend her but I can't even so much as talk to her properly. Haha.
Ah. So, in the end you brought her with you.

She didn't want to come, I had to force her.
What am I to do? I lose all motivation to work when I don't see Amanda's beautiful visage.

That was just a joke. Don't look at me so condescendingly.
Communication is paramount when you put your life in danger. So I brought the person who can best help me with this.

I may not know much but I'm good at judging people.
Please, trust me.
Anyone can say that. Let your actions do your talking for you.

Hahaha. At any rate, my superiors expect a lot from me.
I'm really happy there's a SoulWorker around to investigate the Vacuum.

As soon as I've received the Near SoulWorker material, I'll send it to you, just like I promised in Ruin.
Maybe we'll find it here in the Vacuum too, Iris.
Yes, please! I have never given up.

Well, that's everything from me.
Amanda looks like she might be in a bad mood. Go on, have a chat with her.
Phew...
You look really done in.
If someone in my situation didn't look like this then they'd just have dirt for brains or be a masochist.

They believe that humans are simply interchangeable objects!
But to be honest, I'm slowly running out of breath.
Wow... I can sense your anger from here.

But I shouldn't grumble.
I let Dr Hicks die. I'll have to work even harder to make it right again.

But you didn't kill him!
Why should you feel guilty? Nobody's blaming you.

Thank you for saying so, but I feel responsible nevertheless.
If I had known it was so hard to let somebody die, then I would have...

Anyway, a lot has happened.
I know it's hard for you too, %username%, but let's work together again.
I'll do everything I can so we can bring this to a swift end and then search for the Near SoulWorkers.

Have you spoken to the person over there?
He was in the void as far as I know.
Him there? Oh, is that the one using the name of a dead man?

Yes, exactly. Tenebris was the strongest SoulWorker there was ten years ago, when the Vessi appeared for the first time and the war began.
It's still unclear if it's really him but if it is, then he'd be a great help to the Starry Forest League.
The strongest? Was he really so fantastic?

It's almost impossible to describe.
He's not a legend for no reason.
In that case, I'd really like to take a look at him.
Oh, by the way, you seemed to know %username%. Have you talked before?
Excuse me? He knows me?
It seems %username% doesn't know.
I don't know if it's true, but if it is, then that would be very interesting.
In that case, you should go and talk to him. I'm afraid I'm too busy and have to keep going.
Hey, are you Tenebris?
G... Good day.

Hm, you look a lot younger than I expected a legend to look.
Are you really older than me?

Ahaha, age no longer has any meaning for me.
You don't age in the Vacuum.
Ah, I see.

Still, I'm not that different in age from you.
Only 1 or 2 years apart, so there's no need for formal speech.
You're the one who started it.

That is merely a habit.
I don't wish to be rude to others.
%username% can speak however is easy for you... how about it?
That's an offer I won't pass up! I like to put my cards on the table.
Excuse me? Really?
Why? You're the one who made the offer.

I see.
And it's true, I did start it... Haha...
Understood... I look forward to working with you. %username%.

I came because I heard you know me.
Can you help me understand?
I'm not sure what you want to know, exactly... but I'll try to answer your questions.

Hmm... from what I heard you should have died 5 years ago,
so can you explain why you're still alive here?
Oh, that was a different... No, actually it was the same person, but not the same Tenebris.
What's keeping you? Go on, spit it out!

%username%, do you know about Soul Spirits, beings contained within a person's body?
It's a phenomenon where a person's will separates from the body, and most often it takes the form of a child.
Oh, I think I know what you mean. That small child once asked me if I needed more strength.

A child who appears when you call for strength... exactly.
The child tends to appear when people need it or ask for it.

If you've seen it before, you shouldn't have any trouble following me.
I took the form of this essence that you already know, and separated from my body.

Yes... and I've become unable to get far away from the entity over there,
so I'm bound here, closest to the Vacuum that became a passage.
Like a poltergeist unable to let go of life...

When my body was forced to leave the Vacuum ten years ago, my will stayed behind to rescue the people here.
Poltergeist describes me pretty well, actually, because I still bear a grudge.
So the Tenebris who died back in reality is real, and you are too?
You can think of it that way, yes.

Okay, that's all right then.
I have another question to determine if you really are this original SoulWorker.

I want to know what I did in the 15 years I spent inside the Vacuum. What happened?
I don't know, and that frustrates me. Please tell me everything.

It's not easy to sum up 15 years.
Can you be a bit more specific?
Just tell me what I was like in the Vacuum! And what I did!
Haha... You probably think you were a big gun. You seem to think very highly of yourself.

Before I answer, let me ask you a question.
Does the name Jin Seipatsu mean anything to you?

Jin Seipatsu?
I think Amanda mentioned a name like that a while back.
It looks like you really don't remember a thing.

Right. I don't know anything about my time in the Vacuum.
Even when I went inside the Vacuum, it didn't jog my memory.
Okay, I understand.

First, the %username% I remember was very obstinate.
Once you thought you were right, you hardly listened to others' opinions.

Hm, I can see that happening. I still don't listen to others much.
Fighting with somebody like me must have been pretty tiring.

Wow. You're so modest.
So? What happened?

Nothing special.
We fought a lot, but had to cooperate all the same.

That's what I know, in a nutshell.
Is that enough?

No, we're not done yet.
First you have to tell me who this Jin Seipatsu is that you were asking about.
That has nothing to do with you.
If that's true, why did you give me a completely different impression at first?
The name carries unpleasant memories.
And why won't you tell me why that is?
I do not want to open up room for wild speculations.

All right, if you say so.
You are unbelievably stubborn.

It is not that I cannot or will not tell you.
I am simply not sure if you should really hear it.
Will I be cursed or have to die or something?
No, it's not that.

When I last saw you, you were "not yet" a SoulWorker.
...So I want to confirm "why you became a SoulWorker," %username%.
Okay, and what do I do now?

You do not have to do anything special! I will simply observe how you behave.
As soon as I have the feeling that I can trust you, I will tell you everything.
Hm, I assume that you don't mean that I should just sit around, right?
Hehe, it is up to you how you interpret it.

All right. Then I'll just save the world, like usual, ok?
Pay close attention and don't forget your promise!
Of course not.
I never thought we'd meet again!
Ah. It's good that you're here, Iris. We've investigated the surrounding area and are in the middle of putting together a unit that will be tasked with looking at more remote locations.
All right! So I can start rescuing people again?!

That would be the best scenario.
Since most of the people who entered the Vacuum are all Supernaturals, the war against the Vessi is bound to get very... interesting if we can pull them back out of there.

But right now I can tell you that the situation doesn't look good.
With Amanda's help we've already tried to establish communications but with no success.
That doesn't necessarily mean anything. We'll only have more information once we've found them.

I was waiting for those words.
Not only to help people but to strengthen our forces, find as many as you can.

For that, I'd like %username% to help this time too.
Ha ha, sorry for always leaving it to you.
Stop saying sorry and tell me what I should do!

The most important thing is cleaning up the area.
You never know what will happen next in the Vacuum. That's why we have to secure the area so the other units can rendezvous with us one after another.

We're the mouse sent into the lion's cave on reconnaissance.
Orders are orders. There's nothing for it.

Do you see the building over there radiating sinister energy, Iris?
It seems to be an anomaly of the Vacuum. We recorded an unusually large energy output at this location.

You can tell when you get close, it's a considerably huge energy.
An investigation team accompanied by our E.S.P can't easily enter.
In that case, I'll handle it! Don't worry, I'll set out right now!
Oho. My, but you're full of zest today. Did something good happen?
I'm the same as always! Everything completely normal!

Hahaha. I don't know what's happened, but if you're having fun then you'll definitely try even harder.
Thank you for helping me again.
Good work on the search, Iris.

This concerns me.
I never imagined we would encounter the followers of Grace's Rapid Flame here.
They really are pests. Have they pursued me here to take revenge?

It's more likely they were sucked in here, just like we were.
Deliberately entering a dangerous place like this to fight Soul Junk is a strange choice.

But you've been here for a long time, so maybe you can help me understand the situation better.
Why are the Vessi here?
Isn't it enough when I go there and take care of everything?
Yes, but be careful! Good luck!
Please take care of it.

You're back! Good work.
Goodness me, I never would have thought you'd fight the Vessi.

So, how as I? What impression did you get of me?
Will you tell me about the past now?

No, not yet.
I didn't want to see %username%'s ability or power.
I can't make a decision that fast. Please wait a little longer
I don't even know what you want to see. If you want to evaluate me, then you should at least tell me what matters to you.
I'm sorry. I left you waiting for no reason.

Oh, well yes. The stories of the past are just an added bonus to me, so it's not important right this moment.
But if I do everything the way I normally do then you'll tell me. Right?

I'll... tell you after I've observed you.
Aren't you here for another reason?
Ah. I'm supposed to ask you if you know why the Vessi have suddenly shown up.

I think your observations are bang on.
The Vacuum doesn't care if someone is a human or Vessi. It sucks in everything.

Lots of Vessi came in here, even at my best time.
But they didn't just attack people for no reason. Weird.
What are you saying? Those guys immediately attack like madmen when they see a human.

Out there, it might be because of the war, but here it's different.
We were able to talk to them and since we had a mutual enemy in the Soul Junk, it turned out that we worked together.
You're not trying to ask me to stop fighting them, are you?

That... No, of course not.
I wasn't there; but of course if the Vessi attack, you have to defend yourself.

That's okay, then. Leave it to me. I'll keep wiping them out too!
And if you ever decide you want to tell me about back then, let me know!
Yes. Please keep doing your best.
Hup... there... Oh, welcome back, %username%.
Oh, what are you so diligently moving back and forth?

These are Spirit PathFinders from Grace City.
Since an energy flow was detected, they'll be used here to find out more about it.
An energy flow... Could it make it easier to find survivors?

At least that's what our superiors are planning.
But that won't work in a million years.
Why not? I don't think it's such a bad idea.

According to Dr. Sarah, a Vacuum that produces this many Supernaturals and SoulWorkers
surely has Soul Energy running rampant everywhere.

The problem isn't that we can't find anything, but that we're finding too much to be able to recognise anything.
But I still keep moving everything back and forth. At any rate, it's a command from way above.
How about you just ignore him and do what you want?

I have a family to support... well, I don't.
But I have the ambition of earning money and throwing my weight around, so I'll give up.
Hossa! Argh! Ow, my shoulder. Why is it always me?

You'd be better to quit moaning and start hauling.
Or get promoted so you can order people around.
Hmm, shall I help too?

No... it's okay.
%username% has the important mission of setting this up at the operation site.
She's right. You've got a lot more to handle than we have. We can't burden you with yet another triviality like this too.

Shall we have a briefing while we're at it?
Now, %username%. Go to the area we secured earlier and set these up. The farther you place them, the wider the detection range should be.

Oh, so that's what it's about.
Got it. I'll take care of it right away.

I heard you caused a huge massacre!
Fantastic, the way you just destroy everything!
It was no big deal. How's the installation of the devices going?
As I said, there's nothing here to be happy about.
This is the worst sort of work, when you know right from the start that it's not going to achieve anything.

The Spirit Pathfinder can't detect any Soul Energy at all.
That includes the energy of %username% and other Supernaturals. All of it.

The Spirit PathFinder doesn't register ability.
Neither your energy nor the Supernaturals'.
Is it broken?
It's brand new, newly deployed for the Vacuum investigation, so it shouldn't break...

Then we'll just have to take care of it ourselves.
Wait a minute. I'm going to go find somebody and bring him here.
You sound really pleased. But it's a complete waste of time, so I object.

Oh, more importantly, could you go see Amanda first?
She was looking for %username% a moment ago with a serious look on her face.

It's probably something like too much laundry piling up that needs drying, or forgetting to turn off the gas valve on the stove.
If she's looking for %username%, the laundry is the most likely.
She isn't that thoughtless, is she?

Of course I'm joking.
She was checking %username%'s condition and seems to have found something odd, so she keeps checking over and over.
Something strange? But everything is fine with me.
There are a lot of things that you don't notice yourself. Feel free to talk about it.
Come back soon. I've got to go off again. Haha.

Oh. %username%, you came, huh!
Sorry for calling you over when you're so busy.
That's fine. What strange business is it about then?

Ah, I spoke to Martin.
It's not that important, but I heard a strange voice during one of my missions.
A voice...?

Sometimes there's a creepy laughing voice saying things like "At last" or "It's here."
It seems to be heard near %username%, and there's ringing-like noise along with it, so analyzing the content is giving me a lot of trouble.
What's all this about? Surely it can't be a ghost? I don't like it at all.

I'd love to rule out the possibility that we're dealing with a ghost, but...
I still don't know anything.
Hmm, with an opponent like that, even I...

Don't worry about it too much. I'm talking to Dr Sarah in Ruin Fortress to come up with a plan.
There is no one who knows energy theories better. Please restrain yourself until we have a result.
Please! Absolutely!
You seem to be running around the place in a real tizzy. What is it?

Hmm... I'd better go and ask.
Are there ghosts living in the void?
Ghosts? I've never seen anything like that in all my time in the Vacuum, but...
But you're a ghost too!
I'm the manifestation of someone's will. Don't get me confused with such nightmarish apparitions.
Manifestation of will or nightmarish apparition, isn't it the same in the end?

It's something totally different! Although what you think of as a ghost could be something similar to me.
Tell me, what does your ghost look like?

Oh, the people I work with think that I'm being followed by a ghost with a strange voice.
It says things like “There you are” and “Finally” and laughs horribly. Isn't that a ghost?
Is that possible then...?
What, have you got any ideas?

Probably, what %username% described isn't a ghost.
...Rather, it may be something nastier than a ghost.
Really? What is it then?

That... I'm sorry.
I can't tell you that now.

Ah, does it belong in the realm of the past that you won't talk about?
That's stupid, of course, but since you promised me you'd tell me everything later, I don't want to be like that.

I won't pester you with questions now.
But you have to tell me the truth at some point, understood?
Of course.
Oh, there you are. %username%, I've been looking for you.
If you're looking for me then I guess you're having problems?

Haha, exactly.
Have you spoken to Amanda? Is it trivial stuff again?
No, I only came because something seems to be wrong with my head.

Oh, right. And was Tenebris able to tell you anything?
Every time I ask him something, he just says “I know nothing” like a broken record.

You humans just want to survive and can't understand it.
So, you won't tell me why you really came?

Didn't you notice anything unusual in the conversation?
Have you ever heard of the port city of Dipluce?

D... Dipluce?

I understand… judging by your reaction, I can already imagine that I will have a lot of fun there.

Dipluce is already hell on earth!
A place teeming with Soul Junk.

Not even the entire force of Grace City would be enough to pave even one way to Dipluce.
Soul Junk, which merged with various objects from the surrounding area and were revived, block the way there.
Lieutenant Colonel Aaron is no fool, so he must know that much...
Henry and the Queen, that must tell you something, doesn't it?

Henry and the Queen... That's exactly what Lieutenant Colonel Aaron wants most. It must be a trap!
Could this be a false lead to get Lieutenant Colonel Aaron out of reserve?

If I knew what this guy was thinking, it would have been easier so far.

Let's be honest… Even if you are anything but a good person, you should at least preserve a little humanity.
What is this now, when the end of the world is near?

No… From the looks of things, I'll have to speak to Lieutenant Colonel Aaron myself about this matter.
We can't risk the lives of soldiers for such an unsafe cause.

Aaron was strong for going there.
And if there are fights and Henry waiting for me, I don't mind.

But the other soldiers don't care about their lives!
Whatever. I'll try to stop Lieutenant Colonel Aaron. Are you coming?
No, I have something else to do right now.
Okay, I'm gonna go.

Oh! Long time no see, %username%!
Is your Soul Junk extermination journey going smoothly today too?

Everything's fine.
But you also seem to be happy and content.
Sure! I'm proud to do Soul Junk all day long!
Huh. When we first met, you liked her so much. I guess you changed your mind.

Basically, they're useless and do nothing but damage.
I want to test the weapon of mass destruction I have built as soon as possible, but it is not so easy to get permission to do so.
Then I'm sure you'll like that.
Huh? Have you got anything for me?

Is this mission about wiping out the Soul Junk?! Since you've come here, Lily, it must be so!
Brooke was always against it, but now it's finally time!

When do we start? And where?
I've been looking forward to this for so long!
Have you ever heard of the port city of Dipluce?

Dipluce... There's so full of Soul Junk, isn't there?
This is just the place to test my dissolving gas!

He has not yet become active…

Henry… and even the Soul Junk queen…

We can't rely entirely on them.

It is not important how reliable the information is.
It's enough for me that a path has opened up that I can follow.

... Then I should go, too.
I can only hope that Brooke's actions won't prevent the mission.
I can't help but overhear.
Huh? What do you think?

Doesn't Brooke just want to stop there being more victims?
You have no right to dismiss these efforts as fuss.
Are you serious?

More than ten missions have failed because of her.
I don't feel like holding back because of her hypocrisy anymore.

I don't understand why Lieutenant Colonel Aaron keeps listening to her.
Do you know how many opportunities we've missed so far?!

If this mission is cancelled because of Brooke…
Then maybe I'll have to kill her.
Say that to my face again.

One death in life is enough.
Don't talk so lightly about killing others.

It was just a joke.

%username% has changed too.

%username% doesn't seem very useful to me.

Lieutenant Colonel Aaron, think again!

I don't accept other opinions.
This mission will be accomplished no matter what.

Didn't you hear what I said?!

Huh. You doubt documents confirmed by the lords and the leaders?

An instruction of the Lords… So far we have only written and passed on a rough report…

And now it's time.
With the consequent support of the Lords I would like to conquer Dipluce.
Get out of my way when you have nothing more to say. I want to say something, too.
Victor!

Just give the command.

%username%.

Then you'll go…

If I kill the Soul Junk and all the other critters, it might not be so dangerous anymore.

Indeed.

It's me who's risking her life anyway.
Aren't you going to trust me again?
I understand.

Yes… I'll try…
Somehow…

How does it feel to see her with your own eyes?

Simple and simple, the way I like it.

No matter how many Soul Junk you destroy here, there will be more and more, making it even more dangerous.

First, you should see Beneris and Brooke.

What are you gonna do if they don't have answers?

Phew...

That's what I call a deep sigh.

With so many Soul Junk, it's gonna be really hard.

I already knew that there would be a lot of Soul Junk here, but I could never have imagined this.

Now that this Henry and the hated leader of the Soul Junk have appeared, there will hardly be a retreat.

I for one won't leave as long as that son of a bitch is around here somewhere.

I'll tell you what I've been finding out myself since I got here.

You don't sound like there aren't any options.

Unlike the ground, the number of Soul Junk on building rooftops is quite small.

Doesn't sound so bad.
Why didn't you tell Aaron when you had plans like that?

I had hoped Lieutenant Colonel Aaron would perhaps see, without that knowledge, that there was no possibility and order the retreat.

He has the eyes of an animal that is pushed into a corner and sees only one way out.

So, so...

I came here to find a place to fight.

I'll protect people's lives. Don't worry.
You need to focus on making Aaron who he used to be.
Hmm... I think it would be more promising if you tried to persuade him, too.

I was beginning to think you'd say that…

Well, I'll do what I can.

That's the operational will I want to see!
Becoming active is much better than just standing around all the time with your shoulders hanging down.

Shall we go see Lieutenant Colonel Aaron, then?

Orka or lords, you all want to get out of this hell alive, don't you?

On the roofs there is much less Soul Junk than on the ground.

The roofs occupy… Is there not just as many Soul Junk?

Then there might be a chance...

Good work. Thanks to you, securing this area is running smoothly.

If you have food left, give it to those who are hungry.

Ah, I see.
All right. Since we don't have that much food, I'll grant your wish.

But won't you at least take a little break?
Maybe you can pick up a book…

So you want to show me how important my responsibility is…

I see.

At least I have no intention of throwing my life away.
I've changed too.

I trust you.
But please don't forget that there are people who just care about your well-being.
Yes, okay.
So, I've taken care of everything. What's next?

Good work.
Thanks to Brooke, we had to do some unnecessary work, but we still had to meet the deadline.

The construction of the camp is almost finished.

For me, fighting is the same as resting.
So leave it to me.

If I give you any more work to do, I'm sure she'll protest.
True.

This here?

Ah, but don't even think about wanting to see it.
For me, there's nothing more important in the world than this photo. Since you never know what's gonna happen, nobody's allowed to touch it.

Rubbish.
As everyone knows, caution is better than indulgence.
Doesn't that seem a little exaggerated to you?

Like I said, just get some rest.
There's nothing more to talk about.

I can only hope you can keep it.

That's my business.
Don't worry. Go on.

Use the time to rest.
Phew, it can't be that way every time.
Isn't the problem your inability?

Already here? You got time, huh?

I can fight any time I want.

Hahaha, more importantly, how about hearing the story of my exploits?
I think even you, %username%, would find it interesting.
Did you see a strong Soul Junk?

Uprising? No wonder, considering the circumstances.

This danger must be nipped in the bud.

I'm not gonna praise you for that.

That was a short report on my performance.

If you let them live, they'll start even bigger riots.

I thought there wasn't time for people to argue?

Perhaps one should have questioned oneself rather than punished the soldiers?

And there is no relationship between king and subject here. This is about the commander and his chess pieces.
For the goal and survival of mankind, you sometimes have to crack down on riots.

I don't think we'll be able to come to an agreement at all.
These word battles lead nowhere.

Okay, a wise insight!
Morality and rationality are like arch-enemies who can never agree.

%username% only needs to fight.
Lieutenant Colonel Aaron and I will find our own way to lead the soldiers.
Good work! %username%'s achievements lately have been truly brilliant!
You seem in a good mood today!
Indeed! I am so glad that I could eliminate so many Soul Junk!

If I had power too, I could kill Soul Junk directly like %username%...
I hate how powerless I am!
Oh! Did you hear about that? Lieutenant Colonel Aaron has punished the rebels on the spot!

He did the right thing! Rebel who have only their own survival in mind should be brought to justice directly!
I'll see if I can get the bodies!
So you agree that Aaron did the right thing?
Yes, of course.

In Candus City, we were all way too careless. That's also why Catherine died.
This is why this time we have to eliminate everything that could become a danger.

Lieutenant Colonel Aaron knows that and is just doing his best.
He's really great! I admire him very much!
Do you really think it's okay to try to make up for a victim with more and more victims?
In my eyes, I don't see any difference between Soul Junk and you. Some eat everything up, and you're not too lucky to have a victim.

I don't care what you say.
To wipe out the Soul Junk, I am even prepared to become a Soul Junk myself.
You've sunk really deep.

Haru Estia, Erwin Arclight, Lily Bloommerchen, Jin Seipatsu, Stella Unibell, Iris Yuma.

All right.

Weren't we supposed to surprise them?
Why are they attacking us now?

The commander is in a complete rage, too.
Rogen! Answer as soon as you hear this!
Rogen! Rogen!

Now the priority is to save the isolated soldiers.
Can the NED Company support us in this as well?

We are the only ones who know the reasons.
I'm going. I'll leave right away and save more people.
All right. Good luck.

The most important thing is rescuing the survivors.
Revenge comes later.

They're all dead...

What sort of an ambush was that?

Do you really want to go out there?

In this world exists a being with evil intentions.
... Oh, that story again.

Huh? Do you want to hear more of my story?

Everybody... Everybody...
Hey partner...

Commander Toru, we don't have time to get to the bottom of past events.

What can I do?

Emilito was more than family to Jeremy.

Jeremy was never very self-confident.
That changed when he met Emilito.

Since meeting Emilito, Jeremy has visibly changed.
For the better, of course...

Uh oh. Wha... what's that?
Why...?

I didn't mean to cry. I must not...

I'm gonna go back.

...Sniff...

Quick...
Go quickly! You don't want to watch a grown woman cry, do you?

There you are!
Go on, get ready!

We're fighting, aren't we?

Chii, you're leaving anyway, even if we want to stop you, right?

Please conduct a search mission in Area 9.

The very existence of this sinister place in a corner of Grace City makes me angry.
We must destroy this place as quickly as possible.

Poison and Scar have been hiding there the whole time.

Only the NBRF troops are left after the Rapid Flame, which cooperates with the NED Company, has simply disappeared.
I think they're Henry's own mercenaries.

I'm uncomfortable with the thought that Henry might be there.
I'll get going right away.
Isn't there any way to open the locked door?

We know for sure there will be lots of NED Company mercenaries.

The jamming signal is too strong,
so we can't even grasp the forces, let alone scan the inner facility.

I forwarded Sedurin the executive summary for all plans in this operation.
Go and see her.
If you've understood the explanation completely, you can also jump right in.

I have already informed Sedurin about this mission.
Go and see her and she will explain everything else.

I won't say this again, so listen carefully.
I'm reeeaaally tired right now.

Grab this Henry and take revenge on the NED Company!

The mission has been completed successfully.
How do I know that?

Now it's not a secret base any more.
What's the basis for a secret base? Exactly, a home for secret bassists!

Better than just hanging your head.

There must be something in there... something he's hidden from us.
