And as we don't know what kind of creature it is, we should be extra cautious during the investigation.
Yeah, I'll watch it.
So, newbie, it's almost time. Soon we will find Henry.

You don't need to spare them.
Show no mercy.
Okay, got it.

Drat. I wasn't expecting that.
Why am I being followed now?
It wasn't easy to find! But it should gain us some time.
Ranse, Raban.
It is time for battle.

Now the time has come to punish the traitors.
To punish so that they will never forget.

... Normal people?

Rogen was pursuing a higher purpose. He wanted much more strength to better protect humanity.

If you ever bring anything to light, we'll stand up for it and we won't talk our way out of it, Chii.
It's quite normal for people to love their lives.
I know what it feels like to be powerless while a friend is dying.

You're really not hostile to the NED Company.

No, from now on you'll only see the dark side of the NED Company.

Please do not make a decision until the time has come.
Let me show you our true face first... Then you can still make up your mind.

Take this key and step forward.
That is a secret key that leads to a hidden room.

Near SoulWorker...

You did that really well.

... I'll be going then.

If the hardened blood is then touched by another electromagnetic wave, the body petrifies.

Shortly after petrification commences, the human is human no more.
From a purely biological standpoint, there is nothing left to indicate that the body was human.
But that can't be! That would be the end of humankind!

There is a countermeasure, for the time being.
But they didn't expect a problem in such a remote place... there's far too little time to deal with it.

But fortunately, it seems this radio wave spread

According to your partner, fragments of the Temptation Stone

This is probably a kind of process for creating puppets.
It may be that the Temptation Stones animate inanimate objects.

That is to say, the enemy is trying to expand its army of mannequins instead of expanding the range of the radiation.
That's why we have to come up with some way to combat them. That's the objective.

That's all this report says.
I guess I don't need to tell you what kind of work awaits us.
That's so terrible I'd rather not believe it.

Please report this matter to Major Benjamin.
Oh, and one more thing... Warren is pretty tense.

The people are petrified and then become mannequins?

Then everyone living within the city limits will soon...
It's a sickness. A sickness that spreads evil.

I guess you're going to deal with it, right?

Even though the radiation is weak, evil is brewing in Rocco Town.
The more time we waste, the worse it will get.

We can no longer communicate with them and don't know if they're still alive.
G... ghosts! It's definitely ghosts!

Are you aware that your appearance is more frightening than any ghost?

Err... so... I have something to say...

But...

Telling me I have to bring the girl back...

%username%...?

Please... initiate an evacuation! Before the scoundrels turn up here...
Get the residents of Rocco Town to Grace City... argh!
Hey, stay with me! Pull yourself together!

...
Captain Miriam, I give an order.
Yes, sir, Major Benjamin!

no, I request.

Please find the search party that disappeared in the abandoned hospital.

I just can't do this anymore.

Yes, I treasure my life too much.

It was already too late...

Yes, I'm very satisfied.

Now what?

Only those wearing the badges his subordinates carry will be allowed in,

in other words, only you, to a party for two.

you need to get the badges his subordinates carry.

I'll surely bring them back...

Defeat the Blue Flame Clown's subordinates

Yes, I'm going to bring him to justice for amusing himself with people.

Don't let your guard down.

We seem to have put the danger behind us.

We must put an end to this.

I'm concerned about his movements, but all we can do is pray nothing happens.
The high command orders you to immediately...

...? What's wrong, Miriam? That's not like you.

Ru... Rocco Town...

Eric and Sean called in.

Unbelievable...
Can we defuse them?

%username%, it seems to be an invitation for you.

If you don't accept his invitation, he'll blow Rocco Town sky high...

But we have no other choice.

%username%, accept his invitation.

Buy time by engaging the Blue Flame Clown,

we'll defuse all the bombs no matter what.

And if possible...
this time, finish him off for good.

I'm begging you.
Show that crazy clown your real power.

I'll wait for you here.
I'll take care of dismantling the bomb.

Blue Flame Clown...

My stomach hurts...

Aaaaaaah!
I'm sorry.

Tell my daughter...

Now don't talk like that. You can send her something next year!

Before I can't talk any more... my daughter...
Uh, okay! Just say it. What's your daughter called?
Argh!
Wha...what is it? There's wool coming out of his mouth!
Argh... aaah... aah.... aaaargh!

E...everything's going to be fine. I'll get the wool out!
Then... everything will be okay!
Everything's... going to be fine...
I wanted to be a doctor. I wanted to save people...
Why can't I save someone right in front of me?
Is it over?
With this... it really seems to be over.

We have defused all the bombs in Rocco Town.
They were fireworks, not bombs.
So he mocked us to the very end.

Unbelievable! Who'd have thunk it?

The kids here call you a hero.

Enjoy the rare moment of peace and take a little break.
No, we haven't got time for that.

...If that's how you feel, it can't be helped.

Go to Candus City and help them.

Say goodbye properly before you go to Candus City.

The Soul Junk. Keep that in mind.

The worst enemy is the one who's objective is unknown.

Let's meet again, %username%.

Huh!

Even though the radiation is weak, evil is brewing in Rocco Town.
The more time we waste, the worse it will get.
Okay, leave the unpleasant things to me and take care of the people!

Even if we remove the cause of these symptoms, we don't know what will happen.
It could be that electric waves will accumulate in the human body.
So you have to hurry.

Please tell it to Benjamin.
I don't want to rush you, but it is urgent.

I heard you report that the people in Rocco Town have turned to stone?
Does that mean the radiation extends all the way into Rocco Town?

If we do nothing, and just let this happen, Rocco Town will turn into Mannequin City.
Good. Then there's no time to waste.

I've discovered that the radiation appears in specific locations simultaneously.
It's possible that something like a transmitter is there.

The problem is that strange object, but we can't do anything about it in the current situation.
First, suppressing the source of the signal is the top priority.

That's fine, but isn't there any countermeasure?
If I get petrified too, there's nothing we can do.
Let me ask you a question: have you noticed any changes since you were last there?
Hm? No. I'm the same as always.
I knew it. Supernaturals are immune to most illnesses.

A radio wave that petrifies humans sounds like an unknown weapon,
but in principle it's like a disease that gradually alters the cells in the body.
It shouldn't be a major problem for a SoulWorker.

Ryu, who is a Supernatural, has already confirmed this,
so rest assured.
Oh yeah? What's this Ryu doing that I have to run around here all alone?
There he is!
You, with the horn-rimmed glasses! Do you have a name?
He's really annoying.

Ryu is, besides you, the only psychic in Rocco Town with combat ability.
...If both of you are away, we can't respond if the enemy attacks.
Then he should guard the house? That works! Bilbo!
Ryu! But you forgot it again within just a few hours.

So, I'm counting on you.
Save Rocco Town.
A talking mannequin! Almost nothing surprises me any more.

We don't need any investigation for that. It is obvious that the Adv. Soul Junk is controlling the mannequins near the tower.
They talked about the Blue Flame Clown; it is quite clear that they worship him.

From now on, the puppet equipped with a dialogue function
shall be named codename "Jack the King."
And you are ordered to defeat Jack the King.

Frankly, we don't have the means to do anything about this big tower.
Grace City assisted us with a rocket strike but the radiation messed it up.

It's an electronically guided long-range missile.
Because of the radio waves, it can't even reach the vicinity of the object.
Pff, even after 15 years humanity doesn't know what to do...

In the end, what we can do now is annihilate the individual thought to be the puppets' commander
and wait until headquarters finds a way out of this situation.

Go find Miriam before you're deployed for an operation.
Do you have something to say to me?
Oh, Miriam! Now comes the love confession?
I don't think so.
Go see Miriam before you go into battle.

A talking mannequin... and you want to kill it?
Hmm, it's been a long time since we had SoulWorkers, but they're giving you a pretty rough time!
Don't worry, I do it because it's fun!

More importantly, why did big sister Miriam call me?
I'm mentally prepared anytime!

Oh, I just asked you to come because I felt like it.
But there is something I want to tell you.

This time don't risk your life like it doesn't matter.
I could never forgive you.
Pity. Not a confession of love then.

What?! I'd never get an idea like that!
Just the opposite, I don't want a boyfriend. Can't you just give up finally?
I'll give up when you tell me to my face that you don't like me.
Err...
If it's like that then... to say I don't like you would be wrong.
I knew it! You're too nice to break a man's heart.
I'm not too nice. I simply respect your achievements. And that's why I can't say anything bad about you.
Yes! It won't be much longer before I break through your defences!

Ha ha, I wonder about that.
...Better not expect too much.
All right, be off now.
...It came to a rather unpleasant end.
I don't understand what this is all about, but you did your part well.

Jack the King's remains have been confirmed.
And that object seems to have completely lost its function too.
Good grief, to be saved by the Blue Flame Clown.

We have no idea what the Blue Flame Clown's goal is.
Who can understand the Vessi?

Anyway, while you get on with your work, we'll carry on with the investigation.
Because of the Blue Flame Clown, I mean.

We have more or less narrowed down the location of the Blue Flame Clown.
He's in an abandoned hospital.
Wow, he really found himself a suitable spot.

Since there was no confirmation, we dispatched a small reconnaissance squad...
but all signals have gone silent.

Suddenly there was an interfering signal, as if he'd just been waiting for us.
We can no longer communicate with them and don't know if they're still alive.
Oh well, it's almost too obvious. He'll try to use the hostages to lead me into a trap, right?
It's very likely that it's a trap. That's why we need to come to a carefully considered decision.
We can't just go in blind this time.
You're very short-sighted, Commander.
If he's taken hostages to use them as bait, that means they're still alive.
You can't seriously want to go there! What a stupid idea! You won't get out of there alive!

Listen, you have to step into a trap.
Sometimes it's more fun to fall into a hole in the ground than to walk down a flat path.
Fun? Fun? I really don't understand how you make your decisions.
It's almost embarrassing that I rely on it and ask you for help.
Please, SoulWorker, find the missing members of the search party.
Please find the search party that disappeared in the abandoned hospital.
Oh... ahem...
Are you okay? You don't look too good.

S-support soldier... is that so...?
T-that's good.
*cough* *cough*

I feel... the end is nigh.
I can't feel pain anymore...

It's too late for me.
Now... I can't see anything anymore.
You can make it. Don't give up!

Others are still alive.
Please... save them.

They're probably... waiting quietly...
for someone... t-to help them...
P...please... take care... of the... others!
Good, then the second! Are you hurt?

Are... are you the reinforcements?
Uh... thanks.

The local mannequins are hideously cruel.
Seems like they're just toying with us.
They don't seem to be trying to kill us. It's more like they're playing with us, as if we were real mannequins.

I can still hear them sniggering.
Those monsters... don't they care at all for human life?

I'm going to withdraw.
I don't want to spend another second in this place.
I can do that! Don't look about! You should leave!
I still have one question: are there more people here who are isolated?

There's still one person left, I think.
P... Please save them.

Uah... Uaaaah!
I... I've got to get out of here!
I... I don't want to see any more mannequins!
You got through it well! You can leave the rest to me!

Tha...thanks for rescuing me, but...
I just can't do this anymore.

I... give up.
I give up... I'm going to find a job that's got nothing to do with fighting.

Aren't you... afraid?
Even though dolls attack in such a dark place...
Not really. I do it because it's fun.

So the rumours are true. That's madness, at that age...
Anyway... Thank you for saving me! Be careful!
You're back. What was the search party's situation?

It was already too late when I got there. There are many dead, and a lot of the survivors are injured.
I cannot proudly claim that I rescued them.

No, that's not true. Even though there's only a few of them, these are valuable lives.
You did really well.

A letter from the clown arrived while you were away.
He wants to meet you, and he's written down where you should go.
Is this another one of his jokes?
According to the information from the reconnaissance group, there was a magnetic field on the way to the top floor of the abandoned ward.
In the letter, it says that there's a way to pass through to the other side of the magnetic field.

Apparently, his subjects carry a badge. If you wear it, you can get through without a problem.
It says here that there's just one invite.
An invitation to a trap? He's a funny guy.

...I can't understand it.
I don't know what goal he's pursuing.

If there's an interesting show or party there's no reason not to go!
......And I have to pay back for those who died.

Even if you're a SoulWorker, you can't just walk in there alone without any support.
If you bring us proof, we can investigate the whole thing.
I'm not very hopeful, but we if we break through the magnetic field, we can help you.

Defeat the Blue Flame Clown's subordinates
and get the proof.
I'm back, Miriam!

Is this the badge the Blue Flame Clown was talking about?
...Tasteless.

Sunny said if she researches this badge
others may be able to go together too, but...

Frankly, I don't think it's a good idea.
What if they all die, like the search party that we sent before...

So that's why you came to me and not Sunny?
But can you really do it? It's dangerous alone.
Even if I don't go alone, the result is the same if my companions get into trouble.
I told you. Don't be careless with your life.

And I won't do that.
I just think it's enough if I alone risk my life for this.

Wha... So serious?
It's just difficult, because I guess I've really fallen for you...
Oh, really?! I guess you like serious guys!
And, and? This time, if I kill them all and come back, will I get my kiss?

Yeah, I thought it was a bit lovely.
But now that ruined it.
Ah... I guess I'll have to keep playing the part until the very end.

No, I like you best when you're being yourself.
It's wonderful that you're so serious and prepared to save people.
Yes, I like heroes that save people.

A kiss might be a bit much, but...
Yes, after it's all over, maybe I'll hug you as thanks, how about that?
Ohhh, good! I'll come back as soon as I'm done with that idiot clown. Stay right there!
Sure! Good! Then the preparations are complete!

That clown... I have no idea what he wants from us...
But it's clear that he's a threat to Rocco Town.

I'm not sure why he wants to see you.
But you should do what he asks.

You may be alone...
But you should show him what a SoulWorker can do.
Fine, I'll exert myself, so we can fly off on our honeymoon later!
Hahaha, how about if you exert yourself for the future of humanity?

But the opponent is that notorious Blue Flame Clown.
Don't let your guard down.
This is the perfect chance to defeat the Blue Flame Clown!
The guy fled.

He fled! What was he thinking?
It's not as if he had his back to the wall.

Be that as it may, well done.
We seem to have put the danger behind us.
We must put an end to this.

I plan to focus on repairing the damage for a while.
Please take a short rest for now.
You've helped us a great deal.
That makes me so mad.

There's also an order from the Starry Forest League Command...
I'm concerned about his movements, but all we can do is pray nothing happens.
The high command orders you to immediately...

M... Major Benjamin!
Something terrible happened!
...? What's wrong, Miriam? That's not like you.

Ru... Rocco Town...
We discovered several huge bombs in Rocco Town.
What?
Then it's starting all over again!

Eric and Sean called in.
They were at the drilling site and discovered massive bombs...

According to the investigation...
it has been confirmed that bombs have been planted throughout Rocco Town via the sewer pipes.
How dangerous is it?
We can only guess, but they have about double the explosive force of Big Puppet.
With double the amount of explosives, the effect is many times higher...

Unbelievable...
Can we defuse them?

It's possible. But it will take time.
Nobody knows if they're going to just blow up.
And we have a new message the from the Blue Flame Clown.
%username%, it seems to be an invitation for you.

I can already see it.
If you don't accept his invitation, he'll blow Rocco Town sky high...
So he takes the people in the city limits hostage and then comes crawling back...

So it seems. A silver lining, you could say...
The Blue Flame Clown's location has been pinpointed.

He is on the roof of the abandoned hospital.
However, our scans indicate that there are several bombs in there as well.

It's evidently a trap.
But we have no other choice.

...It can't be helped.
%username%, accept his invitation.
I'll take care of him, and you have to take care of the bombs!

We'll try to defuse the bombs in Rocco Town quickly.
And we'll position a helicopter near the roof.

Buy time by engaging the Blue Flame Clown,
and if he shows signs of blowing up the rooftop, escape by helicopter.

And if possible...
this time, finish him off for good.
I'm starting to get fed up with this circus. This time, I'm putting an end to it.

I'm begging you.
Show that crazy clown your real power.

I'll wait for you here.
I'll take care of dismantling the bomb.

...It may be unnecessary advice,
but don't throw your life away needlessly.

Blue Flame Clown...
Let's end it this time.
A...are you okay? You look like you're in pain.
My stomach hurts...
Your stomach? Show me!
Aaaaaaah!
Woah! Sorry... What's that? Mannequin stuffing?
They stuffed it into me...

I'm fine... I'm, fine, I am...
More than that... I... me... for me...
I have a family. A wife and a daughter...
Don't say such things. You're acting like you're about to die.

Thank you... for worrying...
But I... know myself... best...
So... please...

Tell my daughter...
I'm sorry I couldn't buy her a present...
...That's my only regret...
Okay, I understood. I promise I'll tell her. Where is your daughter?
Argh!

Ugh... cotton from my mouth...
Say it quickly before I can't speak! Where's your daughter!
Argh... aaah... aah.... aaaargh!
Hm.
Damn it, I don't like this...
Is it over?
Ahh, I chased him off.
With this... it really seems to be over.

We have defused all the bombs in Rocco Town.
They were fireworks, not bombs.
Well, look at that. He really just wanted to play.

Unbelievable! Who'd have thunk it?
Somehow I don't really get what this is about.

What on earth does the Blue Flame Clown want?
Did he really just want to celebrate? If so, then all of this was just...
No. No, I'd be an idiot if I tried to understand the Vessi.
Can I ask you something?
I'm all ears.
One of the children in the city zone lost his father in the incident.

Many people lost their lives in the incident.
When you say it like that, I don't know who you mean.

Everyone, then.
Please let them know that I'm sorry they won't be able to celebrate their birthdays with their fathers.
I can't do that.
Why not?

I already told the children who lost their parents that they left town.
They're too young to accept such a thing.
Yes...? That's not bad either.
But I'm surprised that you would even think of something like that.
I made a promise, even if I couldn't keep it.

You did a good job today.
Now that the clown is gone, most of Rocco Town's problems can be solved.
%username%, what do you plan to do from now?
Now that the curtain has fallen, I'll have to find a new stage.
Am I doing that? I know a stage that would be right up your alley.

Please head to Candus City without delay.
You can help the Starry Forest League stationed there.

A major encounter with the Soul Junk is underway in Candus City right now.
You will be a gamechanger for them.
All right...

No! That's enough of the gloomy mood!
I'll finish the Soul Junk and Vessi!

I don't understand your self-confidence.
You're not chasing yourself away, are you?
If you find something that you enjoy, then it's a pleasure to do it.

It was fun this time too, but...
...somehow there was a hardship I've never felt before.

I'm not certain, but it's probably the feeling of responsibility you get when you possess great power.
For someone who protects others, it's quite normal. It's important, even. Don't forget it.

It's not easy, since I'm not used to it.
If I think of it as one of the many tests of a leading actor, then it's not so bad...
Yes. So, before you head to Candus, we should say our goodbyes.

I didn't think much of you at first. But you turned out to be an asset.
Go to Candus City and help them.
That's enough, right? That's all that needs to be said.
I hope to see you again sometime, SoulWorker.
The next time we meet, I'll probably be your boss.
Hm, if you really do that well, it wouldn't be such a bad thing.

Say goodbye properly before you go to Candus City.
They're all waiting for you.

Talk to the people.
At least you can say goodbye to them.

I already heard the news.
You want to go to Candus City?

When you're there, you will learn once again why our world is descending into chaos...
The Soul Junk. Keep that in mind.

The worst enemy is the one who's objective is unknown.
Remember that.
Once I'm gone from here, you'll have to take care of the city all by yourself. Can you do it?

That's what I did before too.
You've eliminated our worst problems, so don't worry.
Or did you just want to make fun of me?
No, no. You played a part in building this town, of course you want to help protect it.
Good. I'll do my best. Same as you.

Ever since you woke up it's been one incident after another,
but I'll remember how you never give up.

No matter the time, never forget that firm resolve.
Let's meet again, %username%.
See ya later, four-eyes.
My name is Ryu.
Huh!

There you are!
I've been waiting for you.
You waited for me! What an honour!

I heard you're going to Candus City?
How much more do you want to work?
Oh yeah, do you remember how I reprimanded you when we first met?
Oh, you mean when somebody else died while trying to save me?
I have to withdraw my complaint.
You didn't let their deaths be in vain. I admit it.

Oh! Your words have lifted a great burden from my shoulders!
I've never dared to approach you, Sunny...

I wasn't very nice to you.
I was just... scared. Like the others.

Many who let ability get to their head have died.
I see you and I just can't forget them.

But when you stopped Big Puppet, I knew it.
Then I saw who you really are.
This SoulWorker understands perfectly the weight he carries.

I tell everyone that, but I'm not as great as everyone thinks.
I save people for my own satisfaction.

And that was good enough for me. So please, never forget.
No matter what happens. Never forget that people have died for you.

Yes, of course!
Thank you, Sunny! I hope we can chat in peace and quiet sometime!

Please... go and see Miriam now.
She wants to say goodbye.

Good work.
I'd love to see you again sometime.

Congratulations, you're going to Candus City!
At least, I'd like to congratulate you...

But there you'll be facing even more than here.
Keep that in mind.

Fighting and having fun!
It's not work to me!
Hahaha! Yes, for you this is probably more like an amusement park.
Ah. I just want to tell you something before I go, Miriam.
Yeah? Oh...
Rejected already? I haven't said anything yet and you're laughing?
Just listen first, and then decide how to respond.
Oh, you didn't want to ask me if I'll be your girlfriend?

I've given up on that. Your circumstances seem to be too specific.
If I keep sticking to you like this, I'll just annoy you.
I actually just wanted to say goodbye, but now this has become somewhat embarrassing.
Hahaha! Yes, but not because you don't mean anything to me.
I think I just lack the ability.
Haha, so this is your caring way of rejecting a man?
I hope you don't get the wrong idea.

All right, all right.
Well, I'm not the type to stick to one woman either!

Just you wait! I'll come back with an even prettier woman from another city zone on my arm!
You can stamp your foot in rage as much as you want, it will be too late!
Yes, exactly. I'll regret it my whole life long.
My whole life...

You're in the spotlight, that's for sure.
You've barely woken up and people are already asking for you.

But that shouldn't surprise me.
First an Adv. Soul Junk, then a self-destruct mechanism and mad clowns. You finished them all.

Well, you don't need me to tell you to not get all smug about it.
Question everything, always, and think everything through carefully.

Integrity matters, but you mustn't make yourself its slave.
Your true enemy... hides in your heart.
And that's why Tenebris is also...
Tene...? Oh right! That Tene-thingy, your ex!
He's not my ex! He's just someone I know...
Oh! Say, if you're going to Candus City, can you take a letter for Aaron?

He helped me a lot in the past. There's a lot of private stuff in the letter, so please don't open it.
Okay?

You're changing the subject. But I'm not one who tries to fathom the mysteries of women, so let's leave well enough alone.
Of course, I'll do you a favor on the way!
Super, thanks.

Oh and by the way, the route from Rocco Town to Candus City is – how can I put this – a bit dangerous.
Yes. Very dangerous, actually.

Without a guide, you won't know what to do.
So the one who lives there... hmm, I don't know if I can call it a person. Anyway, a person.

I told this ‘person' about you.
His name is Booker. Funny name, isn't it?

Be sure to say I introduced you, okay?
Then they should be kind to you.
"Booker TV." Got it memorized?

Well then, SoulWorker, %username%.
Thank you for everything you did for Rocco Town.

If you miss Rocco Town, then come back any time.
You're always welcome here.

Ah, good work to you too, Miriam.
Protect this town until I return, okay?
Take care of yourself.
I'll definitely be back, just you wait!
(You bade Miriam farewell and left the street.)
So you're leaving?
Yes, I'm being sent out.

It's a pity though.
All I ever said was thanks and never once apologized.

Yes, we probably relied too much on the title SoulWorker.
When I look at him, he looks like a completely normal boy...

%username% probably didn't refuse because they wanted to help everyone.
...I deeply regret that I only used that child and couldn't do anything for them.

That's really true...
I wonder what happened before that child became a SoulWorker. Shall I look into it?
People's pasts are their private business.
Haha... that's true.

And it's not important what his past was like.
What's important is that he saved Rocco Town.

Therefore, if that child ever suffers, we of the Fortune Corps.
must take the initiative to lend a hand.
So that we can be a reassuring ally to him.

To that end, we have to clear out the Soul Junk and the puppets.
With the SoulWorker gone, it looks like we'll be busier.
But tell me, Miriam. Do you still feel responsible for what happened before?
Whaaat?! What do you want all of a sudden?
I'm sorry, but I couldn't help overhearing what you said to the SoulWorker.
I thought I could forget it... but is isn't that easy.

It's not your fault...
This is all I can say.

Whatever happened, you can't live in the past.
As your superior, I want you to start forgetting it.

Right.
For me, you are, first and foremost, a member of the Fortune Corps..

Chapter One: Awakening
End
Hehe, you're reluctant to leave Rocco Town, aren't you?
Hm? There's someone there.

Oh, could you be...
%username%, perhaps~?

Oh, it's a pleasure.
I'm Booker; I lead the bandits.

Wow... what a manly guy...
my motivation just dropped.
Ahaha! You're as masculine as I heard!

Miriam told me about you.
She said a greenhorn would come and ask me for help.
She was as beautiful as ever, wasn't she~.
I completely agree on that!
Ahaha! Even a Vessi like me cannot deny her beauty!
A Vessi like you? You're a Vessi?

Hey... You don't need to put so much effort into maintaining a poker face.
I am Vessi. I am not human. In fact, I would prefer it if you got a fright.

I am a being from another world and belong to a people you consider your enemy.
But I am a traitor. I have betrayed my own people and am a traitor who is living with humans.
How did you betray them? Did you fall in love with a human or something?
If the reason had been so romantic, I'd have no need to be embarrassed.

Well... I have sold critical information that would displease the Vessi.
It is because of this act that I can stand here with impunity.

Of course, I cannot deny my heritage, but because of it I can get into places you humans cannot.
This place, for instance, has its appeal.

You are in the Bandit Zone. We play by different rules here.
I am trying to make some money here.

The Vacuum has had a huge impact on this area, so rebuilding it is a distant dream.
But the place is so big you have to pass through it if you want to reach the basecamp.

Like I said, it's a bandit zone. You don't get punished for anything here.
Discard your rubbish, spit in the street or pee on a street corner, nobody cares.
It's the same with murder.

Hm? I thought this place was a wasteland, but it's really interesting!
Something could turn up at any moment, but I enjoy snooping around with you!
But joking aside. In all this chaos, there's no way at all of telling what has happened.

In a nutshell: anarchy.
We set up a small safe zone outside the camp to get the place under control.

Only here rules exist, so if you want to eat prison food, try acting tyrannical~.
Well, I doubt you'd do such a thing~.

If you don't know your way around these parts, it can end in a quick death.
That's what guides like me are for.

That should do as an introduction to the Bandit Zone.
Ask Billy over there to show you the way.

I'm busy. I don't have any time to show other people the way.
Today is the day the winner will be announced.
I'm sure you still have a lot to do! Bye.

No, I'm busy keeping an eye on the radio.
Go bother that guy over there.

Heh? Who are you?
Looking for a fight?
I said, are you looking for a fight?! Can't you hear?

I was introduced by that guy over there.
I don't want to talk with men either.

Heh? The boss's guest?
Hey, you should have said so right away. Heh?

My name's Billy.
I'm a first-class problem solver in the Booker's Hand. Remember that.
I forget men's faces quickly, so let's get to the point.
Could you show me the way? The boss said that you can help me!

The boss said you're supposed to ask me the way?
What, can't you see it for yourself? It's not that complicated here.

Do I have to explain every little thing to you?
Or are you here to take me on?
Ahh, I've been asleep for 15 years. There's nothing for it.

...Did you only just wake up?
From the Vacuum?

Ahem! What do you mean?
Do you expect me to apologize now for being rude?
I can see you feel guilty.

But be that as it may. If you follow the path, you'll come to Candus City.
But the path is dangerous. Oh, why do I have to tell you that?

Hey, Billy. Stop shouting.
Is your radio broken?
S...sorry, Boss.

Wha... whatever! Now that I've shown you the way, I have to take care of my own business.
If you want to know anything else, just talk to me.

This is the treasury.
Earlier, some companies wanted to rebuild the area and laid up supplies. You can find a lot of good stuff here.

We Booker bandits gather goods and live from selling them.
We often waste our time too, but usually we're in the black.

If you're interested, you can help us.
You could make a mint if you work hard.
I don't really have much interest in money.

Huh? Billy, what are you doing?
You don't even know them and you're offering to work with them? Are you in love?
N...no, that's rubbish.

Probably because of your shrieking in the beginning.
Tsk... you've got a really soft heart for a mercenary.
B...Boss! Stop talking rubbish!

Heh?
I could have sworn I just heard something very impolite. Or did I imagine that?
Y...you imagined it. All in your imagination.

Uh, whatever. Think about it.
It would not be to your disadvantage.
Please go to Candus City as quickly as possible and help the people there.

You just have to keep heading towards Candus City.
Don't ever let down your guard out there.

Oh, the leader wanted to see you before you leave.
He hates people without manners.
At least introduce yourself to the boss.

Oh, you want to go to Candus City?
In that case, I'm glad we met. I don't know if our paths will ever cross again, but...

But there are other dangers there.
Retreat immediately if anything happens.
A talking mannequin! Almost nothing surprises me any more.

And you are ordered to defeat Jack the King.

Grace City assisted us with a rocket strike but the radiation messed it up.

Well, I never expected you'd be able to help.

I'm not very hopeful, but we don't have a choice.

Go find Miriam before you're deployed for an operation.
Do you have something to say to me?
Go see Miriam before you go into battle.

A talking mannequin... and you want to kill it?
Hmm, it's been a long time since we had SoulWorkers, but they're giving you a pretty rough time!

I have no complaints so don't worry.
Rather than worrying about me, shouldn't you worry
about the intelligence level of that incompetent glasses?

Ha ha... I heard from Major Benjamin,
you seem to dislike him quite a lot...
He just runs around and gets involved in other people's business.
If he only knew he isn't better just because he has more years under his belt.
It's true but it's not because Ryu doesn't like you.

He has his own circumstances...
surely he couldn't bear seeing you fight so savagely.
Huh, I'm not interested in his reasons.
Sometimes it's not bad to at least try to understand your counterpart.

No need to even ask that.
I don't want to talk any more about that person,
so I'm setting out.
Okay, look after yourself!
We lost it to that clown again.
I don't understand what this is all about, but you did your part well.

Jack the King's remains have been confirmed.
And that object seems to have completely lost its function too.
Good grief, to be saved by the Blue Flame Clown.

We have no idea what the Blue Flame Clown's goal is.
Who can understand the Vessi?

Anyway, while you get on with your work, we'll carry on with the investigation.
Because of the Blue Flame Clown, I mean.

Mad Edgar... so careless, it already puts me in a bad mood.
I so wanted to meet him.

The latest incidents all revolved around the Blue Flame Clown.
That's why everyone in Rocco Town started looking for the clown.

Fortunately we have more or less narrowed down the location of the Blue Flame Clown.
He's in an abandoned hospital.

Closed Hospital...
fitting for a creepy clown.

We sent a small reconnaissance group to determine his specific position.
But we lost contact.

Suddenly there was an interfering signal, as if he'd just been waiting for us.
We can no longer communicate with them and don't know if they're still alive.

I'm sorry that I have to say this, but...
It could already be too late. Even so, we can't give up.
Please go to the abandoned hospital and find the vanguard.
Leave it to me.

The more time we lose, the more likely it is that we'll miss the opportune moment.
Please hurry.
Please find the search party that disappeared in the abandoned hospital.
Oh... ahem...
Thank goodness you're still alive.

S-support soldier... is that so...?
T-that's good.
*cough* *cough*

I can't feel pain anymore...

It's too late for me.
Now... I can't see anything anymore.

At least you can still talk and breath.
This is not a joking matter.

Don't worry about me... others are still alive.
Please... save them.

It's safe here, now. Wait here.
I'll send somebody as quickly as possible.

They're probably... waiting quietly...
for someone... t-to help them...
P...please... take care... of the... others!
You held on well. Now you're safe!

Are... are you the reinforcements?
Uh... thanks.

The local mannequins are hideously cruel.
Seems like they're just toying with us.

I can still hear them sniggering.
Those monsters... don't they care at all for human life?

I'm going to withdraw.
I don't want to spend another second in this place.

There's someone injured on the way back.
I can't now. Take them back to the city limits.
Uh, okay! Of course!
And tell me, are there still lots of people in there?

There's still one person left, I think.
P... Please save them.
One... that's not enough.

Uah... Uaaaah!
I... I've got to get out of here!
I... I don't want to see any more mannequins!

Pitiful.
Don't you feel ashamed as an adult?

Tha...thanks for rescuing me, but...
I just can't do this anymore.

I... give up.
I give up... I'm going to find a job that's got nothing to do with fighting.

Well, running away might also be an option for someone like you.
Find a job that suits you.

Only a few survivors could be rescued.
Most of them were already dead.

I see...
It was already too late...

But there was a survivor...
That's enough.

He's just playing games with people.
Now I really want to show that Edgar what's what...

A letter from the clown arrived while you were away.
He wants to meet you, and he's written down where you should go.

A special field has been set up on the road ahead,
so no one but a select few can pass.

Only those wearing the badges his subordinates carry will be allowed in,
so the content is that he's inviting just the SoulWorker...
in other words, only you, to a party for two.

Perfect.
I was going to visit anyway, but to be invited in person.
Unlike your odd appearance, you seem to have minimal courtesy.

Do you really want to accept his invitation?

I'll go alone. Everyone else should take care of the patients.

Defeat the Blue Flame Clown's subordinates
and get the proof.

...I agree with you.

You may be alone...

I like this mission better than all the rest.
Now I can finally take that stupid mask off of him.

But the opponent is that notorious Blue Flame Clown.
Don't let your guard down.

Focus? That's rather unlikely.
I just think it's fun tangling with our enemies.
You should appreciate your life more.
This is the perfect chance to defeat the Blue Flame Clown!

I thought you had some manners,
but it was merely a whim.

Please take a short rest for now.

Is there another place?

Rocco Town's infestation is over for now.

I've never really listened to your orders.

Ru... Rocco Town...

Eric and Sean called in.

More bombs?

Unbelievable...

%username%, it seems to be an invitation for you.

Clingy men are rare...

Better settle it cleanly here.

the Blue Flame Clown's location has been pinpointed.

It's evidently a trap.
But we have no other choice.

shouldn't we look for a way to remove the bombs...

Since he went so far as to prepare a stage,
it would be rude to decline.
Have you gone completely crazy? Or did you not hear that there are bombs on the roof?
Ah, I'm quite familiar with bombs these days.

If I don't accept the invitation, this town might be blown up...
there's that possibility.

...We can't predict what he'll do.
I can't deny that possibility.

I'll leave this matter to you.

We'll try to defuse the bombs in Rocco Town quickly.

Buy time by engaging the Blue Flame Clown,
and if he shows signs of blowing up the rooftop, escape by helicopter.

we'll defuse all the bombs no matter what.

this time, finish him off for good.

I'm begging you.
Show that crazy clown your real power.

I'll wait for you here.
I'll take care of dismantling the bomb.

Blue Flame Clown...
Let's end it this time.

My stomach hurts...
What's that? Mannequin stuffing?
Aaaaaaah!

This is...!
Isn't there some way to save him...

This... phew...

Stop talking. You're just making your injury worse.

So... please...

Tell my daughter...

...That's my only regret...
I said you shouldn't talk!
Argh!

Argh... aaah... aah.... aaaargh!

Is it over?

Mr. Edgar is under the rubble.

Mr. Edgar.

Unbelievable! Who'd have thunk it?
Somehow I don't really get what this is about.

What on earth does the Blue Flame Clown want?

Now you can...

I'll always set off on the next mission right away.
Don't you ever want to rest?

SoulWorkers are much stronger than you think.
We can cope with a lot.

%username%... after making you work so hard until now

I'm more inclined to get stressed when I have nothing to do.

If I don't cut something... tear something apart...
it feels like tears will come...
Everything starts to blur, I get angry...

That's why I'm going to...

Then from now on, in Candus City...

Ryu... You...
... Incompetent four-eyes.

You're so annoying.

you truly have the eyes of a beast.

Why do you fight so much?

I don't know why but when I fight, I know who I am.
Then you really are a wild animal.

What do you mean by that?

Heh... Wait a sec!?

Hahaha.
I knew it. You can look like a normal child...
Argh!
Phew...
What's this about?
Uh...

my stomach may be opened first.

Touching me suddenly is the height of rudeness!?
What is that mouth for?

Of course!
Touching a lady's head will cost you dearly.
Are you mentally prepared...?
Oh, now you've got that wild look again!

could you restrain your anger a little?

...

Good.

I... I had a little sister who always did what I told her.
Meaning, she's no longer with us.
Right, she's no longer here.

in the peaceful world 15 years ago, before the Vacuum... took her own life.

who, as a middle schooler, was considered promising.

so whether he truly only wanted to play a prank or not, I don't know.

if he learned how to throw he wanted to try again...

I understood nothing...
She was a timid child, so she probably couldn't say it.

and as a result I let my little sister die.
I lived my life without understanding my sister, who I raised myself.

I overlapped you with the image of my disciple.
I thought you might misunderstand something at some point too and kill someone with it.

Even though you and that child are different.
Luckily, there was actually a reason for it.

I'm relieved.
I thought you were simply harassing me.

Besides you I'm the only combatant in this town too.
I wouldn't do something like adding to the workload out of careless feelings.

So, what will you do?
You won't worry needlessly any more, will you?
Of course, I still don't know why you love fighting so much.

But... I've also seen you grow through the Rocco Town incident.
...And I've learned you have other faces too.
Please forget that!

I'm still worried...
but not to the extent of imposing private circumstances.
Yeah, that's right.

...If you want to go where you can be more active,
head to Candus City.

Unlike here in the borderlands, the city is under attack by Soul Junk.
You can do an awful lot of good there.

Don't let yourself be consumed by the monster that lives within you.

The people around me worry about me too much.
I'm not as weak as you all think.

Yes, right.
Oh, and before you leave here, at least say goodbye to Sunny and Miriam.

Naturally.

Huh!

I've been waiting for you.

How much more do you want to work?

About what Ryu said... is it because of your determination?
Thank you for your understanding.

I see you and I just can't forget them.

Then I saw who you really are.
This SoulWorker understands perfectly the weight he carries.

It's merely that those with power must protect the weak.

No matter what happens. Never forget that people have died for you.

At least, I'd like to congratulate you...

Gladly.

Well, you don't need me to tell you to not get all smug about it.
Question everything, always, and think everything through carefully.

Integrity matters, but you mustn't make yourself its slave.
The real enemy lies in your heart.

I've just heard many similar nags,
so could you spare me soon?

Then I'll leave it at that.

When you go to Candus City, you will find Lieutenant Colonel Aaron there.

Thanks!
Understood? I know it's strange for you to say it instead of me, but please do so anyway.

Take care of yourself.

...I deeply regret that I only used her and could do nothing for that girl.

Shall we look into what happened

People's pasts are their private business.

...But tell me, you're radiating an unusual power.

And we have a new message the from the Blue Flame Clown.
%username%. You're invited, it says...
I don't want to go to a party that gives no sweets 2 times...

I can already see it.
If you don't accept his invitation, he'll blow Rocco Town sky high...

So it seems. A silver lining, you could say...
The Blue Flame Clown's location has been pinpointed.

He is on the roof of the abandoned hospital.
However, our scans indicate that there are several bombs in there as well.

It's evidently a trap.
And a bad one, at that.

A large quantity of bombs...
...I also think it's a trap targeting %username%.
Yes. Even as a SoulWorker, you shouldn't go running into every trap!

But if we refuse the invitation to the party,
he might set off the bombs right away...
I'll go again...

...You won't get sweets if you go, you know?
Besides, this time it will surely be harder.

It's a shame.
But if I don't go, this city zone won't exist much longer...
Then we won't be able to eat biscuits together any more, right?
I see.

We'll try to defuse the bombs in Rocco Town quickly.
And we'll position a helicopter near the roof.

Buy time by engaging the Blue Flame Clown,
and if he shows signs of blowing up the rooftop, escape by helicopter.

While you're buying time,
we'll defuse all the bombs no matter what.

And if possible...
this time, finish him off for good.
Sure! But this time I really get biscuits!

I'm begging you.
Show that crazy clown your real power.

I'll wait for you here.
I'll take care of dismantling the bomb.

...It may be unnecessary advice,
but don't throw your life away needlessly.

Blue Flame Clown...
Let's end it this time.
A...are you okay?
My stomach hurts...
Your stomach? You've got stomach pain? Should I blow?
Aaaaaaah!
Oh, sorry.
Wool... They stuffed it into me...

I'm fine... I'm, fine, I am...
More than that... I... me... for me...
I have a family. A wife and a daughter...
Sure! Please don't die! You can't die!

Thank you... for worrying...
But I... know myself... best...
So... please...

Tell my daughter...
I'm sorry I couldn't buy her a present...
...That's my only regret...
Argh!

This... cotton is coming out of its mouth...
What should I do with this? Should I just put it back in!?
Argh... aaah... aah.... aaaargh!
Hello? Why aren't you talking any more?
Is it over?
Yes, it's over.
With this... it really seems to be over.

We have defused all the bombs in Rocco Town.
They were fireworks, not bombs.
Seriously... he just wanted to put on a firework display?
To do something like this... I'm too appalled to speak.

What on earth does the Blue Flame Clown want?
Did he really just want to celebrate? If so, then all of this was just...
No. No, I'd be an idiot if I tried to understand the Vessi.

In any case, the immediate threat is gone.
That'll do for now.

Pretty depressing, right?
Should we go and eat something sweet?
No, thanks. I somehow don't feel like eating today.

......I see.
I don't know in detail what you saw, but...
it seems you need rest.
No, I don't have time for that.
%username%... you don't have to push yourself, you know?

...I want to help everyone just a little more.
Please, mister.
I want to help many more people.
I hate seeing people die right in front of my eyes.
Stay here, %username%.
Huh...?

The threat of the Blue Flame Clown is gone,
but Soul Junk remain.
...Stay here and keep protecting the people of Rocco Town.
Would you like that?

Yeah!
If I can still help everyone, I'll stay here forever!
Yes! Then everything will be okay.

If you stay here, the town can regain peace.
And we can help more people.
Then we don't have to watch people being injured and killed any more.

So you don't need to go anywhere...
If you stay here you can live happily...

Hmm, what?
You lie like a rug, you troglodyte.
Why would you say that to me? That can't be!
I wanted to say goodbye, because I owe it to you.

IT SEEMS YOU MUST BE MADE TO FEEL PAIN ONCE...
IT'S FOR YOUR OWN GOOD TO TELL THE TRUTH.
I wasn't lying.

You might think that I've seen plenty of faces, right?
It isn't exactly rocket science to identify a liar by their nose.

Yes, maybe I was wrong.
But I just don't want to see this child unhappy.

I have a child too, you know...
To burden a child even more...
Humans are really short-sighted.

YOU JUDGE OTHERS BY YOUR OWN YARDSTICK AND LOCK THEM INSIDE IT.
DON'T YOU THINK THAT'S RUDE AND SHALLOW?
What's that supposed to mean?

15 YEARS AGO THIS CHILD ALREADY COULD SEE US.
...FOR THAT REASON, SHE WAS PERSECUTED BY HUMANS.

Everything that happened was her mistake. And all the guilt that wasn't hers, she buried beneath her.
She became a mannequin that felt the wrath of mankind.

Indeed...
15 years ago, no one would have thought ghosts truly exist.

THAT'S RIGHT.
THOUGH NOW IT'S NOT UNUSUAL EVEN WHEN WE RAMPAGE.
But somehow, this child has no more memories of the time in which she felt the hate of the world.

LOSING HER MEMORY IS A BIT LONELY,
BUT THANKS TO THAT THIS CHILD HAS BECOME ABLE TO LAUGH AND HAS BECOME FRIENDS WITH HUMANS TOO.

SO... UNTIL THE DAY "THAT CHILD" AWAKENS...
I JUST THOUGHT IT WOULD BE GOOD IF SHE COULD LAUGH WITH MORE HUMANS IN THE BIG WORLD.

...I didn't know there were such circumstances.
Sorry.
But is it so important that she should have to endure so much danger for it?
I don't know why you're so kind to Stella.

Shouldn't you be taking care of your own daughter instead?
Stella isn't your child. Stella is everyone's child.

...Right.
From your standpoint it may be meddling.
I meddled needlessly. Sorry.
Fine, then I'll release the child into the big, wide world.
Thank you for your understanding.

...But when you can no longer take care of this child,
I'll come to take her back anytime.
Absolutely protect her.

HEH, NOT BAD.
IF THAT HAPPENED, I MYSELF COULD NOT FORGIVE IT.
......IN THAT CASE, ADOPT HER OR DO AS YOU PLEASE.
Huh, what?
I'm falling asleep standing up... *yawn*...
%username%, emergency mission.
What? Yes! I'll accept the mission, Commander!

A major encounter with the Soul Junk is underway in Candus City right now.
You will be a gamechanger for them.

You go to Candus City right now
and be useful to even more people!
This is an order. If you disobey, no sweets.
Yes! Understood, Commander!

...But what about Rocco Town?
Will it be okay without me?

We can manage here somehow.
But Candus City is in a dangerous state where every moment counts.
...I want you to go and help many people.
Oh, right! Then we should say our goodbyes!

...I'm not used to farewells.
Good work, %username%.

I didn't think much of you at first. But you turned out to be an asset.
Go to Candus City and help them.

Farewells are... difficult...
I'm more at home with funerals.
Come back to Rocco Town, if you ever have time.
Sure! Look after yourself!

Say goodbye properly before you go to Candus City.
They're all waiting for you.

Talk to the people.
At least you can say goodbye to them.

I already heard the news.
You want to go to Candus City?

When you're there, you will learn once again why our world is descending into chaos...
The Soul Junk. Keep that in mind.

The worst enemy is the one who's objective is unknown.
Remember that.
I won't forget it.

Ever since you woke up it's been one incident after another,
but I'll remember how you never give up.

No matter the time, never forget that firm resolve.
Let's meet again, %username%.
Huh!

There you are!
I've been waiting for you.

Are you going to Candus City?
How much more do you want to work?
...I have to apologize to you.
Even so, the fact remains that someone lost their life for you.
Yeah... That's true.

But you did make sure they didn't give their lives for nothing.
About what Ryu said... is it because of your determination?

I wasn't very nice to you.
I was just... scared. Like the others.

Many who let ability get to their head have died.
I see you and I just can't forget them.

But when you stopped Big Puppet, I knew it.
Then I saw who you really are.
This SoulWorker understands perfectly the weight he carries.

And that was good enough for me. So please, never forget.
No matter what happens. Never forget that people have died for you.
Yes! I'll do my best in future!

Please... go and see Miriam now.
She wants to say goodbye.

Good work.
I'd love to see you again sometime.

Congratulations, you're going to Candus City!
At least, I'd like to congratulate you...

But there you'll be facing even more than here.
Keep that in mind.
But it's all right! Altogether, it was really fun!

You're in the spotlight, that's for sure.
You've barely woken up and people are already asking for you.

But that doesn't surprise me.
First an Adv. Soul Junk, then a self-destruct mechanism and mad clowns. You finished them all.

Well, you don't need me to tell you to not get all smug about it.
Question everything, always, and think everything through carefully.

Integrity matters, but you mustn't make yourself its slave.
The real enemy lies in your heart.

When you go to Candus City, you will find Lieutenant Colonel Aaron there.
Would you give him a message from me?

Tell him, ‘It's because of you that I've come this far'.
Thanks!
Understood? I know it's strange for you to say it instead of me, but please do so anyway.
Sure! Understood! I'll tell you!

Oh and by the way, the route from Rocco Town to Candus City is – how can I put this – a bit dangerous.
Yes. Very dangerous, actually.

Without a guide, you won't know what to do.
So the one who lives there... hmm, I don't know if I can call it a person. Anyway, a person.

I told this ‘person' about you.
His name is Booker. Funny name, isn't it?

Be sure to say I introduced you, okay?
Then they should be kind to you.
"Booker TV." Got it memorized?

Well then, SoulWorker, %username%.
Thank you for everything you did for Rocco Town.

If you miss Rocco Town, then come back any time.
You're always welcome here.
Uh-oh! *salute*
Take care of yourself.
(You bade Miriam farewell and left the street.)
So you're leaving?
Yes, I'm being sent out.

It's a pity though.
All I ever said was thanks and never once apologized.

Yes, we probably relied too much on the title SoulWorker.
When I look at her, it should have been us who protected her...

%username% probably didn't refuse because they wanted to help everyone.
...I deeply regret that I only used that child and couldn't do anything for them.

That's really true...
I wonder what happened before that child became a SoulWorker. Shall I look into it?
People's pasts are their private business.
Haha... that's true.

And it's not important what her past was like.
What's important is that she saved Rocco Town.

Therefore, if that child ever suffers, we of the Fortune Corps.
must take the initiative to lend a hand.
So that we can be a reassuring ally to them.

To that end, we have to clear out the Soul Junk and the puppets.
With the SoulWorker gone, it looks like we'll be busier.

Ah, we have to create a world
where a child like that can grow up in peace.
Right. You still have family, don't you? Then you'll have to work even harder.
Right. It feels like she's my daughter.
It would be nice if we could meet again.
Hehe, she'll come back someday.
And then... we'll give her the blue sky and a house made of biscuits!

...That's a good idea.
For that child's sake, we must try harder.

Chapter One: Awakening
End
Hehe, don't you want to leave Rocco Town? I can understand you.
Hm? There's someone there.

Oh, could you be...
%username%, perhaps~?
Oh! You know my name? How?

I heard from Miriam~.
She said to guide a cute girl properly when she comes~.
I'm famous?! Would lots of people turn up if I gave a concert?
Hahahaha! Yeah, yeah, you're a celebrity! I'm your biggest fan!

Oh, it's a pleasure.
I'm Booker; I lead the bandits.
Hmm? De...les...
Booker, pay attention to your pronunciation, otherwise you might utter dangerous words.
But... something's not right. Everything's telling me that you're not a human.

Hey... You don't need to put so much effort into maintaining a poker face.
I am Vessi. I am not human. In fact, I would prefer it if you got a fright.

I am a being from another world and belong to a people you consider your enemy.
But I am a traitor. I have betrayed my own people and am a traitor who is living with humans.
Betrayed? Did you steal pudding from the fridge or something?
If there was a people who could banish someone for such an offence, I'd be the first to banish the banishers!

Well... I have sold critical information that would displease the Vessi.
It is because of this act that I can stand here with impunity.

Of course, I cannot deny my heritage, but because of it I can get into places you humans cannot.
This place, for instance, has its appeal.

You don't need to be afraid, no need to look at me like that.
I find the whole thing unpleasant.

I mean, with the derelict city and an alien who just stands around, that may be so.
Just stay where you are and everything will be fine. I'm busy.
But it's all right! I like this place! It sounds like fun!

You are in the Bandit Zone. We play by different rules here.
I am trying to make some money here.

The Vacuum has had a huge impact on this area, so rebuilding it is a distant dream.
But the place is so big you have to pass through it if you want to reach the basecamp.

Like I said, it's a bandit zone. You don't get punished for anything here.
Discard your rubbish, spit in the street or pee on a street corner, nobody cares.
It's the same with murder.
Oh! So I can give a concert?
You've got guts. That's starting to grow on me.

In a nutshell: anarchy.
We set up a small safe zone outside the camp to get the place under control.

It's the only place where the law applies, so behave like an idiot if you want to go to prison.
Although you don't really look like one.

If you don't know your way around these parts, it can end in a quick death.
That's what guides like me are for.

That should do as an introduction to the Bandit Zone.
Ask Billy over there to show you the way.

I'm busy. I don't have any time to show other people the way.
Today is the day the winner will be announced.
I'm sure you still have a lot to do! Bye.

No, I'm busy keeping an eye on the radio.
Go bother that guy over there.

Heh? Who are you?
Looking for a fight?
I said, are you looking for a fight?! Can't you hear?
Th...the man there told me that I should go.

Heh? The boss's guest?
Hey, you should have said so right away. Heh?

My name's Billy.
I'm a first-class problem solver in the Booker's Hand. Remember that.
H... hey! Could you show me the way to the other city zone?

The boss said you're supposed to ask me the way?
What, can't you see it for yourself? It's not that complicated here.

Do I have to explain every little thing to you?
Or are you here to take me on?
Um... I hardly know anything because I've just woken up recently.

...Did you only just wake up?
From the Vacuum?

Ahem! What do you mean?
Do you expect me to apologize now for being rude?
Phew...

But be that as it may. If you follow the path, you'll come to Candus City.
But the path is dangerous. Oh, why do I have to tell you that?

Hey, Billy. Stop shouting.
Is your radio broken?
S...sorry, Boss.

Wha... whatever! Now that I've shown you the way, I have to take care of my own business.
If you want to know anything else, just talk to me.

This is the treasury.
Earlier, some companies wanted to rebuild the area and laid up supplies. You can find a lot of good stuff here.

We Booker bandits gather goods and live from selling them.
We often waste our time too, but usually we're in the black.

If you're interested, you can help us.
You could make a mint if you work hard.
It's okay, that really doesn't interest me.

Hm? Billy, what's up with you?
You don't even know them and you want to work with them? Are you in love?
N...no, that's rubbish.

Probably because of your shrieking in the beginning.
For a mercenary, you've got a really soft heart.
B...Boss! Stop talking rubbish!

Heh?
I could have sworn I just heard something very impolite. Or did I imagine that?
Y...you imagined it. All in your imagination.

A-anyway, think carefully about what I said, hey.
I don't think it's a bad deal.
Please go to Candus City as quickly as possible and help the people there.

You just have to keep heading towards Candus City.
Don't ever let down your guard out there.

Oh, the leader wanted to see you before you leave.
He hates people without manners.
At least introduce yourself to the boss.

Oh, you want to go to Candus City?
In that case, I'm glad we met. I don't know if our paths will ever cross again, but...

...as someone more experienced in life, I can tell you that you are surely unlucky.
I've no idea what you did, but it's hard to overlook your appearance.

Watch out for yourself, and always be on your guard.
You'll trip up, just when you think you've accomplished something.

All right, take care.
I've got to go.

Hello, it's %username%!
The mister told me to come here!

Is it you? The Supernatural that Benjamin mentioned?
Oh no, SoulWorker.

Pleased to meet you.
I'm Aaron and I'm responsible for the SFL in Candus City.

I've been briefed about you, but didn't know you were still so young...
Even if you are a SoulWorker, it's terrible that Rocco took advantage of a kid!

I'm not being taken advantage of! I really wanted to help!
So don't worry. You can trust me with every mission!

I'll decide that.
Didn't you have a mission from Miriam?
Oh, right! Here!

Ah! So that's how it is.
Well done, brave child. I'll let Miriam know that you completed the mission.
Sure! All right.

You must be exhausted after such a long journey.
There's nothing to do here right now. Get some rest.
Hm? But Miriam said it was very dangerous here...

We're being threatened by Soul Junk here. But we don't have to rely on the strength of a small child just yet.
So don't worry too much.
Lies!

Everyone says that people are suffering here.
They're dying!
That can't be easy for you either, right? It must be very, very difficult, right?
You mean with all the ghosts from this report?

Listen, the problem of Candus City is something adults will handle.
So you rest without worrying about anything.

But I came here to help those who were suffering!
So...
Don't be so stubborn, listen to the grown-ups!
Boohoo...
I'm sorry I yelled at you, but please try to understand.

Even if you're a SoulWorker...
I can't send a kid like you into battle like Rocco did.

First, go and make friends with residents of the city zone.
Brooke will be... particularly helpful to you.
There's no time for that now!
You should leave the adult jobs to the adults.
Leave the adult jobs to the adults.

He... What's that? Why isn't he coming?
I was looking forward to taking a look at him...

Hello~
Do you know who a person called Brooke is?

Hm? I'm Brooke. What do you want?
This is no place for little kids. Go play somewhere else. Got it?

Wait. Why do you seem so familiar?
Oho. Aren't you the SoulWorker from Rocco Town they're all calling a hero?

Oh! Have I become so famous?
Wonder if I'd fill a hall if I gave a concert... I'd like to give it a try!

I heard you came for combat support from Rocco Town...
but you don't seem to intend to fight.

And you're a lot scrawnier than in the documentation.
Are you really a SoulWorker?
All right. The people have confirmed it!

A SoulWorker at this age...
but there are psychics of the same age too.

Oh, please excuse me.
I'm Brooke and I'm responsible for the Special Missions Squad in Candus City. You'd better memorise that as quickly as possible.

Let's see... 15 years in the Vacuum? Wow, that's a long time.
And? What's it like seeing this town after 15 years?
Like seeing a children's room that someone threw a mad tantrum in.

Incredible, huh?
Anyway, to business.

I don't know if Aaron told you, but Candus City is facing imminent destruction.
Oh. In truth, it's basically over.

Our supplies dried up long ago, and the place is crawling with Soul Junk.
Most people have fled. Those remaining are trapped. The city is surrounded on all sides.
Did he lie to me?
Mister? Oh, the Lieutenant Colonel.

Aaron has a daughter who was recently rescued from the Vacuum.
When he sees you, he must think of his daughter. He probably protects you because of that.

But I'm here to help others!
So please be open with me! I'll take care of everything!
Right. ...Then I'll briefly explain the current situation.
I mentioned earlier that we aren't receiving supplies anymore.

The reason supplies to Candus City were cut off
is that the coastal road leading here has been blocked.

Even though it's the only road connecting to Grace City, it's swarming with Soul Junk,
so even reconnaissance, let alone resupply, is difficult.

Meaning, the supply route is blocked.
Probably you know by now that we lack the strength to fight the Soul Junk alone.

Got the gist? If someone could rush to the coastal road
and quickly defeat the Soul Junk occupying it, that would help a lot.
I like running. I'll go right away!
It won't be easy. We can't send any troops out with this many enemies.
No reason for concern. I've fought a lot!

Anyway, I understand you want to fight.
Here's a map with the supply route. You have to go that way.
Sure! Thanks, Brooke!
Oh yeah, and could you talk to Victor before you go?

He's been waiting desperately for you since he heard that a SoulWorker was on the way here.
Stop and say hello, okay?

Go on, go and see Victor now.
He'll be happy to shake your hand.
Hello! I'm Stella!

I've been waiting. You're %username%, right?
Nice to meet you. I'm Victor.

I research Soul Junk in Candus City.
I'm nominally affiliated with the Starry Forest League... but I'm not an official member.
A semi-member... you could say?
Honorary member? That must be cool! Are you that honourable?
Um, it's not different, but... it's not really a good meaning.

Why not an ordinary member?
Did she fail the test or something?
That's right, I wasn't especially good during the test.

I see! Then I'll teach you music!
I'm good at music~.
Uh, I'm a scientist. I don't need music.
Hm? What a shame... I can't do anything else.
Hahaha... I'll just keep learning diligently. You don't have to worry about me.
Sure! Everyone says you have to study hard! So why don't you go and do the same!

Anyway, it's an honour to meet the hero from Rocco Town in person.
You can't imagine how much Sunny talked about you. She said she'd never seen anybody like you.

Oh... I just realised she never said if she meant that in a good way or bad.
Probably in a good way. Haha.
It will have been meant positively, but I still worked hard to help people!
That's right, I've already heard a lot about your deeds.

I just wanted to say hi.
And I wanted to thank you from the bottom of my heart for volunteering to help in Candus City.

If you can find the time, would you speak to Catherine for me, Lieutenant Colonel Aaron's daughter?
She's been looking forward to your arrival even more than me.

Also, if you want to learn more about the Soul Junk, you're welcome to come to me.
I'll tell you everything I know.

Wait... Should I just tell you now? Haha. All right.
Normally the Soul Junk originate in the Vacuum.

Of course the environment inside the Vacuum is different from here, but we don't know how gravity acts,
or what components are in the atmosphere.
But if we solve this with a formula...
I don't know what you're talking about.

......that's the result we got.
If we plug in a formula using the Vacuum's laws of gravity here...
I... have to go.

Huh? Where are you going? I haven't finished explaining yet.
I've explained about 10% so far, so if you listen a bit more,
you can become a fine Soul Junk doctor too.
Hahaha... bye!

Oooh! There you are! You're the SoulWorker who saved Rocco Town, right?
Woooow! And I get to meet a SoulWorker in person!

Is that the weapon you use to unleash your ability? Amazing!
Can I touch it? What?

Yeah! If you do it like this it makes sound!
Let's try together!

Wow! Thanks!
Eh? But it's not making a sound.
Hm? It works when I play it...
Hmph! Hmph!
Oh.

S-sorry for meeting you like this the first time!
I'm Catherine!
I'm the daughter of that man over there with the mustache.

I know I'm small and frail, but I am actually a Supernatural!
I'm still not strong enough yet, but one day I'll be part of the SFL's most important unit!

And the two of us will go to the front lines together and become stars of the League!
The name is... "Two-Top Stars"!
Mmm, doesn't just imagining it make your heart race?

Yeah! Catherine wants to do a concert too?
What can you do? Can you hit drums...?
What? Huh! I'd like to sing!
So you sing.
Of course! Shall I sing you something?
Yes! Sing me something! Sing me something!
Catherine, leave our guest alone now.
Okaaay...

It was lovely meeting you.
I'd like to stay and chat some more, but my dad is already giving me ‘The Look'.
I was expecting it, but it really took a long time.
Did you lie to me, old man?
A lie? I don't know what you're talking about.

I heard from the big sister called Brooke!
There are lots of enemies and it's hard!
This kid... I told her to leave it alone but I guess I should have spared myself the effort.

Don't worry. Adults can do whatever they want.
Yes, you only have to prepare yourself just in case.
But people will die if I don't help!

I'll do everything I can to avoid that happening.
It won't make it easier if you put yourself in the same danger!

Listen, you must not sortie.
This is an order.

Hmph! I already know the way.
I'll go and do it myself. You can watch!
I'm begging you!! Listen to the grown-ups!
Nope, why? I'll be going then!
...Honestly, what do you plan to do if something happens.
Do you really not want to stop the kid?
How do you think you can stop a SoulWorker, who isn't even a proper human being?
Hm.
You're just as stubborn as someone else I know.

When Benjamin told me about it, I scarcely wanted to believe it.
Who would have thought it was really true?

That you were able to deal with the Soul Junk on the coast road all by yourself!
What we've been doing all this time seems almost silly to me.
Didn't I tell you? I can do it by myself!

But there's still the risk of death.
Please be more careful next time.
Oh no, more moaning.

Now we can officially request supplies from Grace City.
Since you handled that mission shortly after you got here, there's nothing else for you to do.

Why not have a rest and go see Victor?
He came looking for you when you were out on the coastal road.

I don't know what it's about.
Let me know if he wants to impose something unacceptable on you. Then I'll go dress him down.
Sure! But I won't come back to you! I'll just do what I think it right.
What an exhausting child.
Go and see Victor. He's been looking for you since you were on the coast road.

There you are. I've heard much about your accomplishments.
You definitely earned the name ‘Hero of Rocco Town'. I'm impressed. Haha.
Why are you looking for me? Do you want to give me some work?

Hmm, I was thinking about it, but I thought it might be impossible.
So it's fine now.
Impossible? She isn't... Am I supposed to play catch with my eyes closed?

Ha ha... that seems hard too.
But what I wanted to ask was to capture Soul Junk alive.
Catch one? You want to keep it as a pet?

A pet? ...Hmm, certainly may not be bad.
If they could be tamed for household use...

...Well, still it's difficult.
To capture them, we need a material that can contain them.
But as you know, their slime fuses with their surroundings.

That's exactly why I realised it was impossible and gave up.
Thank you for the idea anyway.

Jeremy?

They carried out inhumane experiments on people.

Vacuum Vein... which is what Soul Junk are made of.

We set our sights on the infinite possibilities of such a universal substance.

Every attempt without Vacuum Vein failed.
Normal people were unable to handle the amounts of energy that SoulWorkers handled.

A balloon might be the most appropriate metaphor.
If you blow up a balloon too much...

That's what was used on the Junk Knight, isn't it.

and fused the Vacuum Vein with it.

That way, it was possible to store the ability in Vacuum Vein.

However, Vacuum Vein and ability cannot coexist.
Like the doctor just said.
Exactly. You're right.

A miracle?

You're not seriously saying...

How many people did you kill doing that, you idiots?

SoulWorkers and Supernaturals can manifest the power of emotions as a force.

You're insane!

If it weren't for Abel, Enoch, Noah... and Raban,

Are you filled with hate? Are you going to kill me?

...Even I am not in a position to condemn anybody.
This madness... 15 years ago it might have made a murderer.

I'm fortunate because I follow only my desire. I'm no different from you really.
In the end, you're just unfortunate.

Have you had any ideas how you're going to take responsibility and atone for the sins of your past?
No doubt you remember me saying that I would take responsibility and not let anybody come to any harm?
Oh! Is there any way to do that? Say it quickly!

Jayoon and I ran the main project that developed the Near SoulWorkers.

Where they are going and what they have planned.

But I wanted to watch over what those children do.
Where they go, what they do...

...The time has come to end this once and for all.
Wait a moment.

Like... like another girl I know...
Sion is still asleep... so those children are innocent.

not the children who understand nothing.

but it would be too pitiful to kill them here and now.
My goodness...

So wouldn't it be fine to wait a little longer?
Thanks...

Uh... Martin!

Martin!

Inside the Ark Ship?

Aah, you've sentenced him to death because of your feelings?

Dr Hicks merely wants to evade his own responsibility.

Hot chocolate tastes really good!

I... can't be saved anymore.
M-my vision is getting dark...

But others are still alive.
Please save them!

They're probably... waiting quietly...
for someone... t-to help them...

Seriously! Don't talk like you're dying!
Stay awake! I'll send someone later! Understood?
P...please... take care... of the... others!

Are... are you the reinforcements?
Uh... thanks.
Are you hurt?
I'm unhurt, but it was a close shave.

I can still hear them sniggering.
Those monsters! Don't they care at all for human life?

I'm going to withdraw.
I don't want to spend another second in this place.

There's still one person left, I think.
P... Please save them.

Uah... Uaaaah!
I... I've got to get out of here!
I... I don't want to see any more mannequins!
Don't worry, you're safe now!

Tha...thanks for rescuing me, but...
I just can't do this anymore.

I'm too old for this.
I give up... I'm going to find a job that's got nothing to do with war.
Do what you want. Nobody is going to stop you.
How does it look? Is the search party safe?
It was a veritable bloodbath. Only a small part of them survived.
Really?

But if it hadn't been for you, Iris, no one would have survived.
We are very grateful to you.
Haha. I was afraid you would be angry, because I was hardly able to save anyone.
I wouldn't say something like that.

Many people are suffering,
and feeling indignant at being unable to do anything as a doctor is one thing, but still.

A letter from the clown arrived while you were away.
He wants to meet you, and he's written down where you should go.
That guy's always playing games!
