A special field has been set up on the road ahead,
so no one but a select few can pass.

Only those wearing the badges his subordinates carry will be allowed in,
so the content is that he's inviting just the SoulWorker...
in other words, only you, to a party for two.

In other words, to meet the Blue Flame Clown,
you need to get the badges his subordinates carry.

However you look at it, it's a trap to lure you alone, you know?
...Do you really intend to accept this invitation?

Bring it on.
It may be a trap, but that guy's there, right.

Those mannequins... And the Clown... He's destroying the innocence of little kids and playing with people's lives.
I'd like to face him directly, grab hold of him and beat him to a pulp.

Counting on you.
Please, don't let any more victims increase.
Please prove to me that the people we lost rescuing you didn't die in vain.

Defeat the Blue Flame Clown's subordinates
and get the proof.

Is this the badge the Blue Flame Clown was talking about?
...Tasteless.
Be that as it may. That concludes the provisions for meeting with that clown.

I don't know the purpose...
But it's certain they're a threat to humans.

Somehow he seemed very interested in you...
Go ahead and fully live up to that expectation.
That really ruins my mood. I don't want to be doing this for longer than I have to. I'll hurry!

As long as the enemy is the Blue Flame Clown, you have to focus. He likes to play with people.
Don't try to understand him with healthy common sense. Okay?
This is the perfect chance to defeat the Blue Flame Clown!
Damn scoundrel just runs off like a coward.

...To think he'd run.
I can't imagine what he's thinking.
He didn't look cornered, but...

Be that as it may, well done.
We seem to have put the danger behind us.

The moment the Blue Flame Clown disappeared,
the attacks by Soul Junk and Vessi stopped too.
So everything was apparently being driven by the Blue Flame Clown.
We must put an end to this.

There's also an order from the Starry Forest League Command...
I'm concerned about his movements, but all we can do is pray nothing happens.
The high command orders you to immediately...

M...Major Benjamin!
Something terrible happened!

What is it, Miriam?
It's not at all like you to be so agitated.

R-Rocco Town...
A large number of bombs have been confirmed in Rocco Town!
What?
Aha... Bombs again?

Eric and Sean called in.
They were at the drilling site and discovered massive bombs!

According to the investigation...
it has been confirmed that bombs have been planted throughout Rocco Town via the sewer pipes.
How dangerous is it?
We can only guess, but they have about double the explosive force of Big Puppet.

Unbelievable!
Can we defuse them?

It's possible. But it will take time.
Nobody knows if they're going to just blow up.
And we've received a new message from the Blue Flame Clown.
%username%, it seems to be an invitation for you.
I understand, I understand. I expected as much.

I can already see it.
If you don't accept his invitation, he'll blow Rocco Town sky high!

So it seems. A silver lining, you could say...
The Blue Flame Clown's location has been pinpointed.

He is on the roof of the abandoned hospital.
However, our scans indicate that there are several bombs in there as well.

It's evidently a trap.
But we have no other choice.

There's nothing for it.
Iris, please accept his invitation.
Yes, this invitation... I don't like dancing to his tune, so I'm going to take care of him once and for all. I'll be right back.

Don't push yourself too much.
Driving him off is enough.

We'll try to defuse the bombs in Rocco Town quickly.
And we'll position a helicopter near the roof.

Buy time by engaging the Blue Flame Clown,
and if he shows signs of blowing up the rooftop, escape by helicopter.

While you're buying time,
we'll defuse all the bombs no matter what.

And if possible...
this time, finish him off for good.

I'm counting on you.
Show that foolish clown who treats human life lightly what you can do.

I'll wait for you here.
I'll take care of dismantling the bomb.

Blue Flame Clown...
Let's end it this time.
J...just a second. Are you okay? I'm here to rescue you! Stay awake!
My stomach hurts...
Wha...what's wrong with your stomach? Is there a problem?

I'm fine... I'm, fine, I am...
More than that... I... me... for me...
I have a family. A wife and a daughter...
Stop it! You're not dead yet. You can make it!

Thank you... for worrying...
But I... know myself... best...
So... please...

Tell my daughter...
I'm sorry I couldn't buy her a present...
...That's my only regret...
Well really! How many times do I have to tell you that you don't have to make a will!
Thank you for your kind words. But I know it. I can barely breathe...
Before I can't talk any more... my daughter...
Uh, okay! What is it?! Tell me!
Argh!
Wha...what is that?! There's cotton coming out of his mouth!
Argh... aaah... aah.... aaaargh!
W...wait a minute! I'll remove the cotton! Open your mouth a bit wider!
Everything's... going to be fine...
......Good night.
... I will avenge you.
Is it over?
With this... it really seems to be over.

We've defused all the bombs in Rocco Town.
But they were fireworks, not bombs.
From start to finish, he just wanted to make fun of us.

Unbelievable! Who'd have thought it?
Somehow I don't really get what this is about.

What on earth does the Blue Flame Clown want?
Did he really just want to celebrate? I don't think he had a goal. He just wanted to have fun.
No. No, I'd be an idiot if I tried to understand the Vessi.

I never would have thought he'd be so foolish.
As you said, we mustn't think in human terms.

You did your best.
You saved many people and this Rocco Town.

Now the Blue Flame Clown has disappeared and the mannequin army has been beaten, too. The villagers are all very grateful to you.
But do you really have to be so down?
Enjoy the rare moment of peace and take a little break.
Peace or not. Just because you say I should rest doesn't mean that I can.
I just can't forget that sight. Drat.

Do you hate feeling helpless?
... You're like any man...
Understood. ......Head to Candus City.

A major encounter with the Soul Junk is underway in Candus City right now.
You will be a gamechanger for them.
What about the clown? Isn't there any information that he's turned up again somewhere?
If there are any tips that can be used to deal with his offspring...

I've made good use of your abilities so far, so it's a bit funny when I say this, but...
First and foremost, you're a normal girl, not a SoulWorker.

A SoulWorker won't feel fatigue in the body.
But a fatigued mind is easily hurt.

That's why you shouldn't always let yourself be controlled by your feelings. Sometimes you need to suppress your rage.
If you recover your composure, you'll be able to see clearly again.
Yes, I understand!

Iris Yuma, you made fools of those we were terrified of and saved a lot of people.
Go to Candus City and help them.

Even if I go now, I'll come back one day and I'll be even stronger.
Contact me if he turns up again.

Our reunion shouldn't be connected with violence.
Once the world is peaceful again, we'll meet again in this beautiful place, okay?

Oh well. Be that as it may. Say goodbye properly before you go to Candus City.
They're all waiting for you.

Talk to the people.
At least you can say goodbye to them.

I already heard the news.
You want to go to Candus City?

When you're there, you will learn once again why our world is descending into chaos...
The Soul Junk. Keep that in mind.
There's nothing scarier than an enemy whose goal is unknown. Don't forget.

I don't care much for other people's advice, but I'll bear it in mind.
Thanks for everything you have done for me. Thanks.

It's been a series of incidents since you awoke,
but I'll remember that determined figure of yours.

Never lose your determination.
I hope we see each other again occasionally.
Yes, we will meet again.
Huh!

There you are!
I've been waiting for you.

I don't have a smart answer today, honest.
You can tell me off as much as you like. Tell me I'm an idiot who let the enemy get away...
Did I really make such a bad impression on you?

I wasn't going to do that at all.
As it is, I regret what I said to you then.

Really... I'm sorry.
You saved so many people.
No, you saved Rocco Town itself.

I realise that didn't make me very popular with you.
I hope we can clear up these misunderstandings one by one.
That won't be easy. Is that okay for you?
Are there really that many?

I was only joking!
Anyway, I feel a lot better now that we've talked, Sunny.

I wasn't very nice to you.
I was just... scared. Like the others.

Many who let ability get to their head have died.
I see you and I just can't forget them.

But when I saw that you saved the city zone several times, I knew it.
I realised that I was worrying for nothing...

If you understand that, it's all good.
There are any number of people who don't know what they did wrong until life smacks them awake!
I really wasn't very nice to you... thanks for helping us.

Please... go and see Miriam now.
She wants to say goodbye.

Okay... take care!
I hope we can talk about something other than life and death next time we meet.

Congratulations, you're going to Candus City!
Well, actually that means even more work for you.

It will be a lot more dangerous there than it is here in Rocco Town.
So be prepared when you go there.

I've decided to go now.
We never did get to hear about Miriam's boyfriend.
He's not my ex!

Ha ha... I'd been trying to forget that person, but...
a SoulWorker like him appeared and it felt like I met him again...

So I ended up telling you unnecessary things too.
I was overlapping his figure onto you... sorry.

To me...?
Hmm, so you mean you fell for me too?

Eh...? Ah, no, that's not it...
Hmm... that's enough of this story, okay?

Hm. When you go to Candus City, you'll find Lieutenant Colonel Aaron there.
Would you give him a message from me?

Oh, right. While you're at it, could you take this notebook?
Just hand it over.

You changed the subject...
I'll deliver the letter! You can count on me!

Oh and by the way, the route from Rocco Town to Candus City is – how can I put this – a bit dangerous.
Yes. Very dangerous, actually.

Without a guide, you won't know what to do.
So the one who lives there... hmm, I don't know if I can call it a person. Anyway, a person.

I told this ‘person' about you.
His name is Booker. Funny name, isn't it?

Be sure to say I introduced you, okay?
Then they should be kind to you.
"Booker TV." Got it memorized?

Well then, %username%!
Rocco Town owes you so much.

If you miss Rocco Town, then come back any time.
You're always welcome here.
I find such a stiff reception very unpleasant, so just welcome me with a smile.

You're the hero of Rocco Town after all.
Surely you'll become an even greater hero from now on...
If you're going to get used to being treated like a hero, now's the time.
Take care of yourself.
I can do that! See you next time.
So you're leaving?
Yes, I'm being sent out.

It's a pity though.
All I ever said was thanks and never once apologized.

Yes, we probably relied too much on the title ‘SoulWorker'.
When I look at her, she looks like a completely normal girl.

She didn't refuse, saying it's what she wanted to do...
...I deeply regret now that I used her as much as I could and did nothing for her.

That's true... it seemed she enjoyed fighting...
Shall I look into what happened
before that girl became a SoulWorker...?
People's pasts are their private business.
Haha... That's true.

What's important is that he saved Rocco Town.

Therefore, if that child ever suffers, we of the Fortune Corps.
must take the initiative to lend a hand.
So that we can be a reassuring ally to them.

To that end, we have to clear out the Soul Junk and the puppets.
With the SoulWorker gone, it looks like we'll be busier.
Change of subject – You have to forget the guy finally!
Not that the investigation committee drops another load on us.
Oh yeah?
So in just the blink of an eye, he goes from celebrated hero to despised traitor?

He chose his own road.
We couldn't stop him, but the blame doesn't fall on us.
Let's forget it now.
Because a SoulWorker has appeared after a very long time.
Right, the past is the past. Now we must help her even a little.
All right.

End

Oh, could you be...
%username%, perhaps~?

News spreads in no time~.

Hmm? Somehow you look different...

Like with us humans.
There will always be differing opinions among thinking beings.

This place, for instance, has its appeal.

I find the whole thing unpleasant.

I mean, with the derelict city and an alien who just stands around, that may be so.

I'm not afraid.
It's not the first time I've seen a Vessi.

You've fought Vessi?
Hm, not bad. That you've already been into battle at your age...

I am trying to make some money here.

The Vacuum has had a huge impact on this area, so rebuilding it is a distant dream.
But the place is so big you have to pass through it if you want to reach the camp.

Like I said, it's a bandit zone. You don't get punished for anything here.
Discard your rubbish, spit in the street or pee on a street corner, nobody cares.
It's the same with murder.
Even murder? Are all the people here outlaws?

Outlaws... don't glamorise it. Here only chaos reigns.

It's the only place where the law applies, so if you want to go to prison just behave like an idiot.

That's what guides like me are for.

Ask Billy over there to show you the way.

I'm busy. I don't have any time to show other people the way.
Today is the day the winner will be announced.
I'm sure you still have a lot to do! Bye.

Go bother that guy over there.

Heh? Who are you?
Looking for a fight?

Tch... there's no way I can beat any Starry Forest psychic!!

Candus City is straight down this road.

Are you so naive that I have to explain every little thing like that!?
Or are you picking a fight, huh!?
Do I have to slap you?
Boohoo...! I get it! I got it.

If you follow this path, you'll come straight to Candus City.

Is your radio broken?
S...sorry, Boss.

If you want to know anything else, just talk to me.

We Booker bandits gather goods and live from selling them.

You could make a mint if you work hard.
I'm not really interested in money.

Huh? Billy, what are you doing?

N...no, that's rubbish.

B...boss! Stop talking rubbish!

Heh?

Y...you imagined it. All in your imagination.

Please go to Candus City as quickly as possible and help the people there.

At least introduce yourself to the boss.

As I told you before, here taking lives is an everyday occurrence~.
But, right in front of town is safe.

Use the helicopter if you want to reach Candus City safely.

There's no reason for me to run and hide. I'll walk.

Oh, you fearless one~.
Me, I don't know what happens no matter what, so please go ahead as you like~!
Hello! I'm Iris from Rocco Town.

Is it you? The Supernatural that Benjamin mentioned?
Oh no, SoulWorker.

Pleased to meet you.
I'm Aaron and I'm responsible for the SFL in Candus City.

I heard you awoke only recently, and already people are calling you the hero of Rocco Town.
Benjamin recommended you, so I guess you can be trusted.

Hero is an exaggeration.
I haven't done anything much.

Haha. You took care of the Blue Flame Clown and Cain in Rocco. And you still say something like that!
I look forward to seeing what you'll do here in Candus.

But... oh, right.
I was asked to deliver a letter from Miriam.
Miriam, huh. Actually, I once worked with her in the past...

Thank you for bringing this to me.

...I'd like to say that, but we don't have much room to spare.
Sorry to ask right away, but can you lend a hand?
That's why I'm here! What's this about?

and has practically fallen into isolation.

There is only one route still open, between Rocco Town and Candus City.
That means it's difficult to communicate with them or send supplies.

It wasn't manageable with just the troops in Candus City.
We contacted Rocco Town and found out about you.
We're very grateful you came.
Then it's really dangerous here?
Sometimes, when Rocco Town gets attacked by Soul Junk, it turns into a real war zone.

We're short on both people and supplies.
We'll be relying on your power for a while, too.

Please understand, we have an urgent mission for you, right now.
Like I said, the situation is very precarious.

Brooke will brief you about your mission. She's part of the Special Missions Squad.
She will explain the details.
Brooke... What's that? Sounds like the name of a wrestler.
Haha. Almost seems like it, but don't say that around her.

You're about the same age, so I'm sure you'll get along well.
Have a chat with her.
Go and see Brooke: she'll explain your mission.

Hey... What's that? Why isn't he coming?
I was looking forward to taking a look at him!
Are you... Brooke?

That's right.
Don't tell me you're going to say it's a boyish name too?
No, I wasn't... It's just I thought your name doesn't suit your face.
Yes, of course. I should blame my parents, and nobody but them.

... Ah, wait a second. Why do you seem so familiar?
Aren't you the SoulWorker who saved Rocco Town?
Yes, but couldn't I be treated appropriately?

Treated? Are we supposed to call together all the people and hold a welcoming ceremony?
Unfortunately, I lack the people to organise a party. So you're just going to have to do without.

What... I'd imagined a muscular giant of a man.
You're just a girl my age.
A he-man with gigantic muscles isn't necessarily strong, is he?
Men like that are normally pretty strong.
Now it's almost ridiculous to force a procedure to follow healthy common sense.

I haven't properly introduced myself yet.
I'm Brooke, an operations soldier of Candus City.
We'll be working together from now on, so remember it well.
You can't forget such a memorable name.

Yes. Even though it can be annoying, nobody forgets it, once they've heard it.
That's the only advantage of that name.

What's it like seeing this town after 15 years?

Rocco Town was a bit more peaceful, but...
this place feels ominous.

Impressive, isn't it?
In a bad way, of course.

I don't know if Aaron told you, but Candus City is facing imminent destruction.
Oh. In truth, it's basically over.

Our supplies dried up long ago, and the place is crawling with Soul Junk.
Most people have fled. Those remaining are trapped. The city is surrounded on all sides.

There's an emergency escape transport plane, but...
if the last line of defense is broken, everyone dies.
But why are you still stationed here then?
Ah, that... Ah, no. I almost told you too much.
I'll tell you the reason later: first you need to know what the mission's about.
Okay. Work is always nice! So, who's in danger here?

In fact, supplies aren't arriving.

is that the coastal road leading here has been blocked.
The Coast Road is the only connection to Grace City, but...

so even reconnaissance, let alone resupply, is difficult.

and quickly take out the Soul Junk occupying it.
So? Child's play, right? Calling it a mission is a bit excessive.
I'll crush them all! I never surrender! I like the sound of that!

Hm. Now is not the time to hang our heads.
I have nothing more to say right now. Go talk to the others.

This city is being invaded by Soul Junk.

I research Soul Junk in Candus City.

What's this...? My eyes have changed!

or what components are in the atmosphere.

you can become a fine Soul Junk doctor too.

Wooooow! You're like a doll. You would fit into my arms perfectly!
J...just a second! Oooh! Oof...

Hmph! Hmph!

And he's really handsome... *giggle*.
Ah, okay.
Oh, by the way, Rookie. I heard you're going with Kane Barrel this time?
Yeah? Oh, right.
That idiot. His hood might look good, but he's an idiot.

It's cold at Ruin Fortress.
Wear a jumper or something... why are you only wearing the hood?
Don't blame me if you catch a cold.
He's a complete idiot...

His brain must have turned to muscle too.
So take this scarf. Don't say I made it!
Got it?
Yes, I understand.
Okay, great! Take care, Rookie! Good luck!
Oh, you're here again?

I've already talked to Roy.
He didn't give me any details. He just said that you want to leave Grace City shortly?
I'm pursuing someone until I've killed him.

Pity.
I'd have loved to chat with you longer.

I don't really know what you do,
but I clearly remember you moving around busily and looking full of drive.

I can't do anything useful...
But one day, I will walk my path on my own two strong legs.
Yes. I hope such a day comes.
Roy, don't you have anything to add?

No. I don't.
We'll be seeing each other soon, anyway.

I see.
Then allow me to tell you a boring tale before you leave, Iris.
Yes, okay. How can I be of assistance?

You remind me of how I used to be.
I was a Supernatural too.
I suspected as much, but...

I wanted to push my abilities to their limits and help people.
I might not be anything special these days, but back then...

And she was always at my side.
The embodiment of determination.

She was strong and unyielding.
A wonderful woman.

We joined forces and overcame all obstacles.
And each time we did, our relationship grew stronger.

But I began to question the path I had chosen.
I don't remember why... but there probably was a reason.

We grew further and further apart.
That's why she...

That dazzling white flame burned me.
These wounds are from that time.

That story is horrible.
But nevertheless you somehow sound happy about it.

Naturally.
I still love her.

She was so beautiful...
Even the flames that tried to take my life were flawlessly beautiful.
Instead of being angry at her, I came to a realisation.
In my eyes, she was clearly a creature who had come from the heavens to judge me and change me.

I don't know what she's doing now.
But one thing is certain...
She's moving forward of her own will.

I mustn't give up.
If only so I can see her again, one day... I cannot give up now.
You're an odd duck.

Hahaha! Thank goodness that you realise that!
I'm a strange person!
But you, Roy, you're not completely normal either, are you?
I knew it. You find me odd.

In any case, I deeply admire how diligently you helped in Grace City.
I have hope for the future.
Well, I'm glad to hear it!
Well, I won't keep you any longer. Let's meet up again sometime.
Until next time.
(You say goodbye to Neb and Roy.)
Very interesting.
What do you think?
You're not a good liar.
Haha, Roy. I don't want to lie.
Hm. Still, don't send some investigator after me.

Didn't you talk a bit too much?
I might tell on you to the Starry Forest.

You think so?
Who cares what some boring guy is mumbling to himself?
I can't figure you out.
I don't think it's all that bad. But fine.
In any case, I look forward to another meeting with that person.
Well, that's because your life is boring. So you can look forward to something like that.

...
Roy, don't you have things to do?

Oh, you gave me a fright!
I'll be on my way then.
Please avoid using excessive methods.

What do you think of me?
You really don't need to worry about that.
There you are. Are you finished in Grace City?
Yes, there's nothing left for me here. All right, let's go!
I must say... You're a completely different person from before.
Is that a good thing? I thought this incident would have given you a shock...

I've seen before what can happen when you don't keep your feelings in check.
I won't make that mistake again.
Yes, you can actually grow, even in situations like that.
Well then. Get going!
Drat... connect... just connect!
It's already connected... you can stop.
Rogen...! It's me, Henry!
I know... How could I forget you?
G...Rogen!

Let me back into the NED Company!
Please... I'm begging you!

I don't know why you ordered the retreat from the west of Cloudream and left me behind on my own.
But my research can save mankind and make the NED Company the greatest...!
The catastrophes in Amaryllis and Candus City... and now the Near SoulWorker project too.
You jeopardised the existence of the company and mankind, and now you want to be allowed back in?

T-that... I'll make up for it starting now...!
Please give me a chance...!
It's because of you that everyone at NED headquarters had to be withdrawn from the west of Cloudream.

The Starry Forest League has classed us all as enemies and will punish or poach everyone who has had dealings with the NED Company.
If the remaining members in the west all leave the NED Company now, then the NED Company will no longer exist in the west.

All because of you, Henry. So...
Stay there and seek forgiveness from the Starry Forest League, or take your own life.
Rogen...
I'm going to hang up now. Don't call me again.
Rogen...

*sob*
*sob*

Rogen... you'd dare to leave me?
Me, the genius who will rebuild mankind from scratch?

All right... if you're going to be like that: I have a plan too.
Damn you both, Starry Forest League and NED Company. I'll exterminate both of you!

Code name Queen... The immortal Soul Junk hidden in Candus...
If I get my hands on her, I can destroy you once and for all!
I... will be master of this world... haha... mwahahah!
Jeremy?

You didn't eat, again.
These are restricted to 30 per day. I got up early this morning to get them.

Phew...
All right. Let me know if you get hungry later.
I'll go then.
Emilito...
What's up with you, Jeremy?
You look like a different person.

What happened to that cheerful smile and eternal optimism of yours?
Even your eyes are dull.

I... quite like that.
You used to get on my nerves a lot. Hahaha.
Jeremy.
Do you want more power?

Chapter Three: Torn Ideals
Complete.
Ach, I want to go home.

Hm? This is a restricted area for civilians.
Please head back quickly.
Hm. Strange, that you would say something like that, but I'm not a civilian.
What is that supposed to mean? Is there something wrong with your head?

Wait, just a second. Civilian or not, how did you get in here?
Who are you? You there!

I'm a SoulWorker from Grace City.
Didn't you get a message?
Aahh.

Aha. So you're the notorious new SoulWorker.
I've heard a lot about you.
You're a lot, really a lot younger than I expected!
Hmph, were you expecting an old lady who's about to kick the bucket?

No, no. It's just that heard you were in the Vacuum for 15 years.
But then apparently it's true that you really don't age in the Vacuum.

I'm Martin.
I've been dispatched to Ruin Fortress as commander.
You're a lot younger than the other commandants I've met so far.

It was hard to get here.
...I'll leave the kind of hardship to your imagination.
Well, if you're the Commandant, you must be able to tell me something about the situation here, right?
Yes... that is... Right, although I am the Commandant, I don't know much... No, I don't know anything at all.
... what?

I'm the Commandant in name only. As the reinforcements were assembled so suddenly in an emergency, there's no real system.
I have had neither a pay rise nor a promotion.

If only I had! Actually, I should have been on holiday soon.
I was really looking forward to being able to relax, finally. But now there's neither holiday nor compensation.
Oh, it's so demoralising.

Even so, you're the commander, aren't you?
It can't be that you really know nothing at all...

I really don't know.
We have to do something so we aren't cut off,
but it's not even clear where to begin yet.

There's no point in forcing people I'm seeing for the first time to carry out some kind of examinations.
I've even already heard the words ‘What do you know?!' from one of my subordinates.
Of course, I don't know everything. It's a completely different field of work! How am I supposed to know all that!?

Sending a hastily assembled team on the important mission of tracking Near SoulWorkers
is like saying the upper management is incompetent.
Honestly, I almost feel like being demoted for insubordination would be better.
Hey. On the one hand, you don't know anything, and on the other hand, you hold others responsible for it. You're a real loser.

We must find the Near SoulWorkers... but we have no information or means.
In other words, we can't help you.

Given the circumstances, we have to visit each other and investigate.
There's a woman named Amanda over there on the Supernatural investigation team.
She should know more than I do, so go say hello.
Ahh, I'll never figure you out. I'll be going then.
Hahaha, until next time.

Go to Staff Sergeant Amanda.
She's sure to know more than I do, so you ought to ask her.

Welcome.
I've been waiting for you.

Aren't you the SoulWorker from Grace City?
Someone gave me a picture of you, but you look a lot younger in real life.
Nothing seems impossible nowadays. Not even fire shooting out of kids' hands, right?
Right. Even so, it takes some getting used to.

Oh, I haven't introduced myself yet. I'm Amanda.
I'm a Supernatural in charge of communications at Ruin Fortress.
My ability is extending radio waves. Well... simply put, a walking radio extender?

I don't mean to brag, but I guess that makes me the most useful member of the squad based in Ruin Fortress.
Communication would be impossible without me.

Oh! I'm sure you know more than that incompetent man, right?
Tell me what I can do to help here.
Sorry, but I'm not authorised to give orders.
That's just great. You're no different than the rest of them.
No! I am definitely not like those people there!

That commander spends all day spacing out drinking hot chocolate,
the doctor in charge is unfriendly, and I can't tell whether everyone came to investigate Near SoulWorkers
or just to enjoy the snowy mountains.
Haha, sounds like work isn't one of their strong points.
I seriously hope you can understand my problems, even if nobody else does.
Hm, all right.

Thanks.
I'm afraid there's not much I can tell you, but I will share everything I know with you.

Ruin Fortress here is a fortress built by NED Company.
It had cut off contact with outside forces, including the Starry Forest League,
so it was an unknown quantity.

But ever since Grace City, we are certain the NED Company betrayed us.
And because this pact was broken, the Starry Forest League won't make any exceptions now.

It seems the shuttle thought to be carrying the Near SoulWorker also came here,
so the mission is the investigation of Ruin Fortress and tracking the Near SoulWorker... something like that.

The Starry Forest League has never been inside Ruin Fortress.
We don't know how many buildings there are or what they contain.

Investigating normal people would be enough of a problem, but on top of that, nobody knows anybody here...
So there's trouble cooperating, and we can't come to a joint decision.
But these are critical investigations which concern the war. That's going too far.

It's because of the war. The people deployed for this operation
are normally all fighting Vessi and Soul Junk, right?

At times like this we can't bring in 1 whole unit.
So a few personnel have been dispatched from each unit.
And that's how the patchwork unit was completed.
That won't make it any easier to find Henry.

Henry? Oh, the scoundrel who caused trouble in Candus
and was chased from Grace.

I have been informed that he may have fled here.
Is there no way to find out more?

We still can't even manage the fortress, let alone grasp its interior...
so I can't say for sure.
I can only assure you that I have not clapped eyes on so much as his shadow.
Yes, I already thought this wouldn't be easy...

But if the Near SoulWorker Project was under Henry's command,
we might find some clues by investigating.
Exactly, they're practically bragging that they are evil. That's where we have to go, right?

Wow... You really are always optimistic.
Aren't you scared of going in there alone? You don't know what's waiting for you inside!

Being fearless has its advantages!
If I were allowed, I'd go in there this instant!

I'm scanning the interior with the communicator right now.
You wouldn't want to die from an unknown attack without knowing anything,
so please wait a bit longer until the call to assemble.
All right, you can go and see Dr Sarah over there.

She is an expert on all things to do with energy in Cloudream.
I guess they sent her here to research the Ruin Fortress's power source.

I find it difficult to talk to her.
People like her are unbelievably smart...

Nobody remains silent when forced to speak.
Let me talk to her, I'm qualified.

...Oh, then I'd be happy if you said
you'd like me to cooperate a bit more as a teammate.

Aren't you the SoulWorker from Grace City?
Senia and Sedurin have told me a lot about you.

You seem to have been talking with all kinds of people just now,
did you get any interesting information?
I'm here because I wanted to find something out.

...I see.
I'm called an authority on energy too, but... I have no idea.

Well, I know you're a great doctor...
Maybe you know the answer?
Even if a doctor is the best... everybody has their own specialty.
Is that another way of saying ‘I have no idea'?
Right. It's the same with most of the ones who work here.

Everyone has abilities, but doesn't know what to do.
You've seen it too, right?

I don't know why most of the people are so hard at work here.
It's actually amazing that we've found out anything at all here.

I'm asking you for your opinion. What do you think?
What do you reckon? What have these bad guys been up to here?
Maybe it's a giant weapon or a robot.

Yes, we think it might be. Unfortunately, we all we can do is guess.
We think the Near SoulWorkers are the weapons.

Really... I want to do something, but the people here just do as they are told.
They don't look out for one another. They just complete their missions and nothing else.

Everything here has been switched off, so I can't even analyse the energy wavelengths.
We're just going round in circles. We're all going to be disciplined for it at some point...
Phew... that's really annoying.
You feel the same. That's why you're pacing about here.
Nothing's working, even though we are trying everything.

We haven't even found the entrance yet.
You'll soon run out of things to do too.
You aren't inside? Then you haven't accomplished anything.

As I said, we're going round in circles.
We're actually here for the investigation, but now we can't even get in... I'm at a loss.
Yeah, yeah, I get it. Nobody here knows anything.
Sorry for having only useless adults.
No. I don't like adult meddling, so I'll try looking for something myself.

I'm not sure if your foolishness is because you are boasting or extra confident, but...
It would be nice if you succeeded!

You were here.
Did you find anything?
The situation is much worse than feared. That's why he's staring into the distance.
Haha! Are you like them too?
Sorry, but it's no different with you either.

I understood that it's more like a preschool than anything else.
I've been with the SFL for a long time, but I've never seen anything like this.

Even if the team was only put together at the very last minute, wasting capable personnel like this...
I'd love to sue the human resources manager.
Even so, shouldn't we do something?

Do you understand now that I can't organise anything here?
We can only trust them and wait.

What are we waiting for?
We're SoulWorkers, so we should just go and solve it!

I understand the feeling, but with no infiltration route or anything known,
acting alone does no good.
Aren't you here to go inside?

There are a lot of mechanisms for stopping invaders inside the fortress.
It resembles a gigantic trap.

Be that as it may. Right now we have to wait for the internal investigation.
A rash intervention could cost us valuable time.
Haha. What's all that about?

Hahaha, the mood is pretty bad.
Exerting pressure won't do us any good. So my dears, how about a hot cocoa?
No, thanks. I'm not planning to sit around here and relax.
... I'll take one.

By the way, Commandant. Why are you running around here so calmly?
How about you do a little work?
Ahaha, there's nothing I can do right now.

The higher-ups tried to push materials outside my field on me,
but I flatly refused, saying it's outside my specialty.
Are you proud of that?

It's also important to clearly say what you can't do.
Rather than entrusting it to someone who can't figure it out after 1 hour,
it's more efficient to leave it to someone who can in 10 minutes.
You really are unflappable.
... Hahaha!
I'm really sorry.

Do you think I'm doing this because I like it?
Meetings, meetings in this damn cold place... the only thing I can rely on is hot chocolate.

We must come to some conclusion. Support is coming soon.
I have a real sense of guilt every time I submit my report with ‘no progress', haha!

Understand at least that we're desperate.
It may look like we're doing nothing, but that isn't the case.

Nothing is shadier than pretending to be busy
when you have no work you can do, right?

Two SoulWorkers have arrived.
More and more people want to get inside. Find some kind of solution.
Okay. But I don't know how it's going to turn out.

So, here you are and you're already being reprimanded.
As ever, Martin.

Well, not as ever. I've been pretty hardworking in my own way.
But why are you here, Dr Sarah?

We've finished some investigation and analysis.
I've confirmed what seems to be the safest entrance,
so it looks like we can move on to the interior investigation.
Oh! Has there been any progress? The Doctor really is most efficient!
That's really great. Finally, we won't have to listen to any more complaints.

Then where should I go?
I'll go right away!

There happen to be 2 entrances, would the 2 of you look around together?
Or would you rather go separately?
We can manage it alone, so let's take one each!

We have to make up for the investigation that has stalled until now.
I have no objections either.

Understood. Then we need to assemble once and hold a meeting.
Person in charge, gather the attendees.
As commander, I should at least do the coordinating.
Now we can finally start doing something. Make an effort too.

Alright, everyone's here.
You probably don't want to look at my face forever, so let's keep this short.
Dr. Sarah, please explain.

Thanks. All the facilities at Ruin Fortress are functioning flawlessly. They aren't shut down like we first thought.
There's hardly any corrosion or damage, although the fortress was unused for so long.

Strange. While I was in the bathroom just now, the automatic door refused to open.
And you still insist everything is working normally?

That's the problem. Even though the facility is operating normally,
there's no way to access its control authority.

Security... that's so Ned.
So everything's locked.

The NED Company is famous for having incredibly effective security measures.
If all of the security systems are not activated at a certain time, everything is locked.

What's certain is that, since we have no control authority at Ruin Fortress,
we can't even go to the bathroom freely.

I see.
If it had been opened properly, I wouldn't have had to splatter it all over the door back then.
I recommend you don't use the men's toilet.

If we hold control authority over Ruin Fortress,
it means we can manage this fortress.
Do you have control?
No, of course not.
But it means you'll have it soon, right?
No, not that either.
What? So you're not doing anything?

My task is simply to investigate the base and find the most secure route.
For anything else, I think you need to ask a hacker.
You... you're really only doing what you were ordered to do?
Better than doing nothing.

Um... I can't argue with that.
Very well, Comms Officer Amanda.
Yes, yes, I'm listening.
Didn't you find out anything, Amanda?

Yes, something about the AI that was reported a few hours ago.
I thought it was being ignored because nobody took care of it.
It's not that he didn't say anything, he couldn't.
AI…

AI stands for artificial intelligence.
In the first generation, commands were entered into these machines, which they then executed. But now they can learn independently and continue to develop.

If the Vacuum hadn't come, the world might have been overrun with androids.
The advancement of mechanical engineering was stopped by the Vacuum.
If the Vacuum hadn't happened, we'd probably be fighting machines now instead.
Don't worry. Once we get in here, you can fight as many machines as you want!

If I may continue...
Every time I tried to track the movement of the energy wave, it seemed to flee.
It seemed almost human.
You mean they have a brain capable of obstructing us?
Yes, but they are a lot faster than humans. That's why I suspect it's a computer or an AI.

Then, Amanda.
Can you pinpoint the place that oversees the radio wave operations?
Yes. I already looked for it. You're setting the route, Dr Sarah?
The route has been set. We just need to open the entrance, otherwise we can't get in.

Now it's the two SoulWorkers' turn!
Can't we just destroy the doors?
That seems impossible, even for a SoulWorker.
Let's try.

It's not baseless.
A facility that researched Near SoulWorkers
would have been built sturdily for unforeseen circumstances.

I don't know how strong your power is,
but I know Soul Energy very well.

Don't worry about the entrance.
Leave it to me.
Oh yeah? Do you want to hack it somehow? You've got amazing skills!

No, I found an employee ID card on the ground.
It belongs to a cleaning unit and can only open a few areas apart from the entrance and exit.

You can praise me a little, you know?
I'm being useful, after all.

Anyway, this card gives us access to the fortress.
I'll leave the search to you.
Finally, we get to do something!

Your objective is to locate the AI.
Once we have examined it, we can determine if we can secure it.

After %username% departs, I'll have Kane Barrel go investigate other areas.
If you feel uneasy about going alone, going in together as two is fine.
Don't worry about me!

Good luck!
We'll look for danger along the way and provide support.

Hm... He's just walking around at the entrance.
But a whole lot more has come out.
Then let's summarise. *munch munch*
Are you eating again?

I love my egg sandwiches.
In a place like this, you have to ensure you have a balanced diet.

Pick one, eating or talking.
You don't need me to tell you which to pick, right?

Yes, yes. First of all...
There's definitely an AI. And she's quite cute.
They said artificial intelligence, but it spoke just like a real human.

If you program in great detail, human-like actions are possible.
But it still remains ‘like a human'. Unlike real humans, there are many contradictions and exceptions.

In any case, she was very sweet, that AI Lucy.
I would trust an AI like that with my life.
That would be dangerous!
Please, spare us the disgusting details.

Second.
The Near SoulWorker we're searching for
is already openly wandering inside Ruin Fortress.

There was nothing particular in their transport shuttle.
They do what they want as the NED Company has withdrawn.
They've been in that dangerous place the whole time?

It looks like it's searching for something...
but I don't know what.

If I knew that, I wouldn't be struggling.
I don't know, which is why I'm in trouble like this.
Of course, I'm not the one struggling.
Hahahaha. I'm sorry we keep giving you more work.
Oh, I've gotten used to it in the meantime, so you don't have to keep apologising.

To search for the Near SoulWorker, we must control the facility,
and to control it, we need to secure the AI ourselves.
Yes, we need the AI. If we hadn't had the cleaner's ID card, we wouldn't have got inside. Do you think it's possible?
The doctor's hacking skills are bound to help us, don't you think?
I'm not a hacker. I research energy.
Hm. Isn't there something useful like hacking energy?
There is not, so don't look at me so expectantly.
I already had a feeling, but... The Guild just doesn't have any skilled hackers.
We've always had a lack of hackers.

The NED Company treats programmers much better. That goes without saying.
If I were a hacker, I'd go to the NED Company too, instead of the Starry Forest League.

Besides, no hacker would choose to get lost in here.
Let's give it our best.
Well aren't you just a bundle of enthusiasm.

Well, if our hacking skills aren't enough, we have no other option than to format or destroy the AI.
I'm not sure whether that'll help us take over the fortress.

Wouldn't that at least disarm the machines?
Then our investigation team could go inside and find a higher level decoder.
Go inside to find something? Are you serious?
Martin... are you serious...?
Hm, it might sound idiotic, but the idea of smashing it up might work, right?
What good would that do?

Look, an AI is bound to have a self-defence system.
And this system will kick in when it is attacked.

It means there are many sub-cores that assist with power and computation.
If we physically destroy them...
...computing power and output will decrease, giving us a chance to hack it.
When that happens, the hackers in our team will be able to carry out the hack.
It's still not a one hundred percent guarantee.

Even so, it's better than doing nothing.
Amanda, you understand too?
Are you talking about those flashes that appear when you destroy a machine?
You haven't understood a single word.

Simply put, while we're attacking,
the AI can't do anything else. Got it?
Oh, got it! I think I know what you're saying now.

Whatever. We're headed in the right direction now.
All right! I'm on my way!
Yes, please do.
Were you about to leave? Very motivated!

You're back, Kane Barrel.
Would you like a sandwich?
... Didn't you just eat one of those?

It's gratitude toward SoulWorkers.
If you don't like it, just decline.
What's up? You don't look too good.
I'm sorry, I have a stomach ache. I need to rest.

Eh? What's all this out of nowhere?
Hey! You can't do that now that we're finally to start working!

Kane Barrel, come listen over here too.
What on earth is wrong?
I'm sorry. Can't you leave me alone for a moment?
What's all this about?
Then let's start the mission to mess about with Lucy.
Waaah... *sigh*
Wha...what's this? Why are you being sick here?
I'm fine. I just saw something I'd rather not have seen...
Something you didn't want to see? Did you see something dangerous in the fortress?
Egg in the sandwich.
What...?
Well... the fried egg... in the sandwich.
Ah, I see...
The egg... in the sandwich? Are you serious?
It's not a joke... Sorry, but I really don't feel well.
Why...? Do eggs remind you of something bad?
I can't deny it... Yuck...
J...just a second! Stop it! That's disgusting!
I... I can't do the next mission in this state...

Hey... wait. What do you mean?
You can't take part in the next mission? A SoulWorker? Because of eggs?
Everyone has their reasons.
Stop talking nonsense! It doesn't even make any sense that you can't come on the mission because of eggs!
... Urgh!
W...wait a minute? Stop it!

I...I'm not joking or lying!
Now my head hurts too... sorry, but I think I have to go back to Grace City.
Ah! I understand! Go back! Go already!

I'm really sorry.
I'll have to leave pursuing the Near SoulWorkers to you.

I'm speechless, but...
it seems true, so it can't be helped.
Leave this to me.
W...what... a little child!

Th...there are loud n...noises outside!
Mummy and daddy say you have to go in there.

The whole time! It was loud the whole time and then suddenly it was quiet!
N...now I'm all a...alone in the dark!
Alone! Always alone! *sniff*

Boys don't cry!
Big sis will help you, so follow me properly.
*sob* Thanks...
You're the one who brought this kid to the base.

He'll be in danger if we leave him behind.
Do you have a problem with that?

A facility full of overtechnology like this, with just one child.
Running over as if they'd been waiting.
Don't you think that's suspicious?
Hm. Now that I think about it, it is strange.

What are you guys talking about?
The kid hasn't even had a chance to rest. We can worry about that later.
I only stated my objective opinion as part of the investigation team.
If you say things like suspicious or doubtful, the child will get scared.

Have you been reading too many crime novels?
Don't push it. Oh really.
Yeah, yeah, all good. I made a mistake.

Don't push it.
Everybody is allowed to be sceptical. It's not like you hit him.
But still. To suspect a child... I feel dirty.

I know exactly what you mean!
But I have evidence, so don't let your scepticism go just yet.

The biological examinations have shown that it is 100% human.
This kid is neither a Soul Junk, a Vessi, nor a Near SoulWorker. What is there still to doubt?

That... I've heard that sort of thing often.
You're probably worried that I'm being exploited.

But since I'm doing this voluntarily, I've decided not to worry about it any more.
Profit and loss... I'd rather save someone, before I worry about that sort of thing.
Really. SoulWorkers are still just like they were in the old days.

For now I'll respect your will.
That said, I'd like you to think once more about what you're doing now.

Before profit or loss...
you can at least have the doubt that something is off with you.

Hmm... I have no idea what you mean...
but I'll say I understand!

While you were holding off the Big Puppet at R Square,
some dolls were allowed to intrude into Rocco Town.
Fortunately the dolls were few and subdued without damage, but...

The problem is that those dolls are completely different from the ones fought at R Square...
and that the intrusion method is completely unknown.

So they're not like the ones the Big Puppet led...
Got it, I just need to destroy them all!
I expected no other reaction from you.

With you the only one able to carry out the operation,
it's odd to say this, but...
...are you really all right? You must still be tired from last time.

Of course I'm fine!
Strangely I got a bit tired back then,
but now I feel no fatigue at all!
Ha ha ha, maybe it's thanks to SoulWorker power!

I see... understood.
You really like going to dangerous places...
just like the figure I heard about at the scene 15 years ago...

We judged these to be a second faction of puppets
and focused our investigation on the direction thought to be their route of entry, but...

We didn't find anything of note.
Our communications and intelligence has been disrupted by some unknown radiation.

That's why we sent a search party to look at the site, but...
They haven't returned yet. They obviously ran into a problem.

I want you to go confirm what happened in the operation area...
or what is happening there.
I have the feeling that something bad is going to happen this time.
Huh? You're always so optimistic, and now you say something like that?

Yes, I was only able to survive the explosion of Big Puppet by luck.
That's why I have such a foreboding that something terrible will happen this time.

Something good is always followed by something bad. So this time it must be something bad.
Once I've survived it, I can look forward to something good again!

I don't know if that way of thinking is optimistic or pessimistic.
Be that as it may. Unfortunately, I have to ask for your help again.

Find the search party that set out to find the source of the radiation.
The sector doesn't have a name yet. It just isn't that simple.
Is that really a... human?
Excuse me, but are you alive?
I see some sort of blue gemstone...
I don't think we should touch it. It might be dangerous.
Are you here again?

The situation has already been forwarded to the operator. A gigantic tower...
And people who are turned to stone. Problem upon problem.

I heard we just received the analysis of the rays from headquarters.
They seem to have had something to with those humans that were turned to stone.
And where are they coming from? I'll set off straight away and deal with it!
Good. Sunny got the report. It's probably best if you get a doctor's opinion on this.

After bombs, now a phenomenon where people freeze up...
It really is one misfortune after another.
Go to Sunny and take her the result of the investigation.
I've been waiting for you!
I've heard that you have documents from the investigation of the tower!

Yes, I know.
I've compiled the materials so %username% can check,
but I'll tell you verbally too.

Yes! Thank you for your efforts!
I was worried because of the technical terms.

Hehe, I'll explain it to you without jargon.
First, a summary of the report.

The radiation from the tower has the same wavelength as the stones that emit the strange Vessi energy.
The SFL doctors estimate it to be very similar.
Can you explain to me what these wavelengths are?

It's a wavelength called Temptation.
Normally it's sealed in stone, but it can be made to burst out.

In themselves, they are harmless, but if they end up in humans, their effect unfolds.
Anyone touched by them turns to stone and ultimately will cease breathing.

The theory behind it is relatively basic. First the person's blood hardens so that they can no longer move.
If the hardened blood is then touched by another electromagnetic wave, the body petrifies.

Shortly after petrification commences, the human is human no more.
From a purely biological standpoint, there is nothing left to indicate that the body was human.

How inhumane...
So there's nothing we can do about it?

There is one possible defence.
However, not in this backwater.

But fortunately, it seems this radio wave spread
isn't aimed at wiping out humans.

According to your partner, fragments of the Temptation Stone
were embedded in the petrified bodies.
This is probably a kind of process for creating puppets.

Giving false life to inanimate things...
that's the role of the Temptation Stone too.

That is to say, the enemy is trying to expand its army of mannequins instead of expanding the range of the radiation.
So that means that we don't have to worry that the waves will spread and destroy everything and everyone.

That's the content of the report.
You know what we must do, without my saying it, right?
... I have to do something.

Are you really okay...?
I know SoulWorkers resist disease, but...
we can't expect support because of Temptation's influence.

In other words, this time you must fight alone
in an area full of dolls.
What...? Are SoulWorkers really well protected against disease?
That's because %username%, who went once, had no problem...

But... I can't say it's absolutely safe either.
Your body might turn to stone at any time,
and you still want to go to that place again?

Of course.
If I did nothing just because it's dangerous, then even more people would die.

... You're really terrific.
I'm sure I can't change your mind.

Then before heading out on the operation, go visit Warren.
He doesn't belong to the Starry Forest League,
so I think he has no idea of the current state.

By policy we normally don't tell ordinary people such information
to avoid stirring up fear, but...
he'll want to be of use as a doctor, so please.
Ah, I don't mind, but... you won't tell him directly?

Doctors from different associations like to maintain a certain distance.
It's somewhat complicated, but I would call it a difference in the ideological mindset. I'm begging you.
There you are. What is going on in Rocco Town?

First, be quiet and listen to me.
A phenomenon is occurring in which people turn to stone when they die.
The people are petrified and then turn into mannequins?

But don't worry.
I'll solve it somehow and protect this town!

The blood of people exposed to the radio waves hardens, their bodily activity stops,
and in the end they become no different from puppets... I see.

I see, no wonder... Lately in Rocco Town, many people have been complaining
of heavy bodies and stiff limbs.

Nothing we tried has worked. I was at my wits' end.
Luckily, we weren't hit so hard.

What matters now is that the symptoms of people affected are worsening.
We don't know where the radiation comes from, but it's having a definitive effect on Rocco Town.
The situation is worse than I thought.
It's a sickness. A sickness that spreads evil.

I guess you're going to deal with it, right?
In that case, please go see Benjamin and tell him this.

Even though the radiation is weak, evil is brewing in Rocco Town.
The longer we wait, the worse it will get.
Yes, of course! I'll let them know!

Even if we remove the cause of these symptoms, we don't know what will happen.
It's possible that electric waves accumulate in the human body.
So you have to hurry.

Please tell it to Benjamin.
I don't want to rush you, but it is urgent.

I heard you report that the people in Rocco Town have turned to stone?
Does that mean the radiation extends all the way into Rocco Town?

If we do nothing, and just let this happen, Rocco Town will turn into Mannequin City.
Good. Then there's no time to waste.

I've discovered that the radiation appears in specific locations simultaneously.
It's possible that something like a transmitter is there.

The tower, the biggest problem, can't be dealt with in the current situation.
Suppressing the source of the signal is the top priority first.

According to Sunny, my body won't turn to stone.
I'm the only one who can accomplish this mission! I'll go then.
All right. Please destroy those mannequins.
A talking mannequin? Almost nothing surprises me any more.

We don't need any investigation for that. It is obvious that the Adv. Soul Junk is controlling the mannequins near the tower.
They talked about the Blue Flame Clown; it is quite clear that they worship him.

From now on, the puppet equipped with a dialogue function
shall be named codename "Jack the King."
And you are ordered to defeat Jack the King.

Frankly, we don't have the means to do anything about this big tower.
Grace City assisted us with a rocket strike but the radiation messed it up.

It's an electronically guided long-range missile.
Because of the radio waves, it can't even reach the vicinity of the object.
I'm the only one who can survive it. I understand.
Frustrating, but we have to rely on the SoulWorker. That's reality.

In the end, what we can do now is annihilate the individual thought to be the puppets' commander
and wait until headquarters finds a way out of this situation.
It hurts my sense of honour, but please take care of it, SoulWorker.

Yes! Don't worry and prepare for an evacuation!
And rehearse the evacuation as a precaution!

Go find Miriam before you're deployed for an operation.
I still have something to say to her.

You'll probably get a bit of nagging...
Please understand. That's her personality.
Go see Miriam before you go into battle.

So you're heading out alone again.
It's dangerous, even if you're a SoulWorker.
I'm the only one who can do it! Well of course, that's a given!
You're so righteous.

Really... SoulWorkers all say that.
You walk the same path, so much so it seems like fate...
If strong people like us did nothing, it would be recklessly irresponsible. Haha!
Oh, so that's how it is!

Fine, I'll trust you.
You're not allowed to die, got it?
There you are. Do you have time for a report?

Yes, I'll report. ...The Blue Flame Clown came
and killed Jack the King for selfish reasons.

...Same as the report I received.
Wasn't that a doll he made himself?
What whim struck him all of a sudden...

Well, fine. I've confirmed the remains of Jack the King.
The tower seems to have completely lost function.

Destroying something he made with his own hands...
If that's his taste... I must be grateful this once.

Anyway, while you get on with your work, we'll carry on with the investigation.
Regarding the Blue Flame Clown, I mean.

We've narrowed down the location of the clown.
He's hanging out in an abandoned hospital.
A hospital...
What is it? Have you got something on your mind?

No... I was reminded of when I worked part-time as a nursing assistant at a hospital...
...There I was able to find the meaning of life.
Oh, right. Would you rather not go there?

Just the opposite!
If these guys are causing such trouble in a place like that, I'd like to stop them.

I don't know what they're plotting there...
but it seems the search party that went to investigate can't return.

...They must still be in danger.
Their lives may be at risk.

The Blue Flame Clown is among the cunning type of Vessi.
...Unimaginable from his appearance,
he's toyed with and killed humans in a meticulous, planned way.

So this time you should abandon the idea of winning by force.
...Since we don't know what he's thinking,
we need to deal with it calmly. Understood?

Haha! No matter how great your disadvantage or how scared you are, you just have to take things as they come!
I see the advice as a simple suggestion.

...It sounded like you'll act without thinking as usual?
Lamentable that we have no power to stop you.
Please find the search party that went missing in the abandoned hospital.
Oh... ahem...
I...is everything all right?

S-support soldier... is that so...?
T-that's good.
*cough* *cough*

I feel that the end is nigh.
I can't feel pain anymore.

You mustn't give up!
If you survive, then everything will soon be all right!
It's too late for me.

But others are still alive.
Please save them!

They're probably... waiting quietly...
for someone... t-to help them...

Wait just a moment!
I'll call for help right away!
P...please... take care... of the... others!

Are... are you the reinforcements?
Uh... thanks.
Thank goodness. You look better than I expected.
I'm unhurt, but it was a close shave.

I can still hear them sniggering.
Those monsters! Don't they care at all for human life?

I'm going to withdraw.
I don't want to spend another second in this place.

There's still one person left, I think.
P... Please save them.

Uah... Uaaaah!
I... I've got to get out of here!
I... I don't want to see any more mannequins!
I'm here to help you! It's safe now!

Tha...thanks for rescuing me, but...
I just can't do this anymore.

I'm too old for this.
I give up... I'm going to find a job that's got nothing to do with war.

Not a bad decision.
Leave the dangerous stuff to us.
How does it look? Is the search party safe?
There are almost no survivors.
Really?

But if %username% hadn't gone,
the lives of those who returned would have been in danger too.
...That alone is a good thing.

No. I was only just able to narrowly prevent the worst.
Nothing good happened.
Yes, in that case, I hope it goes better next time.

But there's some more bad news. Post has come from the Clown for you.
He wants to meet you, and he's written down where you should go.

What are you saying?
What is he up to?

This is what the letter says.
A special field has been set up on the road ahead,
so no one but a select few can pass.

Only those wearing the badges his subordinates carry will be allowed in,
so the content is that he's inviting just the SoulWorker...
in other words, only you, to a party for two.

In other words, to meet the Blue Flame Clown,
you need to get the badges his subordinates carry.

And that badge is only one.
He intends to make %username% come alone.
Trap or not. If he's waiting, I'll be on my way.
Who knows what that guy is planning!

...Understood.
Please do it to prevent any more casualties.

Defeat the Blue Flame Clown's subordinates
and get the proof.

Is this the badge the Blue Flame Clown was talking about?
...Tasteless.
Be that as it may. That concludes the provisions for meeting with that clown.

I don't know the purpose...
But it's certain they're a threat to humans.

Somehow he seemed very interested in you...
Go ahead and fully live up to that expectation.
This time I believe good things will happen, I'm going!

Don't take on such a burden and don't always try to fix everything.
Even if you can't manage it by yourself, we'll find a way.

He wanted me to come alone, so don't worry about it.
See you.
This is the perfect chance to defeat the Blue Flame Clown!

Calling us out and then running away...
In the end I couldn't tell what his goal was.

I don't know either. What was he thinking?
It's not as if he had his back to the wall.

Be that as it may, well done.
We seem to have put the danger behind us.

The moment the Blue Flame Clown disappeared,
the attacks by Soul Junk and Vessi stopped too.
So everything was apparently being driven by the Blue Flame Clown.
We must put an end to this.

There's also an order from the Starry Forest League Command...
I'm concerned about his movements, but all we can do is pray nothing happens.
The high command orders you to immediately...

M...Major Benjamin!
Something terrible happened!

What is it, Miriam?
It's not at all like you to be so agitated.

R-Rocco Town...
A large number of bombs have been confirmed in Rocco Town!
What?
More bombs?

Eric and Sean called in.
They were at the drilling site and discovered massive bombs!

According to the investigation...
it has been confirmed that bombs have been planted throughout Rocco Town via the sewer pipes.
How dangerous is it?
We can only guess, but they have about double the explosive force of Big Puppet.

Unbelievable!
Can we defuse them?

It's possible. But it will take time.
Nobody knows if they're going to just blow up.
And we've received a new message from the Blue Flame Clown.
%username%, it seems to be an invitation for you.

If you don't go, he'll blow us all up.
Running away would be incredibly cowardly.

Exactly.
But we already know where the Blue Flame Clown is.
It's as if we're being invited.
Where is the Blue Flame Clown now?

On the roof of the abandoned hospital.
However, our scans indicate that there are several bombs in there as well.

It's evidently a trap.
But we have no other choice.

...It can't be helped.
%username%, accept his invitation.
I wouldn't miss this party even if I hadn't been invited!

Don't push yourself too much, okay?
Just driving him off is enough... understood?

We'll try to defuse the bombs in Rocco Town quickly.
And we'll position a helicopter near the roof.

Buy time by engaging the Blue Flame Clown,
and if he shows signs of blowing up the rooftop, escape by helicopter.

While you're buying time,
we'll defuse all the bombs no matter what.

And if possible...
this time, finish him off for good.

I'm counting on you.
Show that foolish clown who treats human life lightly what you can do.

I'll wait for you here.
I'll take care of dismantling the bomb.

Blue Flame Clown...
Let's end it this time.
I...is everything all right?
My stomach hurts...

What about your stomach?
Say it a bit more clearly!
I have part-time experience as an ambulance crew member!
Hey, are you listening?
I have a family. A wife and a daughter...

That story is for later!
Tell me the symptoms... the exact symptoms! Otherwise...!

Thank you... for worrying...
But I... know myself... best...
So... please...

Tell my daughter...
I'm sorry I couldn't buy her a present...
...That's my only regret...

You shouldn't be worrying about others right now! Worry about yourself!
If you want to tell her something, then stay alive to tell her yourself!
Thank you for your kind words. But I know it. I can barely breathe...
Before I can't talk any more... my daughter...
How many times do I have to say it?! Don't give up!
Argh!
Wha...what is that? There's cotton coming out of his mouth!
Argh... aaah... aah.... aaaargh!
Ah! Wait, I'll pull it out! If I pull it out...
Everything... will be fine...

Sorry...
......Those were your last words... I should have... put you at ease...
I will avenge you.
Is it over?

At the end, he vanished laughing.
That is very disturbing.

At any rate, there are absolutely no signs of life from the Blue Flame Clown.
That'll do for now.

We've defused all the bombs in Rocco Town.
But they were fireworks, not bombs.
Then he was never actually planning to fight.

Unbelievable! Who'd have thought it?
Somehow I don't really get what this is about.

What on earth does the Blue Flame Clown want?
Did he really just want to celebrate? I don't think he had a goal. He just wanted to have fun.
No. No, I'd be an idiot if I tried to understand the Vessi.

The guy acts completely at random.
Sometimes things like this happen. With guys like that, you have to let your fists do the talking.

......You really did your best.
You protected not only many people but the town itself.

Now that the Blue Flame Clown is gone and the doll army has quieted,
everyone in town is thankful to you.
For a while you'll be welcomed as the town's hero, just like 15 years ago.

For now, enjoy the brief peace
and give your heart some room, even a little.

The work didn't go perfectly...
...but if I'm down, everyone else will worry too.

Understood.
I'm not entirely convinced, but let's do that.

I'm glad. Please head out to Candus City without delay, once you've had a proper rest.
You can help the Starry Forest League stationed there.

A major encounter with the Soul Junk is underway in Candus City right now.
You will be a gamechanger for them.
Okay, understood. It's enough for me if I can help someone.

I've made good use of your abilities so far, so it's a bit funny when I say this, but...
First and foremost, you're a normal young man, not a SoulWorker.

A SoulWorker may not feel fatigue even when pushing the body hard.
...But once the mind starts to crumble, it's beyond control.

To those around you, you seem extremely resilient.
Always smiling, never yielding to evil, standing in front of everyone...
and getting hurt more than anyone.

Isn't it actually painful?
Pressed down by the sense of responsibility that you must do it...
hurt deeply even by small failures...
%username%, you... need a little rest.

I-I'm fine!
Where do I look tired?
You're being unnecessarily obstinate again.

Haha. That's not stubbornness.
The sight of his grin while I'm rescuing people drives me on.
Haha. A really funny lifestyle with so many curious sayings.

But if you say that, I won't stop you.
Say goodbye properly before you go to Candus City. Everyone wants to say goodbye to you properly.

Talk to the people.
At least you can say goodbye to them.

I already heard the news.
You want to go to Candus City?

When you're there, you will learn once again why our world is descending into chaos...
The Soul Junk. Keep that in mind.

The worst enemy is the one who's intentions are unknown.
Remember that.

Ever since you saved me, I've been in your debt.
I will pay that debt next time we meet.

Hehe, you've saved the city zone so many times. What debt do you think there is to pay?
I think you have a different idea of what constitutes gratitude.

Right. Many have died in this latest string of cases,
but I was going to say, don't take it too much to heart.
It isn't your fault. Without you, the damage wouldn't have stopped at this.

Well done – you saved the people. Just like you wanted to.
You should be proud of yourself.

Ah...!
Thank you. I'll try to think that way!

I can tell that you have to force yourself to say that. But fine.
I hope we'll meet again.

...You came.
I've been waiting.

Now, you seem to have time today.
Shall I bring some sweets?

Thanks, but I'm leaving for Candus City shortly.
I should get going...
Oh, that's a shame. Yeah, there's nothing for it.

Then I guess I should see you off.
It really is a shame...

I am grateful to you and always will be.
You're still willing to risk everything to save lives, even now. You haven't changed.

But sometimes you should rely on the people who want to help you.
You get mentally exhausted so quickly because you always try to do everything yourself.

No... relying on someone means putting that person in danger.
Rather than that, it's better if I manage on my own!

Yes, I get it.
It's probably impossible for normal people to help a SoulWorker anyway.

I wasn't very nice to you.
I was overjoyed to actually meet my childhood hero.

Oh, thanks!
I want to work even harder for people who appreciate me as much as you do, Sunny.

Please... go and see Miriam now.
She wants to say goodbye.

Okay... take care!
I hope we can talk about something other than life and death next time we meet.

Congratulations, you're going to Candus City!
Well, actually that means even more work for you.

It will be a lot more dangerous there than it is here in Rocco Town.
So be prepared when you go there.
Haha, okay! I understand!

W-what's wrong?
You seem much more energetic than when you came back earlier.

Yes! I'm doing much better thanks to the support from the people!
I thought people would criticise me for all the deaths.

Who would blame you?
If anyone did, I'd pinch their cheeks.

Ha ha... it's fine since it's true.
But thanks.

You're leaving for Candus City already.
It's a tougher place than here.
Don't let your guard down.

There's someone called Lieutenant Colonel Aaron in Candus City.
Please give him my regards.
Go, go! Here is a letter for him, all right? Just give it to him!
This mission isn't at all difficult, is it? See you later!

Oh and by the way, the route from Rocco Town to Candus City is – how can I put this – a bit dangerous.
Yes. Very dangerous, actually.

Without a guide, you won't know what to do.
So the one who lives there... hmm, I don't know if I can call it a person. Anyway, a person.

I told this ‘person' about you.
His name is Booker. Funny name, isn't it?

Be sure to say I introduced you, okay?
Then they should be kind to you.
"Booker TV." Got it memorized?
Of course! Thank you for your advice!
Take care of yourself.

I'll save the world. And then definitely come back.
See you next time.
So you're leaving?
Yes, I'm being sent out.

It's a pity though.
All I ever said was thanks and never once apologized.

Yes, we probably relied too much on the title ‘SoulWorker'.
From behind he looks like a perfectly normal young man.

People with a strong sense of justice are made to be exploited.
That boy's sense of justice exceeds all measure.

That's true... even with power, it's still hard...
Shall I look into what happened
before that girl became a SoulWorker...?
People's pasts are their private business.
Haha... That's true.

And it's not important what his past was like.
What's important is that he saved Rocco Town.

Therefore, if that child ever suffers, we of the Fortune Corps.
must take the initiative to lend a hand.
So that we can be a reassuring ally to him.

To that end, we have to clear out the Soul Junk and the puppets.
With the SoulWorker gone, it looks like we'll be busier.

Oh well. The more I think about it, the more astonishing this cycle is.
The people he helped 15 years ago still live in Cloudream.

They say what goes around comes around...
even in this world that has changed so much,
his past good deeds will brighten his path a little.
... You think so?

There are many who remember how he sacrificed himself near the Vacuum 15 years ago and helped countless people.
In the future, he will meet many of those people.
That is precisely what worries me.

Why?
If someone remembers, I think he'd be happy...

It may be needless worry, but...
past praise will become pressure and only add to his burden.
Who knows what will happen when he collapses under that load.
All right. Got it.

Chapter One: Awakening
End
Hehe, you're reluctant to leave Rocco Town, aren't you?
Hm? Someone's there.

Oh, could you be...
%username%, perhaps~?
H-how did you know?

Hahaha. In such a dangerous world, everyone learns very quickly when someone as strong as you shows up.
I'm Booker; I lead the Booker bandits. Here's to good cooperation!

Miriam told me about you.
She said a clueless greenhorn would come and ask me for help.
Hahaha! Here's to good cooperation!

Hm. Maybe you're surprised that I'm talking to you first, but...
First and foremost, I am a Vessi. If you find that unpleasant, go right ahead and say so. I don't mind at all.

Well, I have bad memories of the Vessi...
but Miriam said they were kind, so I don't think of them as bad Vessi!
Miriam spoke well of me? Haha! I'm glad to hear it!

Be that as it may.
I may be a Vessi, but I am on the side of humanity. I have sold information to humans that is deadly for the Vessi. That's how it started.
Then there are traitors among the Vessi too?
There will always be differing opinions among thinking beings.
Thanks to my treason, I can cooperate with humans and live here.

Of course, I cannot deny my heritage, but because of it I can get into places you humans cannot.
This place, for instance, has its appeal.

You don't need to be afraid, no need to look at me like that.
I find the whole thing unpleasant.

I mean, with the derelict city and an alien who just stands around, that may be so.
Just stay where you are and everything will be fine. And I'll stay here where I am.
I'm not scared, but I was surprised because they're completely different from the Vessi I fought before.

You've fought Vessi?
Hm, not bad. That you've already been into battle at your age...

You're in the Bandit Zone. There are no rules here.
I am trying to make some money here.

The Vacuum has had a huge impact on this area, so rebuilding it is a distant dream.
But the place is so big you have to pass through it if you want to reach the camp.

Like I said, it's a bandit zone. You don't get punished for anything here.
Discard your rubbish, spit in the street or pee on a street corner, nobody cares.
It's the same with murder.

It really is a dangerous place... but there seem to be people in trouble here too.
Worth helping!

Hahaha! You're not right in the head! Saving people in this chaos?
Maybe you'll manage to drag half a corpse to the city zone.

The law prevails again in the safe zone at the village entrance. If you rescue anyone, bring them here.
If your pursuers don't want to live on bread and water for the next few years, they'll give up there at the latest.
Yeah, I'll remember!

Ah! Nevertheless, don't try to save anyone here!
Take my advice. This place is swarming with enemies and Soul Junk that are stronger than you by quite a bit.
