Haha. Okay. It's a good thing you didn't fly into a rage.
Ah, there's something else I'd like to say to you before you go.
... then hurry up.
Butterflies fold their wings, souls turn black, and desire flares red.
Pardon me, but I don't have time for that sort of thing right now. I have to go!

Ah, just a moment!
Ahh. Gone already.
This world will sink into darkness when the black dragon soars into the sky.
You really need to hear this.
Hmm, what? Do you want to hear more of my story?

Partner! Hey Partner!
Partner! Partner! Partner!

Get up! Get up!
You have to get up!
Aaaaah...
What took you so long?

I've been waiting for you the whole time!
What took you so long?!
Sorry.
Why was he even sent on this hopeless mission...? Emilito...
It's your fault... you brought this operation...!

If only you hadn't come here!
This never would have happened if you hadn't come here!

Emilito wouldn't have died!
You! You killed him!
You killed Emilito!
I'm sorry... I'm so, so sorry

You liar! You liar!
You liar!

You promised to protect us! You said that you'd help us!
In the end, you did nothing at all!

Traitor.
You filthy traitor.

Go.
I don't want to look at you any more.
Beat it! Get lost!
Yes, I understand.
The way back is safe. Be careful on your return.
Hey partner...
Well done.

Jeremy is being tended to.
His wounds aren't that bad. Just a bit bruised.
Thank goodness.

But... he seems mentally worn down.
He apparently can't even eat.

The funerals for the fallen members are mostly done.
...Including Emilito.
Jeremy seems to be recovering too, but why not say something to him?

I don't think it's going to help now.
I accept full responsibility for everything.
You were simply fooled by the NED Company...

I'm the one who has to take the responsibility.
The mistake I made as a leader is unforgivable.

We have no time to mourn.
Grace City was always steadfast until now. But this time, the Rapid Flame dealt us a crushing defeat.
We have to arm ourselves before this place gets captured too.

Yes, of course.
I can't even spare time to grieve.

The dead don't come back. Live or die...
It may be harsh, but that's reality.

I know... even so, as long as there are people calling for help,
I have to go...

Listen, don't bear it alone.
This is the responsibility of the whole Starry Forest.

You've got to pull yourself together again as fast as possible or else we'll be in trouble.
The NED Company abandoned this place and we have to inspect it and find out something.
Find out something? Are you looking for something from the NED Company?

Yeah, that's right.
We haven't found anything yet, but it won't be much longer.

Go and get Jeremy... Now, wait, Jeremy isn't doing well.
Then go and see Sora, who's taking care of Jeremy.
Aren't you going to ask how Jeremy is?
Ah, there you are... How have you been?

I... can't claim I've been doing all that well.
But you're probably here because of Jeremy, not because of me.

He isn't doing well. He's not eating or talking.
He just sits there and stares.

The mental shock must have been great.
...No wonder. Emilito, whom he admired so much...

I heard Jeremy said something terrible to you.
I won't ask you to understand by force.
But please know that he's not a bad kid.

No, it was my fault to begin with.
Jeremy has every right to hate me.
Emilito was more than just family to Jeremy.

The boy was always insecure.
That changed when he met Emilito.

He said he met someone who brought out his true self.
Since meeting Emilito, Jeremy has visibly changed.
For the better, of course...

And then he found you too.
Then suddenly, Jeremy had two heroes.

But... one of those heroes didn't make it in time,
and the other lost their life astonishingly easily.

Faced with that far too harsh reality, Jeremy
had no choice but to direct his hatred at someone...
Otherwise, he surely couldn't have endured it.

And you can't hate the dead.
So you were the only logical choice, for Jeremy.
Please... don't hate him because of it.

We can only hope it will get better in time.
Until Jeremy's heart heals itself.

He is very resilient.
I know he will make it. Yes. Right.

Emilito must surely think so too.
If there is an afterlife...
Emilito would surely Jeremy...
Sorry... truly...
Can I ask you for something, Jin?
Sure, if you think I can help?

Well, the situation doesn't look good.
I hope everyone stays strong.

The damage hasn't even been repaired yet, has it?
If you're downcast at a time like this...
I think everyone won't be able to keep going.
I see.
I see! So I mustn't be disheartened! Haha!
I'm sorry for asking such a stupid thing of you.

Nonsense, thanks to you I've remembered something important.
Twist of fate... when something bad happens, something good must soon follow.

The news is all bad right now... but nobody wins if I lose heart.
I have to be strong so everybody else can be strong!

Haha, thanks!
You really are as responsible as they say.
Everything will be all right, I'm sure.

You look a little better.
Did something happen?

I just changed my attitude a little.
Everything will be okay again soon.

Oh, how did you know?
Something good just happened.
What...? Really?

That's right. You'll be more surprised than you think...
Actually, Henry has appeared.

Henry... really?
Not an illusion, a fake, or a trap?
Hey. When I said that Poison was probably setting a trap for you, you ran straight into it anyway. You're not suddenly getting careful?
No. If that's really the case, that's terrific! Haha. Looks like something positive is finally happening again!

In any case, Henry was sighted regularly in Area 9. The NED Company abandoned that location.
After what happened last time, I investigated everything very carefully. Henry was clearly there.
So don't worry and go get him.

It's enough to know that he's there.
See you later!
Show those NED guys who they challenged.
Please conduct a search mission in Area 9.

The NED Company's secret base. We could call it that.
How could they create a place like that, without us knowing about it?

Just knowing that there is this sinister place in a corner of Grace City annoys me.
We have to destroy this place as quickly as possible.
But... What is Henry doing there?
Exactly! And why was it not a NED Company troop, but the Candus City commissioned NBRF?
Maybe the NED Company really did abandon Henry. Could that be?

What is going on in their heads? The company tried with all their might to protect Henry.
... It probably doesn't help to overthink it. What matters now is that we get in there.

Knowing he's there is enough.
I'll catch him even if I have to destroy everything!

Opening the gate isn't a problem.
I can hack it within 5 minutes.

The real problem is that you don't know what awaits you on the other side.
We know for sure there will be lots of NED Company mercenaries.

It would be safest if we could scan the interior with a satellite.
But that's not such an easy method.

The jamming signal is too strong,
so we can't even grasp the troop strength, let alone scan the interior facilities.

The interior is quite large.
I think it would be hard for you alone to find Rauper and Henry.
Nevertheless, now we have to find a way inside somehow!
Of course. So I asked Sedurin for a favor.

I forwarded Sedurin the executive summary for all plans in this operation.
Go and see her.
If you've understood the explanation completely, you can also jump right in.

I have already informed Sedurin about this mission.
Go and see her and she will explain everything else.

I won't say this again, so listen carefully.
I'm reeeaaally tired right now.
You look tired.
My workload increased and it's been rough... yawn...
N...no need to explain!

No, I insist.
I couldn't sleep if I didn't explain it to you properly.

*ahem*... I want to use an EMP bomb.
When I activate it, the bomb will explode with a bang and all electronic devices in the vicinity will be destroyed.

Its operation is extremely simple. You just put it on the ground and press a button.
The bomb will do the rest all by itself.
So even I can operate it! I understand!

By the way: EMP isn't radioactive. EMP stands for electromagnetic pulse and is a kind of shockwave
that deactivates any type of machine.

But if the internal facilities got neutralized too, we'd be in trouble, right~?
So I traced the jamming signal back and adjusted it so that it
neutralizes only the machine transmitting it~.

So don't hold back, use it as much as you like~.
Got it?
Yes! I understand!

The mission has been completed successfully.
How do I know that?

Because we were able to scan the interior of the secret base.
Now it's not a secret base any more.
What's the basis for a secret base? Exactly, a home for secret bassists!
Hahaha! And the only way to clear out a home for secret bassists is with a conductor's baton!
Waah, there's not even any fun here.
Good thing Toru is back to his old self.
Actually, I like it better when he's so distressed. That makes it a bit more serious.

After searching every corner of the inside of the secret base,
we picked up a small number of life signs.

Amongst them was one in each corner, as if the person was on a sightseeing tour.
That was probably Henry.

I'm not sure, but I think he was looking for something.
There must be something in there... something he's hidden from us.

Additionally, another special signature of a living organism was detected. But we don't know what it was.
And as we don't know what kind of creature it is, we should be extra cautious during the investigation.

I'm not afraid of anything.
If Henry is located in that place, I would even risk my life to search.
The time has nearly come. Soon we will find Henry.

You don't need to spare them.
Show no mercy.
I understand!

Damn... I never thought things would get this bad...
Neither the Starry Forest nor NED can be relied on...
It wasn't easy to find! But it should gain us some time.
Ranse, Raban.
It is time for battle.

Now the time has come to punish the traitors.
To punish them so they will never forget.
So this is where you were. I've been looking for you.
There you are.
And once again lots of people have lost their lives because of the NED.

The Starry Forest trusted Ned in this operation too...
...a terrible betrayal.
... I don't think that the NED Company is evil.

I knew it was a money-hungry, selfish organisation, of course.
... But I believed in a world in which men are united with the money mentioned by Rogen.

In this chaos, I thought money was what could unite humanity.
And I thought NED Company would gladly spend money for the sake of humanity.
This decision... there was no doubt or hesitation.
Isn't it wrong if people are endangered because of it?!
I know exactly what sins I have committed.
... Emilito is dead.
I... I killed him.

I believed the world could be united if we trusted the NED Company.
That's why Emilito died.

I'm sorry...
I am sorry... so sorry.

I do not want forgiveness.
But please, save me.

I will give my life to atone for my sins.
I will make it up... to Emilito, Jeremy and you...

I promise.
Please... save me.
... This is the last time.
I'll give you one last chance.

You're only human.
And I believe in the goodness of people.

Leave the NED Company and come the SFL.
Come to us and make your contribution for humanity.
Yes, of course.

Your life is just as valuable as that of other people.
That's why I am ready to give you a chance if you beg for forgiveness with all your heart.

But this is truly the last time.
If you betray us again... I won't show mercy.
Yes, thank you.

Members of the SFL will be waiting for you outside.
From there on, you're on your own.

Jin, take this before you go.
That's a secret key that leads to a hidden room.
You can probably use it to find Henry.
Got it.

Emilito...
I'm sorry.

Near SoulWorker...
The NED Company has done something really tremendous here.
That's why I lost sight of Henry.
How unfortunate. I'm sure you're pretty annoyed about it, aren't you?

It's enough to know that he's here somewhere.
I'm sure I'll get him next time!

You're right. The fact that we found weapons hidden by the NED Company is a successful harvest.
You did really well.

This affair has turned the cold war between the NED Company and the SFL into a hot war.
It's unfortunate that Henry escaped, but we'll catch him.

After all, "Special Independent Unit ESP" and "Inspection Corps Orca"
are tracking Henry.

Both of them?
Wow, it's been a long time since we deployed both.

The chairman of the Starry Forest League learnt of the seriousness of the situation.
It can only be a matter of hours till we find Henry now.
It can't happen fast enough.
Are you still hunting for Henry?

I can be pretty unforgiving.
You have to handle personal matters personally, don't you?

I have some good news for you then.
Do you remember the Near SoulWorker that Henry showed us last?

Henry found Near SoulWorkers and used them...
In other words, he may have gone to look for other Near SoulWorkers.

Then there's yet more Near SoulWorkers.
And if Henry wakes them...
Yes, exactly. Investigations into the Near SoulWorkers are currently being carried out in Ruin Fortress.

I'd like you to take part in the operation to track and secure
Near SoulWorkers at Ruin Fortress.
Yes, I understand. Thanks for the information!

Actually, you were only here in Grace City to find Henry. I'm sorry we weren't much help.
I truly pray that you find him this time.

I've already informed Kane Barrel of the tracking location.
So you'll have to team up with Kane Barrel and complete this mission.
Kane Barrel is going too?
Since new enemies have appeared with the Near SoulWorkers, I'll focus more on hunting them.

Of course, it doesn't change anything that this mission is dangerous, even if Kane Barrel is along. But I'm sure that you'll manage together.
Come back safely!

Good work, Rookie.
See you later.
Before you set out on your next mission, you should introduce yourself to the others.
Hi, I wanted to say goodbye before leaving Grace City!

Ah, there you are!
You're looking cheerful today...
Yeah. If I lack energy, everyone worries.

Muahaha... So you're just pretending to be cheerful!
You really are an honest young man.
Haha! But I can only do this work because I get recognition for it!
Hm, I think it's actually because it's easy-peasy for you.

Well, I'm going to sleep.
That's all for greetings. Good night~

Dr. Sedurin! Many patients are still waiting!
Are you really going to bed?

I have my own work to take care of...
We've already treated the emergencies.
There's a new patient!

Oh, you mean that man... the Near SoulWorker.
What was he called?
Raban. You fell asleep again during the meeting...
So it's Raban. Is the Starry Forest League monitoring him?

Yes, we're taking care of Raban for now.
We need to examine him thoroughly, and his state of mind doesn't appear too good.
Hm... is everything all right? This man is an enemy...

Not at the moment he isn't.
We undid the brainwashing. The enemy no longer controls him.
So, he was manipulated in a number of ways.

I've examined his brain, and he shows signs of significant brainwashing.
It appears that he does not want to fight, but isn't capable of defying orders.

Our first action must be to undo the brainwashing entirely.
Once that's accomplished, Doctor Sedurin will run several tests.
Yes, experiments on live subjects are my forte.
Erm, doctor? Please, don't say things like that. It's not funny.

You were ordered to find the Near SoulWorkers?
By the time you return, I will have made enough progress so we can talk to Raban.
I'm not very interested in that. I'm more concerned about the search for Henry.
I...is that right? In that case, Raban must belong to me.
Hey, Sora, now that's what I call commitment!

Well, it's a ticket to a promotion!
And he's really handsome... *giggle*.
Ah, okay.
Oh, by the way, Rookie. I heard you're going with Kane Barrel this time?
Oh, yes. This time I'll learn as much as I can.
That idiot. His hood might look good, but he's an idiot.

It's cold at Ruin Fortress.
Wear a jumper or something... why are you only wearing the hood?
Don't blame me if you catch a cold.

Haha! You have to keep moving so you don't freeze!
Don't worry!
You don't seem to rely on clothes much either.

Oh well.
Take this scarf to Kane. Don't say I made it!
Got it?
Ahh. Yes! I understand! I'll give it to him!
Okay, great! Take care, Rookie! Good luck!
Oh, you're here again?

I've already talked to Roy.
He didn't give me any details. He just said that you want to leave Grace City shortly?

Yeah. There's someone I absolutely must not forgive.
I think I'll keep chasing until that matter is settled.

Pity.
I'd have loved to chat with you longer.

I don't really know what you do,
but I clearly remember you moving around busily and looking full of drive.

I can't do anything useful...
But one day, I will walk my path on my own two strong legs.
Yes. I hope such a day comes.
Roy, don't you have anything to add?

No. I don't.
We'll be seeing each other soon, anyway.

I see.
Then allow me to tell you a boring tale before you leave, Jin.
I'm all ears! Fire away!
You remind me of my time as a Supernatural.

I also wanted to push my abilities to their limits and help people.
I might not be anything special these days, but back then...

And she was always at my side.
The embodiment of determination.

She was strong and unyielding.
A wonderful woman.

We joined forces and overcame all obstacles.
And each time we did, our relationship grew stronger.

But I began to question the path I had chosen.
I don't remember why... but there probably was a reason.

We grew further and further apart.
That's why she...

That dazzling white flame burned me.
These wounds are from that time.

That was not a nice story...
As happily as you told that, I must have misunderstood something.

Hehe. Differences of opinion led to us going our separate ways, but I still love her.
If it seemed to you that I had fun telling you the story, then you're right.

She was so beautiful...
Even the flames that tried to take my life were flawlessly beautiful.
Instead of being angry at her, I came to a realisation.
In my eyes, she was clearly a creature who had come from the heavens to judge me and change me.

I don't know what she's doing now.
But one thing is certain...
She's moving forward of her own will.

I mustn't give up.
If only so I can see her again, one day... I cannot give up now.

That's a good attitude.
I don't know if it will be enough, but I will help you!

That's really not necessary.
He... he's a little funny in the head.
But you, Roy, you're not completely normal either, are you? What's up with you?
Is that what you always think of me?

In any case, I deeply admire how diligently you helped in Grace City.
I have hope for the future.
Well, I won't keep you any longer. Let's meet up again sometime.
Until next time.
(You say goodbye to Neb and Roy.)
Very interesting.
What do you think?
You're not a good liar.
Haha, Roy. I don't want to lie.
Hm. Still, don't send some investigator after me.

Didn't you talk a bit too much?
I might tell on you to the Starry Forest.

You think so?
Who cares what some boring guy is mumbling to himself?
I can't figure you out.
I don't think it's all that bad. But fine.
In any case, I look forward to another meeting with that person.
Well, that's because your life is boring. So you can look forward to something like that.

...
Roy, don't you have things to do?

Oh, you gave me a fright!
I'll be on my way then.
Please avoid using excessive methods.

What do you think of me?
You really don't need to worry about that.
There you are. Are you finished in Grace City?
Yes! Yes, there's nothing left for me to do there! Let's go to the next place, quickly!
I must say... You're a completely different person from before.
Is that a good thing? I thought this incident would have given you a shock...

Of course, there were moments when I wanted to give myself up and forget everything.
But I always thought that it was not the right time.
Yes, you can actually grow, even in situations like that.
Well then. Get going!
Drat... connect... just connect!
It's already connected... you can stop.
Rogen...! It's me, Henry!
I know... How could I forget you?
G...Rogen!

Let me back into the NED Company!
I'm begging you.

I don't know why you ordered the retreat from the west of Cloudream and left me behind on my own.
But my research can save mankind and make the NED Company the greatest...!
The catastrophes in Amaryllis and Candus City... and now the Near SoulWorker project too.
You jeopardised the existence of the company and mankind, and now you want to be allowed back in?

T-that... I'll make up for it starting now...!
Please give me a chance...!
It's because of you that everyone at NED headquarters had to be withdrawn from the west of Cloudream.

The Starry Forest League has classed us all as enemies and will punish or poach everyone who has had dealings with the NED Company.
If the remaining members in the west all leave the NED Company now, then the NED Company will no longer exist in the west.

All because of you, Henry. So...
Stay there and seek forgiveness from the Starry Forest League, or take your own life.
Rogen...
I'm going to hang up now. Don't call me again.
Rogen...

*sob*
*sob*

Rogen... you'd dare to leave me?
Me, the genius who will rebuild mankind from scratch?

All right... if you're going to be like that: I have a plan too.
Damn you both, Starry Forest League and NED Company. I'll exterminate both of you!

Code name Queen... The immortal Soul Junk hidden in Candus...
If I get my hands on her, I can destroy you once and for all!
I... will be master of this world... haha... mwahahah!
Jeremy?

You didn't eat, again.
These are restricted to 30 per day. I got up early this morning to get them.

Phew...
All right. Let me know if you get hungry later.
I'll go then.
Emilito...
What's up with you, Jeremy?
You look like a different person.

What happened to that cheerful smile and eternal optimism of yours?
Even your eyes are dull.

I... quite like that.
You used to get on my nerves a lot. Hahaha.
Jeremy.
Do you want more power?

Chapter Three: Torn Ideals
Complete.
Ach, I want to go home.

Hm? This is a restricted area for civilians.
Please head back quickly.

Ah... I'm not an ordinary citizen!
I came on business...
You claim you're not a civilian? What are you then? Maybe a trespasser?

Wait, just a second. Civilian or not, how did you get in here?
Who are you? You there!

I'm the SoulWorker dispatched from Grace City.
My name is %username%, nice to meet you.
Aahh.

Aha. So you're that SoulWorker there's been so much talk about.
I've heard a lot about you.
You're a lot, really a lot younger than I expected!
If I'm young here, the place must be crawling with old codgers.

No, no. It's just that heard you were in the Vacuum for 15 years.
But it's true, you don't seem to age in the Vacuum.

I'm Martin.
I've been dispatched to Ruin Fortress as commander.

Oh, the Commandant!?
Hahaha. As young as you are, I never would have thought so.

It was hard to get here.
...I'll leave the kind of hardship to your imagination.
If you're the commander, could you tell me about the current situation?
Yes... that is... Right, although I am the Commandant, I don't know much... No, I don't know anything at all.
... what?

I'm the Commandant in name only. As the reinforcements were assembled so suddenly in an emergency, there's no real system.
I have had neither a pay rise nor a promotion.

If only I had! Actually, I should have been on holiday soon.
I was really looking forward to being able to relax, finally. But now there's neither holiday nor compensation.
Oh, it's so demoralising.
Be that as it may. Can't you tell me anything at all?

I really don't know.
We have to do something so we aren't cut off,
but it's not even clear where to begin yet.

There's no point in forcing people I'm seeing for the first time to carry out some kind of examinations.
I've even already heard the words ‘What do you know?!' from one of my subordinates.
Of course, I don't know everything. It's a completely different field of work! How am I supposed to know all that!?

Sending a hastily assembled team on the important mission of tracking Near SoulWorkers
is like saying the upper management is incompetent.
Honestly, I almost feel like being demoted for insubordination would be better.

Ah, whatever! Don't you want to make a little effort?
If you exert yourself, I'm sure you'll get some recognition from the others.

Recognition, huh.
More than recognition, I'd like my salary raised even a little...

Ah, I shouldn't be saying this to someone who came all this way to help.
Ha ha... sorry.

Given the circumstances, we have to visit each other and investigate.
There's a woman named Amanda over there on the Supernatural investigation team.
She should know more than I do, so go say hello.
Understood... I'll go check.
Hahaha, until next time.

Go to Staff Sergeant Amanda.
She's sure to know more than I do, so you ought to ask her.

Welcome.
I've been waiting for you.

Aren't you the SoulWorker from Grace City?
I've seen photos of you but you look even more trustworthy in real life.

I-I'm %username%!
I'm still inexperienced, but I'll do my best...!
Well... you're welcome, provided you don't just hang around.
Incidentally, why are you standing so far away?
Uh... I didn't want to get too close in case you thought it was impolite!

Oh, you're one of those.
Come closer, I'm not going to eat you!

A...all right. I suppose it's equally impolite to keep such a distance when meeting for the first time.
I'm really sorry.
Ahaha, I don't mind. We can talk like this if you prefer.

Oh, I haven't introduced myself yet. I'm Amanda.
I'm a Supernatural in charge of communications at Ruin Fortress.
My ability is extending radio waves. Well... simply put, a walking radio extender?

I don't mean to brag, but I guess that makes me the most useful member of the squad based in Ruin Fortress.
Communication would be impossible without me.
Oh! Do you know anything about Ruin Fortress?
No... I just transmit commands and orders. I haven't investigated anything.
So that means you know as little as Martin over there.
No! I am definitely not like those people there!

That commander spends all day spacing out drinking hot chocolate,
the doctor in charge is unfriendly, and I can't tell whether everyone came to investigate Near SoulWorkers
or just to enjoy the snowy mountains.
You seem rather unhappy.
I seriously hope you can understand my problems, even if nobody else does.

I understand you.
Let's do our best together!

Thanks.
I'm afraid there's not much I can tell you, but I will share everything I know with you.

Ruin Fortress here is a fortress built by NED Company.
It had cut off contact with outside forces, including the Starry Forest League,
so it was an unknown quantity.

But ever since Grace City, we are certain the NED Company betrayed us.
And because this pact was broken, the Starry Forest League won't make any exceptions now.

It seems the shuttle thought to be carrying the Near SoulWorker also came here,
so the mission is the investigation of Ruin Fortress and tracking the Near SoulWorker... something like that.

The Starry Forest League has never been inside Ruin Fortress.
We don't know how many buildings there are or what they contain.

Investigating normal people would be enough of a problem, but on top of that, nobody knows anybody here...
So there's trouble cooperating, and we can't come to a joint decision.
Then I'll carve out the path myself!

Oh! If that were possible, somebody would have already done so.
But you're a SoulWorker, so I have high expectations of you all the same.
Oh right, do you know anything about Henry?

Henry? Oh, the scoundrel who caused trouble in Candus
and was chased from Grace.
I have been informed that he may have fled here.

We still can't even manage the fortress, let alone grasp its interior...
so I can't say for sure.
I can only assure you that I have not clapped eyes on so much as his shadow.
I already thought this wouldn't be easy.

But if the Near SoulWorker Project was under Henry's command,
we might find some clues by investigating.
Yes! I'll investigate the place carefully. Be thorough!

Wow... You really are always optimistic.
Aren't you scared of going in there alone? You don't know what's waiting for you inside!
No! On the contrary: I want to get inside as fast as possible and find out what's going on!

I'm scanning the interior with the communicator right now.
You wouldn't want to die from an unknown attack without knowing anything,
so please wait a bit longer until the call to assemble.
All right, you can go and see Dr Sarah over there.

Yaaawn...

painful?

G... guh!

Is this much enough?

I could easily buy something like a small house in my hometown.

Yaaawn... right, %PCFirstName%?

R-really!?

While I'm gone, don't cry from fear, hang in there!
Ha ha ha!

they say he was chatty even on the way to the training center~...

And lots of requests... yaaawn, what a hassle...

Well, there were various requests~...
Hm~...? This... there's a request for you too.

Please be sure to tell Jane I'm safe.
You're cool, SoulWorker. Ha ha ha!

...it says.
Yaaawn, he's really a strange mister~.

From what I heard earlier~
a soldier named Jane seems to have been financially supporting the mister's family...

I have lots of other research to do~.
Well, good luck~.

What were his other requests...
Ah... he lost his Army Necklace, but please make sure it doesn't lead to a court-martial...

Sigh~...
Can someone like this become a SoulWorker~...

Hm, the soldier Jane?
Hmm... let's see...

Ah, Jane!

Hey, %PCFirstName%.

Haa, haa... %PCFirstName%?
Why are you here...?

Ah, Sergeant Smith... I'm so glad...
Haa... haa.

I should be handing over Sergeant Smith's Army Necklace myself...
Haa...

I want to finish the operation, but I can't carry it out because of that Rapid Flame.

If it's possible, could you help me escape this place..?

Ah, welcome back.
Who's that soldier?

I'll contact you when it's done, so rest a little.
Good work.

Sigh~, what to do...
Ah! %PCFirstName%, did you hear too?

About Rapid Flame...

That cheerful man has gotten less talkative...
He seems to be thinking about strategy all the time.

Isn't there something I could do to help the Colonel...
Hey, isn't there anything...?

Hm, SoulWorker?
What are you two plotting, hey!?

Billy of the Booker's Hand Gang?
I told you to move with soldiers, didn't I?

Well, don't be so uptight.
You think I'd sell your info, hey.

Don't worry.
We're in the same boat anyway, I won't do that, hey.

Understood.
But from now on, be careful when moving around.

Hmph, cold like the big shots.
By the way, you were talking about something interesting, hey.

You don't need to know.
It's our business.

I might be able to help, you know?
Well, say it, hey.

None of your business.
Get back to your place quickly...

%PCFirstName%!? What are you doing!

Hm? Over something that trivial you were wearing a face like you carry the world's troubles, hey?
Hmph, what, is that all.

..."Trivial"?
Then can you solve it?

Hm? Hmph, don't underestimate me, hey.
Just punch the enemy boss, can't you?

Sigh... anyone knows that much.
The question is whether anyone can do that.

Hm, you don't even get that, hey?
Hmph, this is what they call "it's darkest under the lighthouse."

What do you...
Ah! %PCFirstName%!?

Hmph, finally figured it out, hey?
Well then, I'm off to play a bit.

Ha ha... I feel I took one from Billy, but...
Defeat the enemy boss...

May I leave this to you?
Surely pointless sacrifices and injured soldiers will decrease.

Billy, that guy...
maybe he's a better Vessi than I thought...

From the reports and situation coming in, I can see they're wavering!
Uh… billy?

Hm? You're the one calling out for once.
What is it, hey?

Thank you... for telling me a good method.
Thanks to it I may be able to reduce soldiers' sacrifices.

Next time you get paid, treat me to some tasty human food, hey.

Ah... understood.

Anyway, thank you.
Thanks to you I realized something good.

Sigh... Colonel!
If you force an operation, you may get hurt.

The losses are too great!
Please reconsider once more.

No, adjutant.
This incident is a serious matter that mustn't be brushed aside.

You're my adjutant, why can't you understand my thinking!
Go request troop reinforcements from Thor right now!

Tell Thor I'll command the troops directly.
This isn't a request, it's an order!

Sigh... what a mess...
%PCFirstName%, what do you think?

Ah, the situation is this...
While advancing, Rapid Flame destroyed a small school.

The school collapsed and the children inside...
seem to have been brutally slaughtered, every one.

The Colonel heard this and...
he's been raging around like that ever since.

If we tell Commander Thor, she'll surely send troops, but...
a considerable number would be pulled from our already insufficient forces...

If that happens, we won't just lose the battle.
The loss of key troops would be of enormous scale.

At a time like this, if only there were some way...
Hm...? Billy?

Hm, what is it, hey?
Did you come into money to treat me to a meal, hey?

...I know you were eavesdropping next door.
Maybe you have some useful information?

Hmph, no, it wasn't on purpose, hey~.
I just thought maybe you were eating something tasty~, hmph.

Ahem! Well, you know.
I think I told you the same thing before... have you forgotten, hey?

...What?
I don't remember...

I told you to use the SoulWorker close by.
Simple, right, hey?

A SoulWorker...
True, if a SoulWorker moves, troop losses would be fewer, but...
He's in blind rage right now… do you think something like that could ease the anger of the Battalion Commander?

Hm, you mean the human boss?
Did that guy win the boss position by gambling, hey?

Sure, he's probably raging right now.
But is he such a blockhead that he can't be figured out even when his adjutant, you, handles it properly, hey?

Find that human boss's anger point and solve it, hey.
Then it all settles and it's a happy ending, hey.

Hmm... understood.
Let's try it.

Hmph, well then, I'll take a little rest, hey.
Thanks for the hard work~.

As Billy said, could you take down those Rapid Flame guys?
Meanwhile I'll report to the Colonel.

The Colonel seems sensitive about children's issues after the previous mistake.
I have to support him properly.

Thanks to you solving it, the Colonel's anger has subsided.
We don't even need troop reinforcements now!

Hmph, looks like it worked out well?
Then you're treating me to human food, right, hey?

Billy, thank you.
But... how did you read the Colonel's heart?

Hm, read, you say, hey?
Hmph, I've read the room plenty under the boss. Well, just a hunch, that's all~.

Even if called a traitor, living in a crappy place, hey.
At least a boss can make that much judgment~.

Call me if you need anything else, hey.
I'll teach you the lessons from my hard life.

Oh, and the reward is human food, hey! Don't forget~.
If it's bad, brace yourself, hey? Hmph.

Understood.
I'll ask again another time.

Sigh... what should I do...
All of this being scrapped...

Ah, you came?
Look at this pile of machines.

Sigh... all of this is scrap.
Can you believe it all came from 1 place?

Sigh... all of it is equipment deployed to Untouchable Pass, but...
apparently there's a new type of fire extinguisher there.

That extinguisher contains a liquid that corrodes iron.
Because of it, all the machines rotted...

I put such loving effort into tightening screws and oiling them like they were my own children...
Sigh... what am I supposed to do...?
I'm sorry to ask, but I'd appreciate it if you could go to Untouchable Pass right now.

Could you smash all those new fire extinguishers that are supposedly there?
Then we can prevent the equipment's corrosion.

Fire extinguishers!
If you see one, destroy every last one!

That damn liquid...
It seems they can't develop it any further, so just break whatever's there!

Phew~, thanks to you I can catch my breath...
But what do I do about the ruined machines...

Infinite overtime is guaranteed from today...
Sigh~... anyway, thank you.

if there are people awaiting rescue, we can't not go.

I thank you on their behalf.

I heard.

As much as we can't only rely on SoulWorkers, we've decided to do our part as well.

It would be ideal for us to go out on the front lines but ESP troops don't have the power SoulWorkers do to deal with it accordingly.

Rather, I should say it can't have much impact.
The psychic units suffered big losses earlier.
Although targetting the head of the enemy would be most efficient when left to both the ESP army and SoulWorkers.

Even if we crush the head, the front line will hold for a while.
So I decided to take a meaningful mission with some ESP members.
Saving people.

They asked what I'm doing with an ESP unit that could even turn the tide, but...
that's what people who don't go to the battlefield and see people only as numbers say.

Grace City's Heavy Gears are strong.
And... Grace City, the safest place in western Cloudream that I know, won't crumble like this.
Plus, I've already gotten consent from headquarters to continue with this plan with a part of the group.
Also, it's already proven that it works. SoulWorker %PCFirstName%, thanks to you, that is.
It seems Eric has been spreading a lot of great influence to not only SoulWorkers but the ESP army and SFL.
Thanks to that, we've gotten a lot of cooperation from the citizens and the morals of many of the soldiers are significantly improving.
So could I request your leadership this time as well?
There's someone who's been dealing with a lot of relief activities who asked for some assistance.
Of course, they claim they can handle it on their own but I don't think it would hurt to have another helping hand if we can lend it.

Sorry.
Same as before, I'll send the location to your terminal.
Thank you.

Haa, haa...
I can't breathe...

...Hm? %PCFirstName%?
Did you come to support us?

First time since Grasscover Camp, it's been a while.
I heard about Dipluce Port.

Another hero added, to think...
I'd better try harder too.

After awakening to psychic ability, I transferred to the ESP unit.
...Ah, aren't you thirsty? I have water...
Haha! Gotcha!

Ah, you say my personality seems a bit changed?
...Yeah, I'm trying to change a bit.
For %PCFirstName%, who helped me... and for everyone else.
I told you, right? That I'm going to be the real thing.

Psychic ability doesn't solve everything, but I've gained confidence since then.
Confidence that I can do it.
So that's why I thought I could do it; become a hero, I mean.

I also bought a ring, for when I propose to Aina.
I had 1 before, but...
… I'll just leave the story here; this is still a war battlefield, after all.
We can talk about everything else once we return to Grace City.

We've just about finished identifying the civilians nearby.
So with the unit guys I'm about to carry out a retreat operation.
But, as you know, this place is still crawling with Rapid Flame.

Sorry, but could you draw their attention?
Meanwhile we'll protect the civilians and return to Grace City.

Good work. I heard from Sensun.
He said you were a great help.

The rescued civilians are each receiving treatment or resting.
And Sensun...
Oh, hey you two.
Speak of the devil.

Thanks to you I made it back safely.
Thank you.

Ah, please take this.
It was given as thanks for the rescue.

Don't hold back.
It's leftovers from the unit members.

To meet you here.
I came for a bit before entering the Ruin Fortress...

I didn't expect such a blue sky.
The Ruin Fortress sky is blue too, but not as safe as here.

We plan to rest a while and set out again.
It's a bit busy, but not as much as SoulWorker %PCFirstName%, I bet.

I'm rooting for you. Always.
I hope we meet again.

Patient, hold here. Hard.
Ted, bring some bandages!
Y-Yup!
Julie! Rubbing alcohol!
I told you to wait, didn't I?! I'm still looking for it!

Now, it'll hurt a little, but...
please bear with it.
One~ Two!

Phew... a little rest...
Hm? Master!

You have no time to rest, do you?
And you're noisy, idiot!

Ah... %PCFirstName%. Hello.
Did you perhaps bring supplies?
…..? I see.

It feels like it's getting slower and slower.
It's good that more people came, but...

Because the number of people suddenly rose.
When it suddenly rises, they say we run short of the "premium" ones.
It's just supplies, you idiot.
*gasp* T-Take that back!
Lolololololololol.
Ah… Ahaha…. I guess they're this energetic because they're just kids.

It's changed quite a lot, hasn't it?
With the war starting, lots of refugees came from elsewhere...

Since the war started, the injured are increasing everywhere.
I just can't stay still.
We've lent a part of the orphanage to SFL and… I've been doing as much as I can to help out with htings.
But it's difficult since the injured keep flooding in nonstop here and there.

Help...?
I don't have anything in particular...
Oh! %PCFirstName%!

Actually, supplies are short right now.
I did request from the Starry Forest League, but...

Their reply is a bit slow.
I even feel like they're avoiding us...
Could you look into it if possible?
Oh! Thank you.

Senia has always handled support.
Please ask Senia.

Senia has always handled support.
Please ask Senia.

Oh, what's wrong?
Rest whenever you can, even a little.
Hm? Support?

Ugh... honestly.
Even without that, I'm in a bit of trouble.

Recently, items brought from an outside unit went missing.
Along with the soldiers.
They're completely MIA right now.

They should be near the town that was burned to the ground earlier, but...
I can't spare anyone to rescue them.
Huh? You're going to help out?
Didn't you hear me say that you should take a break?
I mean… if you're okay with it I guess?
Yeah, I can rest assured if you're part of it.

Here, this point is where they last communicated.
The unit is probably around here.
But this place is crawling with Rapid Flame.

It won't be easy to pass, but for you it's probably no problem.
If you clear that, I'll rescue the remaining unit along with the supplies.
Understood?
Great, let's do this!
Waaaah! You're here!
The supplies have arrived. Senia says that thanks to %PCFirstName%, the supplies and the stranded soldiers were saved...
Thank goodness.

Thank you.
I don't have much to give in return, but...
I'm forever grateful for your help.
I should look back at myself and be more charitable from now on.

Thank you so much.
I'll do my best.
Oh, have you heard?
Those jerks from the Eastern reinforcements are calling our report low-grade.

Western hicks?
Ugh, honestly!

Veterans among veterans are gathered here, you know.
Tch, I feel awful...

%PCFirstName%.
Won't you join us and show those eastern guys, no, those eastern hicks!
And come to think of it, I thought I heard that one of the leaders of Rapid Flame looks like some sort of sorcerer or whatever?

Then that guy must have something like the magic he uses.
If we use it, couldn't we make a weapon with tremendous firepower?
Then I think I could flatten the confidence of those jerks.

All right!
Let's give it a try! Ga-ha-ha-ha!
Doesn't matter if you strangle him or haggle him; just bring me anything.
I'm going to look into it and use it to my advantage.
Good luck with it!

Take care of that mage quick and bring back 1 related item.
Count on you! Ga-ha-ha-ha!

You're back.
Let's see...

Hm?
What's this...?

Hmm, it looks like mere cloth, but...
It all shattered and only this remained? And you brought this?
Oh my word…..

Can't be helped...
Still, you brought it, so I should thank you. Here.
Clothing….. Hmmm…..
Maybe I should give it to Ran…

All right.
We depart in 5 minutes.
Don't lose your focus.
Alright; we're all prepared over here!

%PCFirstName%.
I thought you'd be resting...

We're setting out again.
Days of hardship again...

No use complaining.
Hm... %PCFirstName%, I have 1 request.

Could you join the operation with Sensun?
Not a rescue, but seizing Vessi supplies.

There should be usable items.
The worry is that since the support troops arrived, their vigilance has tightened.

Headquarters would probably not choose a frontal attack except for a surprise operation.
Their boss is still alive, after all.
There are probably still citizens and others tending to the mission there.

So I want to request support.
Somehow psychics alone feels a bit dangerous.
Thanks.

A simple briefing... we'll infiltrate from here.
The operation will proceed concisely and swiftly.
We're going to go into their warehouse and quickly bring back the supplies.
We'll wait nearby and infiltrate once %PCFirstName% has suppressed them.
%PCFirstName%, lead the way.

%PCFirstName%.
Something serious has happened.

As planned we reached near the supply warehouse, but...
the flashy fighting on the way drew more attention from the surroundings than expected.

They detected many Vessi gathering nearby.
It's an open area, so we'll be spotted soon, I think.
Even with %PCFirstName% here, it may be hard for the members to withdraw safely.

No time to deliberate.
Anyway, I'll proceed with a swift withdrawal.
I heard what happened.
I'm looking into what happened exactly but I don't think they're very happy the plan didn't go according to plan.

But no need to worry.
The upper ranks won't like it, but I value lives over operational failure.

Thanks for the support.
Good work.

Sensun?
Let's wait. This time there are seized supplies too, so they'll return in 2 batches.
SoulWorkers. Of course, they're back because they'd be the first ones beheaded.
But Supernaturals are a different story.

Wait, a communication came in.
Ah, it's Kane Barrel.
…Hm.

Understood.
We'll send support at once. That's all.

...Sorry, just after you returned, %PCFirstName%.
Could you go to the operation area once more?

The temporary base we were using seems to have been attacked.
Contact with the unit that was waiting to return has been cut.
Same with the troops Sanson was with.
It's support on moving to a safer destination.
I'll leave it to you, %PCFirstName%.
They're going to put up a fight so you'd better hurry.

They've reportedly already secured a safe place.
All that remains is to get them there safely.
… Good luck.

Ah, support!? Saved...
It was a bit close, though.
The rest of our troops should be headed to safety right about now.

We decided to run a diversion.
The problem is that even that isn't going well.

It seems they had a separate pursuit unit moving.
I heard explosions from over there too, so they're probably engaged.

I'll deal with the ones chasing us.
Sorry, but %PCFirstName%, please support the members retreating.

Don't worry about me.
I'm used to battlefields like this.
I'm confident in using my abilities now and I think I've reached a certain level of survival even when I didn't have any of my abilities.

Besides, Aina's waiting.
I'm not dying before I marry!
Then I'll catch up with you later.

Seems I'm a bit late.
There were more pursuit units than I thought.
Although I think it would've been worse if I had went to support the soldiers already returning.

Wounds? Come to think of it, I got hurt here and there.
Well, those aren't serious.

The ring for Aina and her photo...
I always kept them on me, but I lost them.
I want to go back home so bad.

Everyone has reached the safe zone and seems to be waiting to return.
Let's head back too.
Thank you for helping out.

I heard from Kane Barrel.
Good work.
The one who needs to rest the most is the one doing the most around here…

Sensun?
He's being scolded by Miriam right now.

Did I say scolded?
Make that being treated.

Ah, and also.
A token of thanks from Kane Barrel. I don't need it, so it should go to the one who toiled.

Honestly.
That Sensun...

Did you say a battle-hardened warrior? Fits the nickname.
With those wounds, it wouldn't be strange if he'd collapsed.

If you like, next time Fortune...
No, it wouldn't suit someone who recklessly abuses his body.

It's been a while.
I've heard about the other day.
As a part of SFL now, I can't help but to pay more attention to what's been going on with you all.
SoulWorkers; fighting on the front line against Vessi and Soul Junk; true heroes.

You all fulfill such roles well, but I felt something was lacking.
That said, it's not that there are no achievements.
I thought about what it could be.

Too few people have seen it directly.
Ordinarily, people are quite insensitive to things they haven't faced.
That's why I think it's a good idea to show the troops and citizens of Grace City.

If they saw you all shining like hope in this worn-out red city...
Wouldn't you be the very symbol of relief?
Of course… I guess it wouldn't even be enough for them to truly trust in you even if you showed them tons of times.
Hm... impact is important. How about 100 times?

Will you do it?
Prove that you are a symbol of relief in this terribly ravaged land.
Good luck; you'll all be ableto do it.

Can you hear it?
Even I, with no psychic ability, can hear it.

Long ago, when you all first came to Grace City...
you prevented a great crisis then too, but it was different from now.
The voluntary troops from the East were also talking among themselves of the works of SoulWorkers.
Now you'll be able to say it with confidence.
That you're the symbol of salvation.

Sorry to call you suddenly, SoulWorkers.
You must have each been spending your own time.
Oh, it's quite alright! But more importantly, what seems to be the problem!

Understood, then from now...
Ephnel isn't here yet?
Yeah, she ran off somewhere alone.

Hmm, do we need to gather everyone?
That one insisted on fighting alone to the end, though.
This is an urgent matter; I'd like for each and every one of you to be here.

I came without being told.
It's noisy, so please stop issuing summons across all of Grace...

Ephnel! As I thought, you came right away because everyone's in danger!
So kind~!
I'M GETTING PAID TO DO THIS! Don't make me a loser who gives in to every little kind deed!
This must be a pretty big deal seeing as you've spread the orders all over town, huh?

That's right...
It seems a Rapid Flame ambush unit has attacked here in Grace.

Rapid Flame's...!
Has the war really started already?

Since long ago, the ambush unit has been the vanguard Rapid Flame sends first when starting a war.
In effect, it's a declaration of war.

The ambush unit swiftly throws the battlefield into chaos, then the main force slaughters.
You all, stop that ambush unit from getting any more cocky.
It's finally now starting; I've been waiting for this.

We successfully blocked the enemy's first plan too.
We should be able to stop the next without trouble.

Good.
Then head to the scene.
Go request an airship from Rann like last time.

I'm glad to see you again!
Are we heading to the Ruin Fortress this time too?

No, this time the enemy is invading Grace.
...I think fighting will start near here.

Finally it's come this far...
Then is the destination Grace? Or the east, where we flee to?
If you're going on about escaping like that when you're with a bunch of SoulWorkers, is that fun for you?
No, it's a good enough point to ponder in the circumstances that citizens' lives are put in danger.

We'll think about that then, and the current destination is where the enemy is.
Could you guide us?

Yes, of course!
Then I'll guide you.

The place where we first engaged the enemy. And the place where we're currently tracking enemy movements.
Which will you head to?
There's not necessarily any reason we all have to stick together; let's split into two groups.

...Excuse me.
May I decide the teams?

Hm? Well, I was going to ask you to.
What, do you feel a sense of responsibility as leader or something?

Ha ha... that's not it...
Anyway, I'll continue.

First, I'll split the teams with myself and Erwin as the core...
I'll go with Stella, Chii... and Jin.
Yay! I'm with Chii~!
Looking forward to working with you, Stella.
Me too!
W…Wait! You're leaving me out of the group of the two of them?!

Sorry, Iris.
Please follow my opinion for now.

Sigh... fine. I don't know what the criteria are, though.
I'll put up with it by playing with Lily.
I'm not going to hang out, Miss Stupid.

You split the teams awfully quick?
Is there some criterion?

The place where we first engaged the enemy...
When I heard those words, I couldn't help imagining what became of that place.

...I see.
If only we'd defended well at the place of first contact.

I put people I don't want to see that sight on the same team.
...Was that meddling?

No, it's a good idea, and it's like you.
I don't care about members' mental state.

Two little kids and one guy who always pretends to be cheerful. Not bad, right?
Being with them, you don't want to see it either?

No, well...
I'm just going along because I'm worried.

I know.
Thanks for fulfilling the leader's responsibility.
Yup! Then I'll call Toru to tell him about the groups.

Okay.
The ones on this side are strong at least mentally, so don't worry.

Everyone, come here!
There's an injured person.

Hiding in a dark place, and you still found them!
As expected of Chii, good night vision!
Haha, leave looking at things in the dark to me.

So many SoulWorkers...!
S-saved.

How's the situation?
Are the others still fighting the enemy?

We're somehow holding them off.
If you SoulWorkers join forces, we can push them back in no time!

Understood!
Then let's go right away!
It's a good thing we made it in time.
Uhm, Haru.

Everyone's happy.
Many people... are still alive.
It sounds like they're happy to me.
Happy voice; that's a good sign, right? Let's get on it!
Stella, tell me where they all are.

Yeah, let's go save them together!
I want to save more and more!
… Yeah, we'll be able to.
Nice work. I think most of the situation is under control.

We proceed to the next battle as is.
Everyone, don't let your guard down.
Then shall we split into two teams again like last time?

No, splitting into two teams won't be the wisest choice since the situation has worsened.
And the situation won't get any better just by stopping the enemy's attacks.
It seems like we have no choice but to stop them when they attack. Do you have a particular plan?
It's okay! We can just save everyone again!
Stella? How can you say that after seeing everything...

Woah, wait!
Calm down, Iris. She just wanted to cheer us up.

Well, that's true... Hmm...
Stella didn't do anything wrong.

Erm... Did I do something wrong?
Then I'm sorry.
No, it's okay! You don't have to worry about it!

I didn't expect you to snap at her like that.
But the situation was dire indeed.
Indeed...

Anyway, old man.
The situation won't get any better with just stopping the enemy's attacks. Is there no other way?

We can only wait and keep an eye on the situation for now.
Like I said before, we're not in a situation where we can move freely.
Tsk... Is there no way even with this many SoulWorkers?

It's because it won't be over with just fighting and winning against the enemy.
We have no choice but to defend Grace City.

There is another option.
It's not like we have no way to fight back.

If we stop their first shock troops, their main forces will follow them.
And since it's a war, Flemma will be leading them at the front.
It's dangerous for us to go attack Flamma, but stopping Flamma when he comes to attack us should put us in an advantageous position.

But will it go that well?
There's no guarantee that Flemma will be there, and their main forces may not be there at all.

I agree.
Normally, final bosses just send their MinWoons and wait for us on their thrones with their arms crossed, right?
That would be the usual case, but it's different if you consider the characteristics of Rapid Flame as a group.

They fight only to show off their strength.
It wouldn't make any sense for their leader not to show up in the great theatre of war.
...Of course, I'm not sure if they would still act like that after joining Kent.

Then we have no choice but to fight with all our might.
It's not like we have any other ideas either.

That was a long explanation, but that's pretty much it...
We must hold our ground for now. I hope all of you do well.

You're really different compared to when I was the only SoulWorker.
Did you change your mind because you think we can fight since we have more SoulWorkers now?
Of course. Do you want to run away like last time?
Well, running away might be better than dying here.
Must you ruin the moment again?!
Oh... Iris! Please calm down! We must not fight against each other!
Don't stop me! You should be stopping her from spewing all that nonsense!
Let's just say that she has the right to say that she wants to live...

Oh, you know well.
I think he's smarter than you, Iris.

Iris Yuma.
I keep telling you, but it's better to ignore her if you can't get along with her.

I know, I know! I know...
But why on earth is she so twisted inside?!
Hmm...

It seems like you've changed somehow, Ephnel.
I'm sure that you weren't so apathetic before.
I didn't change at all. You just all went crazy after gathering together.
Are you refusing to answer my question?
How should I know. See you.

Oh, Ephnel!
I'll go too!

Hahh...
Shouldn't we first check if she really is a SoulWorker?

Don't worry about her too much.
She's just going through a rebellious phase.

Then why is she going through a rebellious phase?
I must know the reason to at least understand her.
Well... I'll stay silent about that since Ephnel might kill me for saying it.
Come on, she won't go that far.
Ephnel makes sure she does everything when she puts her mind to it.
That's impressive.
...Let's say that was a joke.

Talking to Ephnel about it now will only make her feel like she's being mocked.
She doesn't like others being nosy about her life.
Can't you wait for now until she brings it up herself?
We might die of old age before we hear it.
...Of course, I'll talk to Ephnel about that, too.

Okay, okay.
Then let's stop bothering a helpless old man and get moving.
Okay! Then let's go, Lily!

Hmm? I never expected you to team up with me first.
Would Chii and Stella be okay with this?

I'll pass on them today since I've embarrassed myself in front of them.
Also, I wanted to know you better.
Ha ha. So you're thinking about having more people on your side.
It's not like that! Don't twist my intentions into something malicious!

If that's not what you intend, then you're just purely evil.
Fine. There won't be much of a difference for me whoever I go with.
So will you go with me or not?
Please, let me go with you.
Then who wants to go with me?!

Oh, I'll be by your side, Stella.
And I think you'll need a guardian too.
I'm 30 years old! I don't need a guardian!
Ha ha ha... Yes, I know about that.
Okay, then who's left...?

You've been hiding your face in silence until now.
Is there a problem?
Erm... So, then... we can not be friends with Ephnel now?
What? What are you suddenly talking about?

Iris and Ephnel had a fight...
And you can't be friends with someone you fight with...

Even friends fight with each other sometimes. What are you worried about?
It will be fine after some time.
Even friends fight with each other...?
Oh... So you were curious about that?
Normally he's no different from a human, but sometimes he's missing something crucial somewhere.

You don't need to worry too much about that.
As someone who knows humans better than you, I can guarantee it.

The personalities of those two are similar too...
I'm sure that they'll be laughing together on the streets, arm in arm before long.
Then it would be better if they never fought against each other to begin with.

Well, yes.
Internal discord isn't the best when we're busy fighting against the enemy.

But keep faith in them and wait.
Ephnel went through the same line of events we did, so she won't be that much of a bad person.
...Okay.
See you soon.
Welcome back! Good work, everyone!

Erm, is there another operation?
I can go even now...

I haven't heard of anything yet.
You're so enthusiastic though you just came back. I always respect SoulWorkers like you!
Ha ha ha... Thank you.
There's no need for respect. We're just doing our duties as people who have the strength to do so.
Lily, you really fight like it's your duty.

I learned that it was only natural for nobles.
...But since I'm not a noble anymore, I rather just enjoy the fights.

But I like to watch you proudly fighting against the enemy.
Compared to you, I'm always fighting like I'm being chased by something. On top of that, the responsibilities as a leader are quite a burden...
Is that so? I thought you were fighting better than you yourself think.
Ha ha ha... You're just being nice to me now, aren't you?
We should really do something about your lack of confidence first.

Straighten your shoulders a bit.
Compared to other selfish jerks who think only about their own lives and money even in this situation, you're certainly a hero.
Ta-da! The jerk is here~
I didn't mean you.
If that was the case, you would've apologized immediately.

Hello, Ephnel.
I'm surprised that you spoke to us first.
Did you change your mind and decided to be friends with us...?
No.
...You're so stubborn.
I have business to do with pigtails over there.

Lily Bloommerchen at your service.
I told you my name, so I expect you to call me by my name next time.

You. You don't seem like the type to mingle with others.
Why are you with them everywhere?
What makes you think that?

Your words and actions don't seem like you're the type that likes to be around people.
To be honest, it seems like you're forcing yourself to be with them.

Ha ha. You know well.
Were you watching us that carefully?

That's not important here! Anyway, there's no need to be with such fools.
Just live your own life like me.
Erm... Ephnel, do you want us, SoulWorkers, to fight against each other?
I'm just asking about things I'm curious about.

You're right.
Fights and killings are my essence. I'm not fit to mingle with so many people.

Am I forcing myself to be with them?
I can't deny that.
No, Lily! You're not forcing yourself to be with us!
If you say that to me... honestly, it makes me sad.
Don't be so gloomy with your head down. You should listen to the entire context, Haru.
So... Are you saying that you'll still force yourself to be with them?
Yes. Is there a problem with that?

Let me ask you something in return. What's wrong about forcing oneself to mingle with others?
Can people who prefer to be alone never mingle with others again?

I want to find new possibilities by working with many friends.
And that's why I'm trying my best to put that into action.
Lily...

Yes, you're similar to the others. You just haven't reached that point yet.
It's my fault for thinking that you were similar to me.

Ephnel, I respect your opinion.
If you feel comfortable fighting alone, you should work alone.

But it's a certain fact that not many of us understand you.
I don't mind if you continue being stubborn, but you should give up finding someone like you.
It sounds like you're trying to tell me to do whatever I want. Then I want you to stop trying to be friends with me too.

You should say that to the others.
I don't do that.
Ephnel, if you really want to stay alone... Then I won't say that anymore either.

But please save others when they are in trouble.
It's fine if you save only those in your sight.
Well, I don't have any reason to let people die in front of me.
Well... That's a relief.
And I'll be able to get paid when saving them.
If they're parents, I'll make their children pay. And if they're children, I'll make their parents pay!
That's very like you.
It might be understandable if you think it's like doctors getting paid for looking after patients.
Sometimes, it's difficult to understand you too.

Anyway, I can understand that much.
But it is a shame that we can't fight together...
But aren't we working together well despite all that?
We just happened to be working on the same jobs.
Ha ha ha. If this coincidence continues, we might understand each other one day.

Forget about it. Let's just go do some work.
Poor civilians are being killed even at this moment. I should get some extra pay.

Good job, SoulWorkers.
All of you fought well in each of your positions.
And I'm glad that you did well too without causing any problems, Ephnel.
I just worked for the money I was paid.
Ha ha ha! I'll keep that in mind!
Now, what matters is from here on.

The leader of the enemy's shock troops...
It seems like an officer has been spotted.
So are we winning if we defeat that officer?!

That's ridiculous.
You're riddling me like sphynx.

Of course, we won't win just like that.
But we'll at least be able to defeat the assault force and draw out Flemma.
Ah, I'll punish this oblivious old man later.

I've been able to defeat officers even by myself, so it will be fine.
I'll go get that done now.

Wait, Iris.
I think the situation may be a bit different now.
What could be different?
The Rapid Flame executives we fought in Grace before had already seen two of their own defect.

Yes, that's right.
Scar was acting on his own, and Poison didn't really want to fight.

That's not all.
We had the support from the Starry Forest League and such at that time, too.
In Falcon's case, you wouldn't have been able to approach Falcon if the Garura forces weren't eliminated by Operation Wolf Cry.
Then are you saying that we're cornered this time?

Rapid Flame must've regrouped their forces, and the officers must be coming out fully prepared.
Compared to that, the Starry Forest League's forces have suffered great casualties due to the assault.

The situation is different from the incident in Grace City.
You must face the fully prepared enemy officers without any help.
The danger would not be comparable to anything.
I see...
That's right... It's more dangerous than ever right now.
Yes, we have a lot more enemies too...

Some people always made others nervous.
But every time, the enemy wasn't that difficult to handle. Let's just go out to fight against them.
Ephnel... Seriously...

No, Ephnel is right.
We have no option but to fight.
Hey, I still have the option of running away with my tail between my legs.

Forget what she said.
All I want to say is that I don't want you to push yourselves too hard to fight.

Operations staff like us are working behind the scenes so that you can fight in a better environment.
It's better to wait for a solid plan to be set rather than fighting without much thought.

But things will still be in our favor if we kill the enemy's officers, right?
That's enough for us.
You always make our headaches seem so simple...
It's better than running away without even trying.

Sigh... Okay.
Then go raise havoc wirh the enemy.

Yes, ma'am.
Okay. Let's go, everyone!
Sigh...
Seriously... It's no use getting worried about them...
Senia. Their powers have exceeded our expectations long ago.
If we don't have much of an option right now, why don't you just let them take care of it?
But even you know that's not for the best...

In the past, the Starry Forest League was too confident about the SoulWorkers' powers.
That's why they relied only on SoulWorkers, and they ended up using SoulWorkers like tools.
Don't you think we might be repeating history?
...Don't worry, Senia.
I promise that I won't let past repeat itself.

But the Starry Forest League won't get any better unless we strike a deal with the eastern headquarters.
We'll be forced to use the blind justice of those SoulWorkers.

Wait... I can still take a quick look at the documents.
Hmm…

It's understandable... since it's a matter of public order, isn't it?
The kind that's given to Starry Forest League.
That is why our funds have been reduced.
Maybe, we might be able to use mercs once or twice... maybe even three times if we try really hard.

Since common soldiers can be easily found.
Unless SFL recruits more support, it's just a little too much for us.

Ah... well, as I've already told you if you plan to go yourself, I won't stop you.
But in our current state, I wish you knew that it would be difficult for us to help you out.
If you're really planning to go... the location is within the outskirts, not far from Grace City.
I don't know how it was back then, but people no longer live there.
In other words, Soul Junk has taken over the area.
It's more of a scouting operation rather than a search operation. So, maybe just take a couple of rounds around the area...

If it's too much for you, I can just reject the request.
What will it be?
... Okay, so you're just going to pass by...
Got it. I'll tell Rauper about it.
While searching, if you run into strange objects or phenomena please inform me.

You're back.
Did you find anything?
Any strange structures... or object that radiates with abnormal Energy?

The area is off-limits, and it was peculiar considering the fact that there were citizens in such a dangerous area.
However... with that kind of trade... the status of the refugees... wait.

%PCFirstName%, did you see what they were trading?

Hmm…
You weren't able to catch them because they ran away in several directions...
Currently, I know that it's hard to see good people around due to the ongoing war and new encounters with enemies.
I know it's not something that you'd like to hear from someone in the Merchants' Union, but it hasn't been safe to go around.
Nonetheless, a proper investigation is needed.

This is for your trouble. It's not a lot...
But since you did much better than mercs.
We'll need further investigation regarding the refugees.

We'll try to figure things out from our side as well.
There's one thing that's bothering me.

I'll let Rauper know about it.
Thank you for your help.

Hrmm... yes, you did.
The only way is to get more.
Okay. If we get more, we'll hand them to you right away.
But, don't keep your hopes up.
I really don't want to cause consumption through stupid things.
I know.
... Oh dear, %PCFirstName%? When did you get here?

... It's not a big deal.
We were just talking about how we needed test samples.

I also wanted to run some tests... Ugh...
I came here hoping that Heavy Gears would have some.

In fact, we only collect them when we need them.

Yep.
I already knew that, but I just had to ask.
Hmm... so, what do we do?
There's nothing we can do.
Can you ask them for some time?
I don't think so...
All right.

What do you mean by that...
You're not thinking what I'm thinking, are you?
Hell no!
You don't even know what I was thinking about!

It's pretty obvious!
You're trying to get the kids to do it, aren't you?
You're out of samples, you can't use the troops, so you're trying to ask them, right?

Ugh...
Senia... stop frowning! You'll get wrinkles!

You know that and yet you ask for favors?
Yeah, yeah... so, can you?

You just carry out your missions as usual~!
We'll handle the collection~!
Well... if you can help destroy the ones that are left, that would be of help.
Wow! Thank you thank you!

Ugh... fine. Okay...
But make sure it doesn't affect the other missions, okay? You got that?
Oh defo!

If anything happens, contact me.
I have things to do, so I'm heading back. Phew...
You shouldn't be here if you're so busy! Goodbye!

But you...!
Never mind...

The biggest threat of them all? Desire Workers.

We were able to retrieve some of their weapon fragments after the battle and we've been studying them...
But somehow, one of the patrons of our lab heard about it.
So they asked us to get some for them.
I've tried telling them that it's difficult to get our hands on the samples and they said that they were going to cut off our funds...
Well, if we finish the study, I won't care whether fry, boil, or sauté the samples, but the fact is, we don't have any.

That is why... we are trying to get the weapons of Desire Workers...
Even fragments would do.

%PCFirstName%, you just have to concentrate on your mission.
And we'll collect the weapon fragments.
We're not in a rush, we're just going to tell the patrons to wait for a bit for the weapon fragments.
Okay? I beg you.
Okay? We good? Yeah?
Oh, you're here.
You didn't hurt yourself, right?
I'm worried that you might strain yourself since you are fighting Desire Workers.
You have no idea how Senia bombards me with sermons every time these things happen.
But thanks to you, we were able to get enough samples.
I was hoping that you wouldn't think I've ordered you around while I sat here doing nothing.
It's only suitable for me, the expert, to go and look at the samples to retrieve the good ones.
To be fully honest, though, I just like going out to get some fresh air.
Anyway, here's what the patron provided us. Since we succeeded, thanks to your help, I think it's only fitting that I give you a cut.

I was worried that it would be really difficult fighting Desire Workers...
But it seems like I didn't have to worry.

You did great!
Woo! Woohoo!
Oh, wait, is this that place too?

It's the outskirts of Grace City.
Hey have you heard?
I've heard from a patron that keeps asking for favors and isn't really a lot of help.
In the outskirts you've been passing through a lot, Desire Workers that are the same as SoulWorkers have been spotted.
There were quite a lot of happenings... and that kind of Energy, should I say? If those guys appear again... it's a real trouble...
They're not twins, but many have seen them... I just thought it might be a problem.
I should fact-check rumors first, but I think that would be difficult right now.

Huh...
Is it because of the Vacuum expanding?
I've just been too busy lately~.
So... I'd like to ask you for your help with the investigation...
There are so many tests that I have to run on the samples you've acquired.
*Yawn* thank you for your help.
You're here. I've been waiting.
I was waiting for you to get here.
According to Oden, I've heard that you helped with the investigation regarding the refugees...
Any progress there?
So, you're saying there's none.

No, %PCFirstName%. You don't have to feel sorry.
Like I've told you before, we did say we would use our investigator to check it out.

Some kind of transaction was said to be present.
The Sloth Natall... the stimulant from Advanced Social Industries.
%PCFirstName%, you've heard quite a lot, so you'd know by now that Advanced Social Industries has taken over the Southern region of Cloudream.

A long time ago, they used these things at the time they were taking over the Southern regions of Cloudream.
It had stimulating effects and was highly addictive. And this was provided to the people at an affordable price.
When consumed, it tricked the brain into thinking it was satisfied. It also caused auditory hallucinations that resulted in spiritual experience.

However, I am assuming that what made all these effects possible was Desire Energy.
Since it was a stimulant made for Vessis, that lived their lives satisfying their needs, it's possible that they used it as an ingredient.

For them, it worked as a stimulant that gave them desire again when tired.
But for humanity living in Cloudream, it was not so.

When consumed by people unrelated to Desire Energy, it caused powerful visual and auditory hallucinations.
And it even gives satisfying effects at the same time...
The Advanced Social Industries were blinded by money as it is... They were overjoyed to find out about this.

Just looking at the Southern regions of Cloudream, a huge amount was spent on that cheap stimulant.
They were even selling their children for a bargain in order to buy these stimulants.
As their addiction became worse, there were many that gave up on their lives.

As people who lost motivation increased, a huge hole opened in Cloudream's southern society.
R.S.B. probably slipped into that gap.
It's hard to say that the Advanced Social Industries took over the South solely with a stimulant, but it did play a huge role.
And now, I'm wondering if there's a possibility that the stimulant made its way here.
If it did... Advanced Social Industries would be watching this place. The West.

And it would no longer be a laughing matter.
If we repeat what had happened to the South, we are going to be defeated once again.

We have to stop the stimulant from being sold. It would be our priority to catch those responsible during a trade and confine them.
%PCFirstName%, what do you think?
I am sorry that I have to be the one to say this. There's no one up there that can help us right now.
