I doubt it.
Hmm... I guess. It's the only place the refugees can reach where security is absent.
But since we can't pinpoint the exact location, you might have to move around, back, and forth the area to find them.
Oh, this might not be of huge help, but the base has authorized the use of the military reserves.
We plan to deploy them to the outskirts nearest to refugee camps for a search mission.

And %PCFirstName%.
You may come and go while the search is underway, but when you find unauthorized civilians or other persons, please detain them if possible.
That's the only way we will be able to get to the bottom of this.
I trust you, %PCFirstName%.
If it's regarding refugees, you should talk to Rauper.
I heard from Arin that you've returned.
I was anxiously waiting for your return.
Looks like we won't have to give you any more trouble.
We weren't hoping for much, but our scouts were able to arrest refugees that were returning from the outskirts.
They were being chased by Soul Junk.
The soldiers thought they were refugees fleeing the war, but they were already carrying refugee certificates.
Maybe, they're related to the trading scene that you spotted, %PCFirstName%. We'll get the details once we investigate.
Oh, %PCFirstName%. Did you find anything?
... This is?
You're saying some Soul Junk were carrying this?
B-But... according to Oden. These are the stimulants from Advanced Social Industries.
Were they... confiscated by the scouts from the refugees?
They were in a very ragged state during the arrest... I heard they weren't carrying anything special.
If that's true... we'll find out during the investigation.
I am guessing we won't be needing any more help regarding this case.
Since this might be related to the Advanced Social Industries if there are any ties to begin with...
Also, it's a waste of assets to use a SoulWorker like yourself in times of war.
We can't say there hasn't been any progress, so we'll request an agent from command.
Thank you for all of your help.
We'll let you know if there's further progress.

There you are.
Did something happen?

Something to help with?
Me...?
Oh, the outskirts...

You looked too busy so I did some investigations of my own.
It doesn't seem like a lie.
The Desire Workers that the SoulWorkers have been fighting have appeared, but I haven't figured out their identity.
I've tried using the Energy analyzer, but all I can say it's that it isn't normal.
Well... nothing's been normal since the Vacuum appeared...
Anyway, I plan to analyze the Energy that occurs during battles.
If I can analyze the reactions, I might be able to get more information.
If you ask why it has to be a SoulWorker... communication is impossible, they're extremely powerful, and only a SoulWorker would be able to face them.
I mean, we can't tell a commoner to catch them.
They're extremely dangerous, so I was hoping you can help, but I don't want you to overdo it either.
Additionally... I'm not sure if it's a good thing or not, but they don't seem to have the ability to judge.
Thanks to that, they are wandering behind the line of defense...
You might have to be careful because they apparently destroy everything they see.

I received authorization from command through Senia.
I guess the matter is a bit sensitive, considering it's related to Desire Workers.
If it's okay with you, then I'd like to ask for your help.
Great.
We can't say if other entities do not exist or are not appearing, so fighting with the wandering ones would be enough.
I'll run the analyzer once you start fighting.
Be careful out there.
Take care.
Okay, I've heard from Arin that you're here.
You don't seem hurt.
The Energy analysis has been completed. The results are somewhat out.

I think...
They can only be explained as an abnormal phenomenon that occurred as the Vacuum expanded.

The fact that they appear in the form of Desire Energy of SoulWorkers...
Desire Workers suddenly appearing when they should be within the Vacuum...

At first, I thought it was like that this time. But upon further investigation, that wasn't the case.
They were things we knew more about.
But before anything...
Did you experience your Energy levels increasing or decreasing, while you were fighting them?

So, no...
That's normal... wait... it's weird saying that. Anyway, I asked just in case.
There was a ruckus about another Desire Worker appearing... but I think it was only a chunk of Desire Energy.
However, the SoulWorkers and Desire Energy in the past... so... it's what happened to the remaining Energy that scattered when the ones that looked like Desire Walkers were fighting.

Though, I really can't tell how they turned into this form.
Ugh... Should I have studied more about Desire Energy...?
Fortunately, it's not a huge problem as long as they're Desire Energy...
But the thing is, we've confirmed that Energy was being released into the air during battles.

If nothing else happens, the released Energy will band together, creating the same thing.
I'll have to ask you for help every time.
If you're not spotted, they're not very dangerous... but you still have to be cautious at all times.

Are you her identical twin?

It's Arua!
Look, I'm Arua!

...I missed that voice.
It’s so good to see you again.
...Is that really you, Arua?

Yay! Arua is back!
What have you been doing these days? And what’s up with that outfit?

Stella, you’re speaking to Solar Nox, the ruler of Nihill Kingdom now.
If you keep calling her by the name she abandoned a long time ago and treating her like one of your girlfriends, I, as her guard commander-

Stella! My lovely friend!
I missed you sooo much!
Me tooo!
Being a guard commander is hard.

Deltis, you may ask other ordinary humans to show me respect, but not my [friends].
And I didn’t abandon the name Arua, and I never will.
Sure, sure. I understand.

Wait a sec, Solar Nox...?
So you’re the traitor of Nihill Kingdom who banished Lunar Nox?
That was the story I came up with in order to cover my identity... But you think you could retire that story now that you know who I really am?

Ah... Sorry about that.
I’m a little confused now...
So... You’re really a Royal Highness, Arua?

Yes, I am!
What do you think? I look quite dignified, huh?
Hmm, all I see is a little kid who’s busy bragging about her not-so-secret power.

I am so sorry...
I never knew that and was so impolite to you...

Don’t worry. You were the most polite human among all of you.
Well, it’s not like I expect you to treat me differently all of a sudden.

Hmm, you managed to climb up pretty far in the meantime.
I guess Nihill Kingdom had no talented people, putting a dummy like her on the throne.

No, it’s more like she fooled us all from the beginning in order to blend in more easily.
I never suspected it because her acting dumb was so natural.
Oh, she wasn’t acting. That was really her.

All right, all right.
Anyway, this isn’t the time for a teary reunion!
Who’s crying? We haven’t been apart for that long.

Toru.
Where’s the battlefield? I want to take care of the most urgent matter right now.

I’ll share that information with you shortly.
In the meantime, take the transport ship with the SoulWorkers.

Ah... Wait!
Arua, it’s just going to be the two of you, right? You and Deltis.

I’m not sure about Deltis, but it’s going to be too much for you to handle it on your own.
Even we had to retreat once because of the overwhelming number of the enemies.

Right. It’s great that you want to help us, but you don’t have to push it too hard.
It’s our job to protect humans in the first place.

What nonsense...
...Having concerns for me is futile.

Hey, could you talk in your usual tone?
It gives me the creeps.

But… well…
The Arua I know... won’t last long in a battle, honestly.

Hmmm, I don’t know. I occasionally accompanied her down to Dipluce Horizon, and she was able to protect herself just fine.
So I don’t think we have to worry too much about her.

Lily is right.
Why don’t you all come with me?
I’ll show you the real reason I came down here.
Umm... I don’t really have high hopes right now.

But like Chii said, don’t push yourself too much.
Just remember, we got your back.

Tsk tsk, Haru Estia.
Do you remember the fight against Flemma?

Of course...
He was one of the strongest enemies we’ve faced so far.

I am the ruler of Nihill Kingdom.
Just like what he used to be!

Ah... Really?
Wow... That’s amazing.

Ah, that look on your face!
You don’t believe a word I say, do you?
Sorry, there's already an image once etched into my brain...

Then it’s your chance to change that image altogether at once.
Good luck, Solar Nox.

Hmph, if you put it that way...
Then I’ll show you what I’m really capable of!
I really hope this could turn the tide...

Solar Nox.
Sorry to break up your party...

Yeah. What’s up, Deltis the disloyal?
What did you find so displeasing about me this time?
...I just have one question.

Although the Nihill soldiers are strong and experienced, there are still casualties.
The casualties even include captains and colonels.
So the enemies are putting up quite a fight.

On top of that, you brought the main Temptation Stone here.
That eliminates the possibility for our men to run away.
It’s more likely for them to face the fall of their own kingdom along with your death.
In that sense, I’d like to ask you if this war is really worth dying for.
What kind of a loyal subject doubts his lord’s motives?

Lately, I’ve been exposing myself to the human culture frequently.
They say the true loyal subjects are never afraid of saying the right things, and I can’t agree more.

Deltis.
You know what happened to the leader of Rapid Flame, right?

Of course, I do.
It was me who brought humans against Flemma.

The power of Rapid Flame, especially Flemma was measurable to our kingdom in Stair Oroboroi.
G. Nox kept a watchful eye on them, saying that they were one of the strongest Vessi.

But he couldn’t even stand a chance against Kent.
That damn god is...something way beyond our imagination.

It could’ve been us if it wasn’t for Rapid Flame.
We wouldn’t have been able to put up a fight.

...As much as I hate to admit that, I agree with you.
Rapid Flame and ourselves have a tendency to heed to the mighty ruler.

Thankfully, Kent seems to only be interested in humans for now.
So interested that he’s willing to engage in a war with them.

Who do you think his next target is going to be when he manages to exterminate all human beings?
We shed blood in a city of humans today, but there’ll be a river of blood flowing on our soil next.

We are the honorable Vessi.
Wouldn’t it be your last wish to die in your homeland rather than someplace else?

Believing that there’s any glory in death is the result of my damn father’s brainwashing.
I believe the real honor is in surviving by any means and living on.

So I’m going to tell them they should not be ashamed of dying for humans in their land.
Their death will be the foundation for honor and lasting peace of Nihill Kingdom.

...I knew this was going to happen.
But I sense that Nihill Kingdom is not going to be the same as before.
If you have a problem with that, maybe you can track down my sister and try overthrowing the kingdom with her.

I have no intention of doing that.
I was just worried whether you made a decision to participate in this war based on something ridiculous like staying loyal to your human friends or not.
Haha, that’s absurd.

There’s nothing I wouldn’t do to make my kingdom prosperous.
This war is just one of the opportunities to defeat Kent while letting humans take the lead.

...Of course, I wanted to find my lovely sister first.
But it has got to wait since I completely lost track of her thanks to Edgar.

Well... All right.
I’m glad that I wasn’t wrong about you.
I’ll continue to serve you without a shred of doubt, Your Highness.
All right. You complain a lot, but you’re wise unlike someone.

You’re back.
How was the army led by the Royal Highness of Nihill Kingdom?

It was...impressive.
When countless soldiers appeared out of nowhere, I just couldn’t believe my eyes.

Haha, that’s the authority and power of a Royal Highness.
I am Nihill Kingdom, and Nihill Kingdom is me!

I truly appreciate you stepping up to join hands with humans in this war.
Would it be possible for us to bury the hatchet and focus on defeating the common enemy for now?

Of course!
Here, let’s shake on it!

But let me remind you once again.
We’re just here to back you up in battle.

Understood.

...My...

Lily Bloommerchen.

Stella...

It's not going to take that long.

Haha, I admire your spirit.

Then I'm busy, so excuse me, I'll be going ahead.
Neb started to attack Grace City from four different directions.

The situation has become much more dangerous than we anticipated.
SoulWorkers... I think all of you need to get to the scene right away.
Is he seriously dividing himself like some sort of germs?

No wonder he had been quiet for all this time. He must’ve been very busy preparing that.
But it’s going to be quite complicated to tackle his attacks this time.

It’s not like we’ve never seen his hallucinations before.
Some of them even turned into a monster.

So I’m sure it’s not going to be that strong either.
We can defeat them all together!

The Near SoulWorkers easily took care of his hallucinations once or twice already.

Are you saying all four of them are...real?

What are those NED bastards doing not locating something like that promptly?

It’s not easy as it sounds.

I don’t think I’ve ever seen that Spirit thingy working except for that one time in Grace City.
Spirit PathFinders...

I thought it was nothing more than scrap metal because of Desire Energy.
We have to focus on how we’re going to fend them off now.

Right! Now that there are four Nebs...
We should pair up and defeat them all!

...Ah, never mind!
With Nabi here, we have four pairs and one person left!
I’m sorry, but can you count me out?

I’m going to talk to Senia for a moment and move on my own.

You’re bluffing as usual.

I can’t really deny that the very idea did cross our minds.

I knew I shouldn’t have let them be in the battlefield...
That’s it. All of you should submit your letter of resignation to Martin when this is over.
Um, I’m sorry to interrupt, but we should retreat now!
I know that! I’m going to clear the path with him, so just follow us!
Yes, Ephnel and I will take the lead!
I thought you were not interested in making friends. I’m glad that you have a dependable comrade by your side, Ephnel.

Ugh, not you too!
I only let him fight alongside me because I have no other choice!

From the moment we’re fighting together against the common enemy, we’re friends!
Just give it up and accept our friendship and passion!
No way! And stop using those words that belong to some cheesy after-school specials!
Haha, don't be shy! I understand!

Yeah, that’s one of the reasons that she says things that she doesn't mean.
One more word and I’m heading back to Grace City by myself.
Okay...then let’s focus on getting out of this place alive first.

I don’t sense any possible threats around this area.
Can you take it from here, Sion?
All right. I’m going to move everyone at once, so stay close to me.

Oh, I finally get to find out what it’s like to be teleported by the prototype.
Thank you.

I guess it wasn’t that easy to defeat Tenebris after all, huh?

I-It was pretty close!
We would’ve won if we fought a little longer!

Yes, she’s right. I’m confident that we could’ve defeated him in the end.
...Except for the fact that some of us would’ve been seriously injured in return.

The strategy of charging at the enemy was wrong to begin with.
It was such an inefficient way to bring out the SoulWorkers’ true potentials to the fullest.
If someone had attacked us in the rear when we were at the impasse, we would have been wiped out.

I agree that it’s an extremely inefficient way of managing the unit.
I mean, why would you go and dive in there when you’re supposed to be holding your ground?

We have the wall and the entire city that can be used in our favor.
The way I see it, we have all the opportunity to create an environment much favorable to us first.

Ah, you’re right.
From a strategic point of view, we may look reckless engaging in a fight.

But we still have to get out there and fight.
If we lure them into the city, there’ll be numerous casualties and immeasurable collateral damage.
So you’re fighting at a disadvantage just to protect other people.

But I don’t think you can afford the luxury of saving everyone in such a bad situation.
To be honest, it looks more like having nine SoulWorkers on your side made you feel overly confident.
Shouldn’t you be looking for the best way out even if it means you have to sacrifice some people?
No, I don’t want to do that!
Stella...

I want to celebrate with everyone when we finally stand victorious...
But I wouldn’t be happy if I come back to see everyone’s corpse.

We’re fighting to live all happily together.
So I want everyone to live!

...Is that how you humans work?

Everyone in Nihill Kingdom will be happy to throw themselves at the enemy for the sake of nation.
So this way of thinking must be quite hard to understand even for you, Your Highness.

So we’ve got to respect their foolish decision to stick to this inefficient fight.
I’m sure I’ll learn a lot by observing how everything unfolds in the end.

Alright.
If that’s the way you’d like to go, I follow.

It’s not that I hate this positive ambiance...
But you do realize that we just came back defeated, right?

Okay...
Maybe we should take everyone and escape to the East.
Say no more! I’ll go book the first flight out!
Then I’m going to stay here and buy time for everyone till the end

Why don’t you go talk to your commander?

...A crushing defeat.
I knew this would happen but not to this level.

NED and the Nihill Kingdom army encountered Tenebris’ hallucination and retreated around the same time you did.

It doesn’t change the fact that the situation is still at our disadvantage.

A horde of enemies rushing in from all directions...
Countless lives we must protect...

But we’re not even close to finding out where the real Tenebris is...
If the wall around Grace City is breached, we’ll be facing the worst case scenario.

People say urban warfare is a battle on corpses.
Now that we have no time to escape, we might really fight while trampling on countless citizen bodies.

...That’s the worst.
It’s going be less than half who can fight in a situation like that.

But don’t worry!
Not all hope is lost yet!
It would be nice if I could see that hope you’re talking about...

...I can’t believe it.

Are you saying you have a plan to solve both these problems, Erwin Arclight?

Let’s talk about how to catch this legendary SoulWorker...
Hello, %PCFirstName%.
Are you looking for help?

But there’s one child that I’m a bit worried about...

Although I just told you to get some rest, do you think you can help me with this?
%PCFirstName%.
I haven’t been able to collect all his belongings yet.
If I tell you the location, can you go and look for anything he left around that place?
If you find something, I’d like you to bring them back.
As one of those who are left behind, we have no choice but to lean on anything we can find to remember the fallen ones by...
Thank you so much. I’m sure you’re extremely busy these days...
Please be careful. I hope you return safely.
Please stay safe.
%PCFirstName%, welcome back.
How was everything? I hope you’re not injured or anything.

I’m sure...she meant a lot to him as much as he was to her.

%PCFirstName%.

Oh, you’d do it? Thank you.
It’d be nice if you can sweep the place from here to over there.
You want me to be more specific?
Ah, just take a look at your map or follow the navigation.
You may know more about what’s what in District 6 than me now.
Just go and take a quick stroll around that place.
When you’re done, we’ll take care of the rest.
Good luck.
You’re back. I’m glad you look fine.
It means we can have a good night’s sleep from now on since you came back in one piece.

I know you’re all strong and mighty, but there’s no guarantee that you can finish the job without a scratch.
Let’s see... So you secured the route.

I’m going to give an order to transport things right now.
Well done. Here you go.
It’s not much, but here is your reward.
We prolonged our lives by one more day.
When will this war end...?

I’m so sick of this war, I hope it ends right now.
Then take care. I’ll see you around.
%PCFirstName%, are you busy right now?

Why am I whispering?
Oh... It’s nothing, but...
There’s a problem that I really don’t want anyone to find out...

That... It’s something similar to a book.

Other features?

Don’t tell anyone, and go there by yourself in secret.

I really don’t want to ask a SoulWorker for this...

Thank you.

I guess being popular is not that good in a case like this...

But what kind of notebook is it?

Perhaps it contains the records of some military strategies or supplies?
...Can I take a look?

[YYYY/MM/DD, Hot]

Please accept this, and don’t tell anyone about this ever.

I’m sure it’s not the real Tenebris but just a lump that’s materialized because of Desire Energy.
The problem is that each of them is too powerful to overlook.
But it’s not like I could afford to send an unit after unit to defeat it until there’s no Energy of him left.

My biggest concern here is that it’s impossible to predict what its next move is going to be.
There’s no guarantee that it’s going to appear on the same spot either.

I want you to watch his every move and report it back to me.
Follow him around to see if he ever gets out of District 6 and roams around Grace City...
It would be nice if we can find out how he fights too.
it’ll be very helpful for soldiers to respond if they ever have to face him.
I want you to report anything you find suspicious about him.
No matter how trivial something appears to be, it could be a trigger to turn the tide in a war, you know?
I would’ve done it myself if I was a little bit younger...
But I’m glad to see that you’re working day and night to help everyone, be it citizens or soldiers.
You should get going now. I hope to hear from you soon.
I hope to hear from you soon.
Ah, you’re back. Did you find anything unusual over there?
Let me take a look at that report.
Hmm... I see.
I made the right call by sending you there. You managed to capture his every move that any normal soldiers would’ve overlooked.
Good job. I’ll take this excellent report.
Now I have to decide how we’re going to handle the situation...

Should I send something to keep an eye on him or order everyone to return to their base...
What should I do...

Ah, sorry. I've kept you.
I'll think about how to handle the rest. Don't worry about it.

I wonder if I could use it to train soldiers.
If they learn the moves of the legendary SoulWorker...
Wait, I’m sure it’s not going to be easy for ordinary humans to copy the SoulWorker’s moves.
Hmm? Are you still there?
You can go now. Thank you.
You busy, master?
Yeah, I’m talking to you... Why am I calling you master?
All SoulWorkers are my masters! Why else?
In any case, I have a favor to ask you...
I heard the hallucination of Tenebris appears on the other side of the wall.
And I don’t know if it’s true but his hallucination looks just like the time when he was called the legend.
I’ve heard so much about him, but I never got to see him in person!

Although he’s a traitor, he was a hero before he turned...
And now, I’m really curious if everything I heard about him is true.
And this is where you step in because you’re super strong!
You can go beyond the wall, right?

Can you go and take a picture of him?
I want a picture of the legendary hero!
Come on, just once! Here, use this camera.

Please take as many as you can!
Oh, photos while fighting would be even better!
Maybe you can capture the moment when he unleashes-

Hmm, is that asking too much?
In return, don't worry about how the photos turn out!
Can you do that for me? Thank you!
Ah, that’s an expensive camera, so please be careful with it. It’s not even mine...hehe.
You’re back!
You took the picture of him in battle too? You’re the best!
I’m so excited. Let’s take a look!
...Umm, is this really him?
I heard that he’s super strong, handsome, and charismatic...
But in these pictures, he looks so normal....
I think you look stronger than him.
Maybe my expectations were too high.
Well, it’s still Tenebris! Thank you!
Now that I think about it, what you do is kind of similar to a hero too.
Does that mean there will be books about you in the future?
Maybe your story will be passed on to our next generation too.
Err... I think that would make me feel so weird.
If I hear someone talking about you after you retire...
I’ll jump in and tell them everything I know about you!
I’m going to tell everyone what kind of person you were so that there won’t be any rumors.
You’d like that, right?
Ah, now that I have a camera right here, I’ll take your picture too.

Or let's take one together!
Put the camera here...
One, two, three. Say cheese!
...Whoa, it’s a great photo. I like this one than the others.
Thank you for everything today. Then I’ll see you later!

If I test her skills now, I can train her better later.

I'm the strongest here at Azland Camp, so don't worry.

Just fight like you've fought before.

If I teach this kid the basics of swordsmanship, she'll become a great fighter.

Did you break up with her on purpose, or does it just look suspicious?

Let's fight evil together.
Pah, you found out she's a Desire Worker.

Don't underestimate Arzland Camp! Arzland is a peaceful paradise that I raised up!

I sacrifice myself for peace in the camp…

I thought we might become good friends… But if this is how the cookie crumbles…

I should condemn you as a traitor.

For peace in my paradise… die!
